verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਾਤੂ ਪੰਚ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har aape pa(n)ch tat bisathaaraa vich dhaatoo pa(n)ch aap paavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself directs the evolution of the world of the five elements; He Himself infuses the five senses into it.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਝਗਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak satigur mele aape har aape jhagar chukaavai ||2||3||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the Lord Himself unites us with the True Guru; He Himself resolves the conflicts. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bairaaRee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and you shall be emancipated.

verses.original: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT koTa(n)tar ke paap sabh khovai har bhavajal paar utaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord shall destroy all the sins of millions upon millions of incarnations, and carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagar basat har suaamee har nirabhau niravair nira(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the body-village, the Lord Master abides; the Lord is without fear, without vengeance, and without form.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਤ ਕਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har nikaT basat kachh nadhar na aavai har laadhaa gur veechaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord is dwelling near at hand, but He cannot be seen. By the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is obtained. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har aape saahu saraaf ratan heeraa har aap keeaa paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the banker, the jeweller, the jewel, the gem; the Lord Himself created the entire expanse of the creation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jis kirapaa kare su har naam vihaajhe so saahu sachaa vanajaaraa ||2||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Kind Mercy, trades in the Lord's Name; He alone is the true banker, the true trader. ||2||4||

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bairaaRee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har nira(n)jan nira(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O mind, on the immaculate, formless Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaieeaai sukhadhaataa jaa kaa a(n)t na paaraavaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace; He has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਦਰ ਮੰਝਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: agan ku(n)T meh uradh liv laagaa har raakhai udhar ma(n)jhaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the fiery pit of the womb, when you were hanging upside-down, the Lord absorbed You in His Love, and preserved You.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har sevahu mere man har a(n)t chhaddaavanahaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: So serve such a Lord, O my mind; the Lord shall deliver you in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai hiradhai basiaa meraa har har tis jan kau karahu namasakaaraa ||
verses.translation: Bow down in reverence to that humble being, within whose heart the Lord, Har, Har, abides.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te paieeaai har jap naanak naam adhaaraa ||2||5||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Kind Mercy, O Nanak, one obtains the Lord's meditation, and the support of the Naam. ||2||5||

verses.original: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: bairaaRee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har har naam nit dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; meditate on it continually.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichheh soiee fal paaveh fir dhookh na laagai aai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain the fruits of your heart's desires, and pain shall never touch you again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਪੁ ਸੋ ਤਪੁ ਸਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so jap so tap saa brat poojaa jit har siau preet lagai ||
verses.translation: That is chanting, that is deep meditation and austerity, that is fasting and worship, which inspires love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਭ ਝੂਠੀ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin har preet hor preet sabh jhooThee ik khin meh bisar sabh jai ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Love, every other love is false; in an instant, it is all forgotten. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਲ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: too bea(n)t sarab kal pooraa kichh keemat kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: You are infinite, the Master of all power; Your value cannot be described at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak saran tum(h)aaree har jeeau bhaavai tivai chhaddai ||2||6||
verses.translation: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Dear Lord; as it pleases You, save him. ||2||6||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag bairaaRee mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Bairaaree, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil har jas gaio ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints, sing the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam ke dhookh gavaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The pains of millions of incarnations shall be eradicated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jo chaahat soiee man paio ||
verses.translation: Whatever your mind desires, that you shall obtain.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa har naam dhivaio ||1||
verses.translation: By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blesses us with His Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh har naam vaddaiee ||
verses.translation: All happiness and greatness are in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak mat paiee ||2||1||7||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak has gained this understanding. ||2||1||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag tila(n)g mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Tilang, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਯਕ ਅਰਜ ਗੁਫਤਮ ਪੇਸਿ ਤੋ ਦਰ ਗੋਸ ਕੁਨ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: yak araj gufatam pes to dhar gos kun karataar ||
verses.translation: I offer this one prayer to You; please listen to it, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਹਕਾ ਕਬੀਰ ਕਰੀਮ ਤੂ ਬੇਐਬ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hakaa kabeer kareem too beaaib paravadhagaar ||1||
verses.translation: You are true, great, merciful and spotless, O Cherisher Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ਫਾਨੀ ਤਹਕੀਕ ਦਿਲ ਦਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa mukaame faanee tahakeek dhil dhaanee ||
verses.translation: The world is a transitory place of mortality - know this for certain in your mind.

verses.original: ਮਮ ਸਰ ਮੂਇ ਅਜਰਾਈਲ ਗਿਰਫਤਹ ਦਿਲ ਹੇਚਿ ਨ ਦਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mam sar mooi ajaraieel girafateh dhil hech na dhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, has caught me by the hair on my head, and yet, I do not know it at all in my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਪਿਸਰ ਪਦਰ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾਂ ਕਸ ਨੇਸ ਦਸਤੰਗੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jan pisar padhar biraadharaa(n) kas nes dhasata(n)geer ||
verses.translation: Spouse, children, parents and siblings - none of them will be there to hold your hand.

verses.original: ਆਖਿਰ ਬਿਅਫਤਮ ਕਸ ਨ ਦਾਰਦ ਚੂੰ ਸਵਦ ਤਕਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aakhir biafatam kas na dhaaradh choo(n) savadh takabeer ||2||
verses.translation: And when at last I fall, and the time of my last prayer has come, there shall be no one to rescue me. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਬ ਰੋਜ ਗਸਤਮ ਦਰ ਹਵਾ ਕਰਦੇਮ ਬਦੀ ਖਿਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: sab roj gasatam dhar havaa karadhem badhee khiaal ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I wandered around in greed, contemplating evil schemes.

verses.original: ਗਾਹੇ ਨ ਨੇਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਮ ਮਮ ੲਂੀ ਚਿਨੀ ਅਹਵਾਲ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gaahe na nekee kaar karadham mam e(n)ee chinee ahavaal ||3||
verses.translation: I never did good deeds; this is my condition. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਦਬਖਤ ਹਮ ਚੁ ਬਖੀਲ ਗਾਫਿਲ ਬੇਨਜਰ ਬੇਬਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: badhabakhat ham ch bakheel gaafil benajar bebaak ||
verses.translation: I am unfortunate, miserly, negligent, shameless and without the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੁਗੋਯਦ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਾਕਰਾਂ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bugoyadh jan turaa tere chaakaraa(n) paa khaak ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am Your humble servant, the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Tilang, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਂਗ ਖਲੜੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhau teraa bhaa(n)g khalaRee meraa cheet ||
verses.translation: The Fear of You, O Lord God, is my marijuana; my consciousness is the pouch which holds it.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਦੇਵਾਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਅਤੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai dhevaanaa bhiaa ateet ||
verses.translation: I have become an intoxicated hermit.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਕਾਸਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: kar kaasaa dharasan kee bhookh ||
verses.translation: My hands are my begging bowl; I am so hungry for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai dhar maagau neetaa neet ||1||
verses.translation: I beg at Your Door, day after day. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਉ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tau dharasan kee karau samai ||
verses.translation: I long for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਗਤੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai dhar maagat bheekhiaa pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a beggar at Your Door - please bless me with Your charity. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੇਸਰਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਮਿਰਗਮੈ ਹਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਸਰੀਰੀ ਚੜੑਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kesar kusam miragamai haranaa sarab sareeree chaR(h)naa ||
verses.translation: Saffron, flowers, musk oil and gold embellish the bodies of all.

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਇਨੇਹੀ ਸਰਬੇ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan bhagataa jot inehee sarabe paramal karanaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees are like sandalwood, which imparts its fragrance to everyone. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਿਅ ਪਟ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghia paT bhaa(n)ddaa kahai na koi ||
verses.translation: No one says that ghee or silk are polluted.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਰਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa bhagat varan meh hoi ||
verses.translation: Such is the Lord's devotee, no matter what his social status is.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵੇ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: terai naam nive rahe liv lai ||
verses.translation: Those who bow in reverence to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, remain absorbed in Your Love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tin dhar bheekhiaa pai ||3||1||2||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for charity at their door. ||3||1||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Tilang, First Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਲੀਤੜਾ ਲਬਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan maiaa paahiaa piaare leetaRaa lab ra(n)gaae ||
verses.translation: This body fabric is conditioned by Maya, O beloved; this cloth is dyed in greed.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਧਨ ਸੇਜੈ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: merai ka(n)t na bhaavai cholaRaa piaare kiau dhan sejai jaae ||1||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord is not pleased by these clothes, O Beloved; how can the soul-bride go to His bed? ||1||

verses.original: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)au kurabaanai jaau miharavaanaa ha(n)au kurabaanai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, O Dear Merciful Lord; I am a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਹੰਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)au kurabaanai jaau tinaa kai lain jo teraa naau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who take to Your Name.

verses.original: ਲੈਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lain jo teraa naau tinaa kai ha(n)au sadh kurabaanai jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Unto those who take to Your Name, I am forever a sacrifice. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੰਙਣਿ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ra(n)n(g)n je theeaai piaare paieeaai naau majeeTh ||
verses.translation: If the body becomes the dyer's vat, O Beloved, and the Name is placed within it as the dye,

verses.original: ਰੰਙਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜੇ ਰੰਙੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਐਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਡੀਠ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ra(n)n(g)n vaalaa je ra(n)n(g)ai saahib aaisaa ra(n)g na ddeeTh ||2||
verses.translation: and if the Dyer who dyes this cloth is the Lord Master - O, such a color has never been seen before! ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚੋਲੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin ke chole rataRe piaare ka(n)t tinaa kai paas ||
verses.translation: Those whose shawls are so dyed, O Beloved, their Husband Lord is always with them.

verses.original: ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhooR tinaa kee je milai jee kahu naanak kee aradhaas ||3||
verses.translation: Bless me with the dust of those humble beings, O Dear Lord. Says Nanak, this is my prayer. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape saaje aape ra(n)ge aape nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, and He Himself imbues us. He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਵੇਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman ka(n)tai bhaavai aape hee raavei ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if the soul-bride becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord, He Himself enjoys her. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਆਨੜੀਏ ਮਾਨੜਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eiaanaRe'e maanaRaa kai kareh ||
verses.translation: O foolish and ignorant soul-bride, why are you so proud?

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਕੀ ਨ ਮਾਣੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaRai ghar har ra(n)go kee na maaneh ||
verses.translation: Within the home of your own self, why do you not enjoy the Love of your Lord?

verses.original: ਸਹੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਮਲੀਏ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahu neRai dhan ka(n)male'ee baahar kiaa ddooddeh ||
verses.translation: Your Husband Lord is so very near, O foolish bride; why do you search for Him outside?

verses.original: ਭੈ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਲਾਈਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhai keeaa dheh salaieeaa nainee bhaav kaa kar seegaaro ||
verses.translation: Apply the Fear of God as the maascara to adorn your eyes, and make the Love of the Lord your ornament.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa sohaagan jaaneeaai laagee jaa sahu dhare piaaro ||1||
verses.translation: Then, you shall be known as a devoted and committed soul-bride, when you enshrine love for your Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਆਣੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eiaanee baalee kiaa kare jaa dhan ka(n)t na bhaavai ||
verses.translation: What can the silly young bride do, if she is not pleasing to her Husband Lord?

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: karan palaeh kare bahutere saa dhan mahal na paavai ||
verses.translation: She may plead and implore so many times, but still, such a bride shall not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: vin karamaa kichh paieeaai naahee je bahuteraa dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Without the karma of good deeds, nothing is obtained, although she may run around frantically.

verses.original: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh aha(n)kaar kee maatee maiaa maeh samaanee ||
verses.translation: She is intoxicated with greed, pride and egotism, and engrossed in Maya.

verses.original: ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: einee baatee sahu paieeaai naahee bhiee kaaman iaanee ||2||
verses.translation: She cannot obtain her Husband Lord in these ways; the young bride is so foolish! ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਾਹੈ ਕਿਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jai puchhahu sohaaganee vaahai kinee baatee sahu paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Go and ask the happy, pure soul-brides, how did they obtain their Husband Lord?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare so bhalaa kar maaneeaai hikamat hukam chukaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does, accept that as good; do away with your own cleverness and self-will.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਉ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai prem padhaarath paieeaai tau charanee chit laieeaai ||
verses.translation: By His Love, true wealth is obtained; link your consciousness to His lotus feet.

verses.original: ਸਹੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਐਸਾ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sahu kahai so keejai tan mano dheejai aaisaa paramal laieeaai ||
verses.translation: As your Husband Lord directs, so you must act; surrender your body and mind to Him, and apply this perfume to yourself.

verses.original: ਏਵ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈਣੇ ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ev kaheh sohaaganee bhaine inee baatee sahu paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: So speaks the happy soul-bride, O sister; in this way, the Husband Lord is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap gavaieeaai taa sahu paieeaai aaur kaisee chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: Give up your selfhood, and so obtain your Husband Lord; what other clever tricks are of any use?

verses.original: ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sahu nadhar kar dhekhai so dhin lekhai kaaman nau nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: When the Husband Lord looks upon the soul-bride with His Gracious Glance, that day is historic - the bride obtains the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapane ka(n)t piaaree saa sohaagan naanak saa sabharaiee ||
verses.translation: She who is loved by her Husband Lord, is the true soul-bride; O Nanak, she is the queen of all.

verses.original: ਐਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਇ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisai ra(n)g raatee sahaj kee maatee ahinis bhai samaanee ||
verses.translation: Thus she is imbued with His Love, intoxicated with delight; day and night, she is absorbed in His Love.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sai saroop bichakhan kaheeaai saa siaanee ||4||2||4||
verses.translation: She is beautiful, glorious and brilliant; she is known as truly wise. ||4||2||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੈਸੜਾ ਕਰੀ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee mai aavai khasam kee baanee taisaRaa karee giaan ve laalo ||
verses.translation: As the Word of the Forgiving Lord comes to me, so do I express it, O Lalo.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਕੀ ਜੰਞ ਲੈ ਕਾਬਲਹੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਜੋਰੀ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: paap kee ja(n)n(j) lai kaabalahu dhaiaa joree ma(n)gai dhaan ve laalo ||
verses.translation: Bringing the marriage party of sin, Babar has invaded from Kaabul, demanding our land as his wedding gift, O Lalo.

verses.original: ਸਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਇ ਛਪਿ ਖਲੋਏ ਕੂੜੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: saram dharam dhui chhap khaloe kooR firai paradhaan ve laalo ||
verses.translation: Modesty and righteousness both have vanished, and falsehood struts around like a leader, O Lalo.

verses.original: ਕਾਜੀਆ ਬਾਮਣਾ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਥਕੀ ਅਗਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: kaajeeaa baamanaa kee gal thakee agadh paRai saitaan ve laalo ||
verses.translation: The Qazis and the Brahmins have lost their roles, and Satan now conducts the marriage rites, O Lalo.

verses.original: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੀਆ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਕਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: musalamaaneeaa paReh katebaa kasaT meh kareh khudhai ve laalo ||
verses.translation: The Muslim women read the Koran, and in their misery, they call upon God, O Lalo.

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਸਨਾਤੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਹਿਦਵਾਣੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਭੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaat sanaatee hor hidhavaaneeaa eh bhee lekhai lai ve laalo ||
verses.translation: The Hindu women of high social status, and others of lowly status as well, are put into the same category, O Lalo.

verses.original: ਖੂਨ ਕੇ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤੁ ਕਾ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਪਾਇ ਵੇ ਲਾਲੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: khoon ke sohile gaave'eeh naanak rat kaa ku(n)goo pai ve laalo ||1||
verses.translation: The wedding songs of murder are sung, O Nanak, and blood is sprinkled instead of saffron, O Lalo. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਸ ਪੁਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਖੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: saahib ke gun naanak gaavai maas puree vich aakh masolaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord and Master in the city of corpses, and voices this account.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਈ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਖਿ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin upaiee ra(n)g ravaiee baiThaa vekhai vakh ikelaa ||
verses.translation: The One who created, and attached the mortals to pleasures, sits alone, and watches this.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਮਸੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa so saahib sach tapaavas sachaRaa niaau kareg masolaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord and Master is True, and True is His justice. He issues His Commands according to His judgement.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਟੁਕੁ ਹੋਸੀ ਹਿਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਲਸੀ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kapaR Tuk Tuk hosee hidhusataan samaalasee bolaa ||
verses.translation: The body-fabric will be torn apart into shreds, and then India will remember these words.

verses.original: ਆਵਨਿ ਅਠਤਰੈ ਜਾਨਿ ਸਤਾਨਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਭੀ ਉਠਸੀ ਮਰਦ ਕਾ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aavan aThatarai jaan sataanavai hor bhee uThasee maradh kaa chelaa ||
verses.translation: Coming in seventy-eight (1521 A.D.), they will depart in ninety-seven (1540 A.D.), and then another disciple of man will rise up.

verses.original: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: sach kee baanee naanak aakhai sach sunaisee sach kee belaa ||2||3||5||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the Word of Truth; he proclaims the Truth at this, the right time. ||2||3||5||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Tilang, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਆਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਖਸਮਾਹੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਭ ਵਰਤਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aae hukam khasamaahu hukam sabh varatanee ||
verses.translation: Everyone comes by Command of the Lord and Master. The Hukam of His Command extends to all.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach saahib saachaa khel sabh har dhanee ||1||
verses.translation: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His play. The Lord is the Master of all. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: saalaahih sach sabh uoopar har dhanee ||
verses.translation: So praise the True Lord; the Lord is the Master over all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਹਉ ਗਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis naahee koi sareek kis lekhai hau ganee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: No one is equal to Him; am I of any account? ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਕਾਸੁ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee dharatee aakaas ghar ma(n)dhar har banee ||
verses.translation: Air, water, earth and sky - the Lord has made these His home and temple.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: vich varatai naanak aap jhooTh kahu kiaa ganee ||2||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Nanak. Tell me: what can be counted as false? ||2||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਬਫਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਮਤੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit nihafal karam kamai bafaavai dhuramateeaa ||
verses.translation: The evil-minded person continually does fruitless deeds, all puffed up with pride.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਆਣੈ ਵਲਵੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਬ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jab aanai valava(n)ch kar jhooTh tab jaanai jag jiteeaa ||1||
verses.translation: When he brings home what he has acquired, by practicing deception and falsehood, he thinks that he has conquered the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa baajee saisaar na chetai har naamaa ||
verses.translation: Such is the drama of the world, that he does not contemplate the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਰਾਮਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh binasai sabh jhooTh mere man dhiaai raamaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In an instant, all this false play shall perish; O my mind, meditate on the Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਇ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: saa velaa chit na aavai jit aai ka(n)Tak kaal grasai ||
verses.translation: He does not think of that time, when Death, the Torturer, shall come and seize him.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis naanak le chhaddai jis kirapaa kar hiradhai vasai ||2||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord saves that one, within whose heart the Lord, in His Kind Mercy, dwells. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Tilang, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਖਾਕ ਨੂਰ ਕਰਦੰ ਆਲਮ ਦੁਨੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: khaak noor karadha(n) aalam dhuneeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord infused His Light into the dust, and created the world, the universe.

verses.original: ਅਸਮਾਨ ਜਿਮੀ ਦਰਖਤ ਆਬ ਪੈਦਾਇਸਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: asamaan jimee dharakhat aab paidhais khudhai ||1||
verses.translation: The sky, the earth, the trees, and the water - all are the Creation of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੰਦੇ ਚਸਮ ਦੀਦੰ ਫਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhe chasam dheedha(n) fanai ||
verses.translation: O human being, whatever you can see with your eyes, shall perish.

verses.original: ਦੁਨਂੀਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਖੁਰਦਨੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਹਵਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhuna(n)eeaa muradhaar khuradhanee gaafal havai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The world eats dead carcasses, living by neglect and greed. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੈਬਾਨ ਹੈਵਾਨ ਹਰਾਮ ਕੁਸਤਨੀ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਬਖੋਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gaibaan haivaan haraam kusatanee muradhaar bakhorai ||
verses.translation: Like a goblin, or a beast, they kill and eat the forbidden carcasses of meat.

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਕਬਜ ਕਬਜਾ ਕਾਦਰੋ ਦੋਜਕ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhil kabaj kabajaa kaadharo dhojak sajai ||2||
verses.translation: So control your urges, or else you will be seized by the Lord, and thrown into the tortures of hell. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਲੀ ਨਿਆਮਤਿ ਬਿਰਾਦਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰ ਮਿਲਕ ਖਾਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: valee niaamat biraadharaa dharabaar milak khaanai ||
verses.translation: Your benefactors, presents, companions, courts, lands and homes

verses.original: ਜਬ ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਬਸਤਨੀ ਤਬ ਚਿ ਕਾਰੇ ਬਿਦਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jab ajaraieel basatanee tab ch kaare bidhai ||3||
verses.translation: - when Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death seizes you, what good will these be to you then? ||3||

verses.original: ਹਵਾਲ ਮਾਲੂਮੁ ਕਰਦੰ ਪਾਕ ਅਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: havaal maaloom karadha(n) paak alaeh ||
verses.translation: The Pure Lord God knows your condition.

verses.original: ਬੁਗੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪੇਸਿ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਬੰਦਾਹ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: bugo naanak aradhaas pes dharaves ba(n)dhaeh ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, recite your prayer to the holy people. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g ghar doojaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Second House, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: There is no other than You, Lord.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: too karataar kareh so hoi ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator; whatever You do, that alone happens.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: teraa jor teree man Tek ||
verses.translation: You are the strength, and You are the support of the mind.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa jap naanak ek ||1||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, meditate, O Nanak, on the One. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh uoopar paarabraham dhaataar ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver is the Supreme Lord God over all.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teree Tek teraa aadhaar || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are our support, You are our sustainer. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰ ॥ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਊਚ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hai toohai too hovanahaar || agam agaadh uooch aapaar ||
verses.translation: You are, You are, and You shall ever be, O inaccessible, unfathomable, lofty and infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh seveh tin bhau dhukh naeh ||
verses.translation: Those who serve You, are not touched by fear or suffering.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh naanak gun gaeh ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so teraa roop || gun nidhaan govi(n)dh anoop ||
verses.translation: Whatever is seen, is Your form, O treasure of virtue, O Lord of the Universe, O Lord of incomparable beauty.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar jan soi ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, His humble servant becomes like Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak karam paraapat hoi ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, we obtain Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin japiaa tis kau balihaar ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tis kai sa(n)g tarai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Associating with them, the whole world is saved.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh lochaa poor ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, God fulfills our hopes and aspirations.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee baachhau dhoor ||4||2||
verses.translation: I long for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: miharavaan saahib miharavaan ||
verses.translation: Merciful, the Lord Master is Merciful.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahib meraa miharavaan ||
verses.translation: My Lord Master is Merciful.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਨੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeea sagal kau dhei dhaan || rahaau ||
verses.translation: He gives His gifts to all beings. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਾਹੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖੈਗਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too kaahe ddoleh praaneeaa tudh raakhaigaa sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: Why do you waver, O mortal being? The Creator Lord Himself shall protect you.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਦਾਇਸਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin paidhais too keeaa soiee dhei aadhaar ||1||
verses.translation: He who created you, will also give you nourishment. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin upaiee medhanee soiee karadhaa saar ||
verses.translation: The One who created the world, takes care of it.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਲਕੁ ਦਿਲਾ ਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT maalak dhilaa kaa sachaa paravadhagaar ||2||
verses.translation: In each and every heart and mind, the Lord is the True Cherisher. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai vaddaa veparavaahu ||
verses.translation: His creative potency and His value cannot be known; He is the Great and carefree Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦੇ ਤੂ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar ba(n)dhe too ba(n)dhagee jichar ghaT meh saahu ||3||
verses.translation: O human being, meditate on the Lord, as long as there is breath in your body. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਕਥੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: too samarath akath agochar jeeau pi(n)dd teree raas ||
verses.translation: O God, You are all-powerful, inexpressible and imperceptible; my soul and body are Your capital.

verses.original: ਰਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: raham teree sukh paiaa sadhaa naanak kee aradhaas ||4||3||
verses.translation: By Your Mercy, may I find peace; this is Nanak's lasting prayer. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: karate kudharatee musataak ||
verses.translation: O Creator, through Your creative potency, I am in love with You.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਕੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhuneeaa ek toohee sabh khalak hee te paak || rahaau ||
verses.translation: You alone are my spiritual and temporal Lord; and yet, You are detached from all Your creation. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਆਚਰਜ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: khin maeh thaap uthaapadhaa aacharaj tere roop ||
verses.translation: In an instant, You establish and disestablish. Wondrous is Your form!

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਚਲਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaun jaanai chalat tere a(n)dhiaare meh dheep ||1||
verses.translation: Who can know Your play? You are the Light in the darkness. ||1||

verses.original: ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮ ਖਲਕ ਜਹਾਨ ਅਲਹ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khudh khasam khalak jahaan aleh miharavaan khudhai ||
verses.translation: You are the Master of Your creation, the Lord of all the world, O Merciful Lord God.

verses.original: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhinas rain j tudh araadhe so kiau dhojak jai ||2||
verses.translation: One who worships You day and night - why should he have to go to hell? ||2||

verses.original: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਯਾਰੁ ਬੰਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: ajaraieel yaar ba(n)dhe jis teraa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Azraa-eel, the Messenger of Death, is the friend of the human being who has Your support, Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਨਹ ਉਸ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਆਫੂ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਦੀਦਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: guneh us ke sagal aafoo tere jan dhekheh dheedhaar ||3||
verses.translation: His sins are all forgiven; Your humble servant gazes upon Your Vision. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਚੀਜ ਫਿਲਹਾਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa cheej filahaal sagale sach sukh teraa naau ||
verses.translation: All worldly considerations are for the present only. True peace comes only from Your Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਏਕਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur mil naanak boojhiaa sadhaa ekas gaau ||4||4||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, Nanak understands; He sings only Your Praises forever, O Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੀਰਾਂ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਦਿਲ ਸੋਚ ॥
verses.translit: meeraa(n) dhaanaa(n) dhil soch ||
verses.translation: Think of the Lord in your mind, O wise one.

verses.original: ਮੁਹਬਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹ ਬੰਦੀ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: muhabate man tan basai sach saeh ba(n)dhee moch ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Enshrine love for the True Lord in your mind and body; He is the Liberator from bondage. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੀਦਨੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheedhane dheedhaar saahib kachh nahee is kaa mol ||
verses.translation: The value of seeing the Vision of the Lord Master cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਪਾਕ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰ ਤੂ ਖੁਦਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paak paravadhagaar too khudh khasam vaddaa atol ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Pure Cherisher; You Yourself are the great and immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਸ੍ਤਗੀਰੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਲਾਵਰ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: dhastageeree dheh dhilaavar toohee toohee ek ||
verses.translation: Give me Your help, O brave and generous Lord; You are the One, You are the Only Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਣ ਖਾਲਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: karataar kudharat karan khaalak naanak teree Tek ||2||5||
verses.translation: O Creator Lord, by Your creative potency, You created the world; Nanak holds tight to Your support. ||2||5||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Tilang, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa kiaa kaheeaai re bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The One who created the world watches over it; what more can we say, O Siblings of Destiny?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape jaanai kare aap jin vaaRee hai laiee ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself knows, and He Himself acts; He laid out the garden of the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਇਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਾ ਰਾਇਸਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raisaa piaare kaa raisaa jit sadhaa sukh hoiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Savor the story, the story of the Beloved Lord, which brings a lasting peace. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸਾ ਪਛੋ ਰੇ ਤਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin ra(n)g ka(n)t na raaviaa saa pachho re taanee ||
verses.translation: She who does not enjoy the Love of her Husband Lord, shall come to regret and repent in the end.

verses.original: ਹਾਥ ਪਛੋੜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਧੁਣੈ ਜਬ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: haath pachhoRai sir dhunai jab rain vihaanee ||2||
verses.translation: She wrings her hands, and bangs her head, when the night of her life has passed away. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਛੋਤਾਵਾ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈਗੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pachhotaavaa naa milai jab chookaigee saaree ||
verses.translation: Nothing comes from repentance, when the game is already finished.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜਬ ਆਵੈਗੀ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa fir piaaraa raaveeaai jab aavaigee vaaree ||3||
verses.translation: She shall have the opportunity to enjoy her Beloved, only when her turn comes again. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੰਤੁ ਲੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਵਧਵੀ ਏਹ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)t leeaa sohaaganee mai te vadhavee eh ||
verses.translation: The happy soul-bride attains her Husband Lord - she is so much better than I am.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੁਝੈ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇਹ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: se gun mujhai na aavanee kai jee dhos dhareh ||4||
verses.translation: I have none of her merits or virtues; whom should I blame? ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉਗੀ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sakhee sahu raaviaa tin poochhaugee jaae ||
verses.translation: I shall go and ask those sisters who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਲੇਉਗੀ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pai lagau benatee karau leaugee pa(n)th bataae ||5||
verses.translation: I touch their feet, and ask them to show me the Path. ||5||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam pachhaanai naanakaa bhau cha(n)dhan laavai ||
verses.translation: She who understands the Hukam of His Command, O Nanak, applies the Fear of God as her sandalwood oil;

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੈ ਤਉ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gun kaaman kaaman karai tau piaare kau paavai ||6||
verses.translation: she charms her Beloved with her virtue, and so obtains Him. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhil miliaa su mil rahiaa miliaa kaheeaai re soiee ||
verses.translation: She who meets her Beloved in her heart, remains united with Him; this is truly called union.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਬਾਤੀ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: je bahuteraa locheeaai baatee mel na hoiee ||7||
verses.translation: As much as she may long for Him, she shall not meet Him through mere words. ||7||

verses.original: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਿਵੈ ਕਉ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaat milai fun dhaat kau liv livai kau dhaavai ||
verses.translation: As metal melts into metal again, so does love melt into love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤਉ ਅਨਭਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jaaneeaai tau anabhau paavai ||8||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained, and then, one obtains the Fearless Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਪਾਨਾ ਵਾੜੀ ਹੋਇ ਘਰਿ ਖਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: paanaa vaaRee hoi ghar khar saar na jaanai ||
verses.translation: There may be an orchard of betel nut trees in the garden, but the donkey does not appreciate its value.

verses.original: ਰਸੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਸਕ ਕਾ ਤਬ ਫੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: raseeaa hovai musak kaa tab fool pachhaanai ||9||
verses.translation: If someone savors a fragrance, then he can truly appreciate its flower. ||9||

verses.original: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਵੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: apiau peevai jo naanakaa bhram bhram samaavai ||
verses.translation: One who drinks in the ambrosia, O Nanak, abandons his doubts and wanderings.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaje sahaje mil rahai amaraa padh paavai ||10||1||
verses.translation: Easily and intuitively, he remains blended with the Lord, and obtains the immortal status. ||10||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: har keeaa kathaa kahaaneeaa gur meet sunaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru, my friend, has told me the stories and the sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane gur kau bal jaieeaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; to the Guru, I am a sacrifice. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aai mil gursikh aai mil too mere guroo ke piaare || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Come, join with me, O Sikh of the Guru, come and join with me. You are my Guru's Beloved. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ke gun har bhaavadhe se guroo te paae ||
verses.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are pleasing to the Lord; I have obtained them from the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin gur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa tin ghum ghum jaae ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who surrender to, and obey the Guru's Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin satigur piaaraa dhekhiaa tin kau hau vaaree ||
verses.translation: I am dedicated and devoted to those who gaze upon the Beloved True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin gur kee keetee chaakaree tin sadh balihaaree ||3||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who perform service for the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har teraa naam hai dhukh meTanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har, is the Destroyer of sorrow.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te paieeaai gurmukh nisataaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, it is obtained, and as Gurmukh, one is emancipated. ||4||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo har naam dhiaaidhe te jan paravaanaa ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name, are celebrated and acclaimed.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tin viTahu naanak vaariaa sadhaa sadhaa kurabaanaa ||5||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to them, forever and ever a devoted sacrifice. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saa har teree usatat hai jo har prabh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, that alone is Praise to You, which is pleasing to Your Will, O Lord God.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jo gurmukh piaaraa sevadhe tin har fal paavai ||6||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs, who serve their Beloved Lord, obtain Him as their reward. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jinaa har setee pirahaRee tinaa jeea prabh naale ||
verses.translation: Those who cherish love for the Lord, their souls are always with God.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: oi jap jap piaaraa jeevadhe har naam samaale ||7||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on their Beloved, they live in, and gather in, the Lord's Name. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਘੁਮਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh piaaraa seviaa tin kau ghum jaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who serve their Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਿਉ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: oi aap chhuTe paravaar siau sabh jagat chhaddaiaa ||8||
verses.translation: They themselves are saved, along with their families, and through them, all the world is saved. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: gur piaarai har seviaa gur dha(n)n gur dha(n)no ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Guru serves the Lord. Blessed is the Guru, Blessed is the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੋ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: gur har maarag dhasiaa gur pu(n)n vadd pu(n)no ||9||
verses.translation: The Guru has shown me the Lord's Path; the Guru has done the greatest good deed. ||9||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਸੇ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਰਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jo gursikh gur sevadhe se pu(n)n paraanee ||
verses.translation: Those Sikhs of the Guru, who serve the Guru, are the most blessed beings.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tin kau vaariaa sadhaa sadhaa kurabaanee ||10||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them; He is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||10||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ਸੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sakhee saheleeaa se aap har bhaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is pleased with the Gurmukhs, the fellowship of the companions.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: har dharageh painaieeaa har aap gal laieeaa ||11||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Court, they are given robes of honor, and the Lord Himself hugs them close in His embrace. ||11||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo gurmukh naam dhiaaidhe tin dharasan dheejai ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of those Gurmukhs, who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਲਦੇ ਧੂੜਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: ham tin ke charan pakhaaladhe dhooR ghol ghol peejai ||12||
verses.translation: I wash their feet, and drink in the dust of their feet, dissolved in the wash water. ||12||

verses.original: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਤੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੀੜੀਆ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: paan supaaree khaateeaa mukh beeReeaa laieeaa ||
verses.translation: Those who eat betel nuts and betel leaf and smoke intoxicants,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਈਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: har har kadhe na chetio jam pakaR chalaieeaa ||13||
verses.translation: but do not contemplate the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death will seize them and take them away. ||13||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jin har naamaa har chetiaa hiradhai ur dhaare || tin jam neR na aaviee gursikh gur piaare ||14||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and keep Him enshrined in their hearts. The Guru's Sikhs are the Guru's Beloveds. ||14||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam nidhaan hai koiee gurmukh jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is a treasure, known only to the few Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jin satigur bheTiaa ra(n)g raleeaa maanai ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who meet with the True Guru, enjoy peace and pleasure. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੁਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਸਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa aakheeaai tus kare pasaao ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is called the Giver; in His Mercy, He grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤੜਾ ਨਾਓ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: hau gur viTahu sadh vaariaa jin dhitaRaa naao ||16||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has blessed me with the Lord's Name. ||16||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: so dha(n)n guroo saabaas hai har dhei sanehaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, very blessed is the Guru, who brings the Lord's message.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: hau vekh vekh guroo vigasiaa gur satigur dhehaa ||17||
verses.translation: I gaze upon the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru embodied, and I blossom forth in bliss. ||17||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur rasanaa a(n)mrit boladhee har naam suhaavee ||
verses.translation: The Guru's tongue recites Words of Ambrosial Nectar; He is adorned with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਵੀ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: jin sun sikhaa gur ma(n)niaa tinaa bhukh sabh jaavee ||18||
verses.translation: Those Sikhs who hear and obey the Guru - all their desires depart. ||18||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa maarag aakheeaai kahu kit bidh jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Some speak of the Lord's Path; tell me, how can I walk on it?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: har har teraa naam hai har kharach lai jaieeaai ||19||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, Your Name is my supplies; I will take it with me and set out. ||19||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਾਹ ਵਡ ਦਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh har aaraadhiaa se saeh vadd dhaane ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord, are wealthy and very wise.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: hau satigur kau sadh vaariaa gur bachan samaane ||20||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru; I am absorbed in the Words of the Guru's Teachings. ||20||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too Thaakur too saahibo toohai meraa meeraa ||
verses.translation: You are the Master, my Lord and Master; You are my Ruler and King.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਤੂ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai teree ba(n)dhagee too gunee gaheeraa ||21||
verses.translation: If it is pleasing to Your Will, then I worship and serve You; You are the treasure of virtue. ||21||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape har ik ra(n)g hai aape bahu ra(n)gee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is absolute; He is The One and Only; but He Himself is also manifested in many forms.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਗਲ ਚੰਗੀ ॥੨੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saiee gal cha(n)gee ||22||2||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak, that alone is good. ||22||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ਕਾਫੀ
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa nauvaa kaafee
verses.translation: Tilang, Ninth Mehla, Kaafee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਚੇਤਨਾ ਹੈ ਤਉ ਚੇਤ ਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨਿ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: chetanaa hai tau chet lai nis dhin mai praanee ||
verses.translation: If you are conscious, then be conscious of Him night and day, O mortal.

verses.original: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਫੂਟੈ ਘਟ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhin chhin aaudh bihaat hai fooTai ghaT jiau paanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, your life is passing away, like water from a cracked pitcher. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਾਵਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har gun kaeh na gaavahee moorakh agiaanaa ||
verses.translation: Why do you not sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you ignorant fool?

verses.original: ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਕੈ ਨਹਿ ਮਰਨੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhooThai laalach laag kai neh maran pachhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: You are attached to false greed, and you do not even consider death. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਜਹੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ajahoo kachh bigario nahee jo prabh gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Even now, no harm has been done, if you will only sing God's Praises.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਭਜਨ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak teh bhajan te nirabhai padh paavai ||2||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, by meditating and vibrating upon Him, you shall obtain the state of fearlessness. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜਾਗ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਗਾਫਲ ਸੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaag leh re manaa jaag leh kahaa gaafal soiaa ||
verses.translation: Wake up, O mind! Wake up! Why are you sleeping unaware?

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo tan upajiaa sa(n)g hee so bhee sa(n)g na hoiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: That body, which you were born with, shall not go along with you in the end. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧ ਜਨ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut ba(n)dh jan hit jaa siau keenaa ||
verses.translation: Mother, father, children and relatives whom you love,

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਜਬ ਦੇਹ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeeau chhooTio jab dheh te ddaar agan mai dheenaa ||1||
verses.translation: will throw your body into the fire, when your soul departs from it. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਲਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਗ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat lau biauhaar hai jag kau tum jaanau ||
verses.translation: Your worldly affairs exist only as long as you are alive; know this well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਲੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਫਨ ਸਮਾਨਉ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har gun gai lai sabh sufan samaanau ||2||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; everything is like a dream. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: tila(n)g mahalaa nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Tilang, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਗਾਇ ਲੈ ਜੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: har jas re manaa gai lai jo sa(n)gee hai tero ||
verses.translation: Sing the Lord's Praises, O mind; He is your only true companion.

verses.original: ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤਿਓ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aausar beetio jaat hai kahio maan lai mero ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your time is passing away; listen carefully to what I say. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਥ ਧਨ ਰਾਜ ਸਿਉ ਅਤਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pat rath dhan raaj siau at neh lagaio ||
verses.translation: You are so in love with property, chariots, wealth and power.

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਫਾਸ ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaal faas jab gal paree sabh bhio paraio ||1||
verses.translation: When the noose of death tightens around your neck, they will all belong to others. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝ ਕੈ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਬਿਗਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: jaan boojh kai baavare tai kaaj bigaario ||
verses.translation: Know this well, O madman - you have ruined your affairs.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਕਚਿਓ ਨਹੀ ਨਹ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paap karat sukachio nahee neh garab nivaario ||2||
verses.translation: You did not restrain yourself from committing sins, and you did not eradicate your ego. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਸੋ ਸੁਨੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh bidh gur upadhesiaa so sun re bhaiee ||
verses.translation: So listen to the Teachings imparted by the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਗਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kahat pukaar kai gahu prabh saranaiee ||3||3||
verses.translation: Nanak proclaims: hold tight to the Protection and the Sanctuary of God. ||3||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ
verses.translit: tila(n)g baanee bhagataa kee kabeer jee
verses.translation: Tilang, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਇਫਤਰਾ ਭਾਈ ਦਿਲ ਕਾ ਫਿਕਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bedh kateb ifataraa bhaiee dhil kaa fikar na jai ||
verses.translation: The Vedas and the Scriptures are only make-believe, O Siblings of Destiny; they do not relieve the anxiety of the heart.

verses.original: ਟੁਕੁ ਦਮੁ ਕਰਾਰੀ ਜਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਾਜਿਰ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: Tuk dham karaaree jau karahu haajir hajoor khudhai ||1||
verses.translation: If you will only center yourself on the Lord, even for just a breath, then you shall see the Lord face-to-face, present before you. ||1||

verses.original: ਬੰਦੇ ਖੋਜੁ ਦਿਲ ਹਰ ਰੋਜ ਨਾ ਫਿਰੁ ਪਰੇਸਾਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhe khoj dhil har roj naa fir paresaanee maeh ||
verses.translation: O human being, search your own heart every day, and do not wander around in confusion.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਜੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਿਹਰੁ ਮੇਲਾ ਦਸਤਗੀਰੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eeh ju dhuneeaa sihar melaa dhasatageeree naeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This world is just a magic-show; no one will be holding your hand. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰੋਗੁ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਖੁਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਖਬਰ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਕਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dharog paR paR khusee hoi bekhabar baadh bakaeh ||
verses.translation: Reading and studying falsehood, people are happy; in their ignorance, they speak nonsense.

verses.original: ਹਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਮਿਆਨੇ ਸਿਆਮ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hak sach khaalak khalak miaane siaam moorat naeh ||2||
verses.translation: The True Creator Lord is diffused into His creation; He is not just the dark-skinned Krishna of legends. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਸਮਾਨ ਮੵਿਾਨੇ ਲਹੰਗ ਦਰੀਆ ਗੁਸਲ ਕਰਦਨ ਬੂਦ ॥
verses.translit: asamaan miyeaane laha(n)g dhareeaa gusal karadhan boodh ||
verses.translation: Through the Tenth Gate, the stream of nectar flows; take your bath in this.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਫਕਰੁ ਦਾਇਮ ਲਾਇ ਚਸਮੇ ਜਹ ਤਹਾ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar fakar dhaim lai chasame jeh tahaa maujoodh ||3||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord forever; use your eyes, and see Him ever-present everywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਲਾਹ ਪਾਕੰ ਪਾਕ ਹੈ ਸਕ ਕਰਉ ਜੇ ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: alaeh paaka(n) paak hai sak karau je dhoosar hoi ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the purest of the pure; only through doubt could there be another.

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੀਮ ਕਾ ਉਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kabeer karam kareem kaa uh karai jaanai soi ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Kabeer, mercy flows from the Merciful Lord; He alone knows who acts. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: naamadhev jee ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁੰਦਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mai a(n)dhule kee Tek teraa naam khu(n)dhakaaraa ||
verses.translation: I am blind; Your Name, O Creator Lord, is my only anchor and support.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ ਮੈ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai gareeb mai masakeen teraa naam hai adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am poor, and I am meek. Your Name is my only support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰੀਮਾਂ ਰਹੀਮਾਂ ਅਲਾਹ ਤੂ ਗਨਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: kareemaa(n) raheemaa(n) alaeh too gana(n)ee ||
verses.translation: O beautiful Lord, benevolent and merciful Lord, You are so wealthy and generous.

verses.original: ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪੇਸਿ ਤੂੰ ਮਨਂੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haajaraa hajoor dhar pes too(n) mana(n)ee ||1||
verses.translation: You are ever-present in every presence, within and before me. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਰੀਆਉ ਤੂ ਦਿਹੰਦ ਤੂ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ਤੂ ਧਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhareeaau too dhiha(n)dh too biseeaar too dhanee ||
verses.translation: You are the river of life, You are the Giver of all; You are so very wealthy.

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਦਿਗਰ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheh leh ek too(n) dhigar ko nahee ||2||
verses.translation: You alone give, and You alone take away; there is no other at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਬੀਨਾਂ ਮੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaanaa(n) too(n) beenaa(n) mai beechaar kiaa karee ||
verses.translation: You are wise, You are the supreme seer; how could I make You an object of thought?

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਚੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਖਸੰਦ ਤੂੰ ਹਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naame che suaamee bakhasa(n)dh too(n) haree ||3||1||2||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, You are the merciful Lord of forgiveness. ||3||1||2||

verses.original: ਹਲੇ ਯਾਰਾਂ ਹਲੇ ਯਾਰਾਂ ਖੁਸਿਖਬਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: hale yaaraa(n) hale yaaraa(n) khusikhabaree ||
verses.translation: Hello, my friend, hello my friend. Is there any good news?

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਉ ॥
verses.translit: bal bal jaa(n)au hau bal bal jaa(n)au ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, a dedicated and devoted sacrifice, to You.

verses.original: ਨੀਕੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਆਲੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: neekee teree bigaaree aale teraa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Slavery to You is so sublime; Your Name is noble and exalted. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੁਜਾ ਆਮਦ ਕੁਜਾ ਰਫਤੀ ਕੁਜਾ ਮੇ ਰਵੀ ॥
verses.translit: kujaa aamadh kujaa rafatee kujaa me ravee ||
verses.translation: Where did you come from? Where have You been? And where are You going?

verses.original: ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿਕਾ ਨਗਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਬੁਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhavaiaarikaa nagaree raas bugoiee ||1||
verses.translation: Tell me the truth, in the holy city of Dwaarikaa. ||1||

verses.original: ਖੂਬੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਗਰੀ ਮੀਠੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
verses.translit: khoob teree pagaree meeThe tere bol ||
verses.translation: How handsome is your turban! And how sweet is your speech.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿਕਾ ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੇ ਮਗੋਲ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhavaiaarikaa nagaree kaahe ke magol ||2||
verses.translation: Why are there Moghals in the holy city of Dwaarikaa? ||2||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਂੀ ਹਜਾਰ ਆਲਮ ਏਕਲ ਖਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dha(n)ee hajaar aalam ekal khaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: You alone are the Lord of so many thousands of worlds.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਚਿਨੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਂਵਲੇ ਬਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham chinee paatisaeh saa(n)vale baranaa(n) ||3||
verses.translation: You are my Lord King, like the dark-skinned Krishna. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਸਪਤਿ ਗਜਪਤਿ ਨਰਹ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: asapat gajapat nareh nari(n)dh ||
verses.translation: You are the Lord of the sun, Lord Indra and Lord Brahma, the King of men.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਮੀਰ ਮੁਕੰਦ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: naame ke savaiaamee meer muka(n)dh ||4||2||3||
verses.translation: You are the Lord and Master of Naam Dayv, the King, the Liberator of all. ||4||2||3||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧੋਇ ਬੈਸਿ ਧੂਪੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਦੂਧੈ ਕਉ ਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhaa(n)ddaa dhoi bais dhoop dhevahu tau dhoodhai kau jaavahu ||
verses.translation: Wash the vessel, sit down and anoint it with fragrance; then, go out and get the milk.

verses.original: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਰਮ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਜਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoodh karam fun surat samain hoi niraas jamaavahu ||1||
verses.translation: Add the rennet of clear consciousness to the milk of good deeds, and then, free of desire, let it curdle. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਹੁ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: japahu ta eko naamaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar niraafal kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All other actions are fruitless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਈਟੀ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਉ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man ieeTee haath karahu fun netrau needh na aavai ||
verses.translation: Let your mind be the handles, and then churn it, without sleeping.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਬ ਮਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rasanaa naam japahu tab matheeaai in bidh a(n)mrit paavahu ||2||
verses.translation: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord ,with your tongue, then the curd will be churned. In this way, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸੰਪਟੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਭਾਵਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man sa(n)paT jit sat sar naavan bhaavan paatee tirapat kare ||
verses.translation: Wash your mind in the pool of Truth, and let it be the vessel of the Lord; let this be your offering to please Him.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਇਨੑ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poojaa praan sevak je seve in(h) bidh saahib ravat rahai ||3||
verses.translation: That humble servant who dedicates and offers his life, and who serves in this way, remains absorbed in his Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਦੇ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahadhe kaheh kahe keh jaaveh tum sar avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: The speakers speak and speak and speak, and then they depart. There is no other to compare to You.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਜੰਪੈ ਹਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat heen naanak jan ja(n)pai hau saalaahee sachaa soiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak, lacking devotion, humbly prays: may I sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar vasai na baahar jai ||
verses.translation: Deep within the self, the Lord abides; do not go outside looking for Him.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit chhodd kaahe bikh khai ||1||
verses.translation: You have renounced the Ambrosial Nectar - why are you eating poison? ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa giaan japahu man mere ||
verses.translation: Meditate on such spiritual wisdom, O my mind,

verses.original: ਹੋਵਹੁ ਚਾਕਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hovahu chaakar saache kere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and become the slave of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਰਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan sabh koiee ravai ||
verses.translation: Everyone speaks of wisdom and meditation;

verses.original: ਬਾਂਧਨਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: baa(n)dhan baa(n)dhiaa sabh jag bhavai ||2||
verses.translation: but bound in bondage, the whole world is wandering around in confusion. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa kare su chaakar hoi ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Lord is His servant.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa soi ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord is pervading and permeating the water, the land, and the sky. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਚੰਗੇ ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ham nahee cha(n)ge buraa nahee koi ||
verses.translation: I am not good; no one is bad.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak taare soi ||4||1||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, He alone saves us! ||4||1||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਜਲੁ ਕੈਹਾ ਚਿਲਕਣਾ ਘੋਟਿਮ ਕਾਲੜੀ ਮਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aujal kaihaa chilakanaa ghoTim kaalaRee mas ||
verses.translation: Bronze is bright and shiny, but when it is rubbed, its blackness appears.

verses.original: ਧੋਤਿਆ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhotiaa jooTh na utarai je sau dhovaa tis ||1||
verses.translation: Washing it, its impurity is not removed, even if it is washed a hundred times. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਜਣ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: sajan seiee naal mai chaladhiaa naal chala(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: They alone are my friends, who travel along with me;

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai tithai khaRe dhisa(n)n ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and in that place, where the accounts are called for, they appear standing with me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਵੀਆਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: koThe ma(n)ddap maaReeaa paasahu chitaveeaahaa ||
verses.translation: There are houses, mansions and tall buildings, painted on all sides;

verses.original: ਢਠੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਖਣੀਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ddaTheeaa ka(n)m na aavan(h)ee vichahu sakhaneeaahaa ||2||
verses.translation: but they are empty within, and they crumble like useless ruins. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਗਾ ਬਗੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਸੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: bagaa bage kapaRe teerath ma(n)jh vasa(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: The herons in their white feathers dwell in the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆ ਖਾਵਣੇ ਬਗੇ ਨਾ ਕਹੀਅਨਿੑ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ghuT ghuT jeeaa khaavane bage naa kaheeani(h) ||3||
verses.translation: They tear apart and eat the living beings, and so they are not called white. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮੈ ਮੈਜਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: si(n)mal rukh sareer mai maijan dhekh bhula(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: My body is like the simmal tree; seeing me, other people are fooled.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਫਲ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਹੰਨਿੑ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: se fal ka(n)m na aavan(h)ee te gun mai tan ha(n)ni(h) ||4||
verses.translation: Its fruits are useless - just like the qualities of my body. ||4||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ਡੂਗਰ ਵਾਟ ਬਹੁਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhulai bhaar uThaiaa ddoogar vaaT bahut ||
verses.translation: The blind man is carrying such a heavy load, and his journey through the mountains is so long.

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਲੋੜੀ ਨਾ ਲਹਾ ਹਉ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਾ ਕਿਤੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: akhee loRee naa lahaa hau chaR la(n)ghaa kit ||5||
verses.translation: My eyes can see, but I cannot find the Way. How can I climb up and cross over the mountain? ||5||

verses.original: ਚਾਕਰੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaakareeaa cha(n)giaaieeaa avar siaanap kit ||
verses.translation: What good does it do to serve, and be good, and be clever?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam samaal too(n) badhaa chhuTeh jit ||6||1||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be released from bondage. ||6||1||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਬੇੜੁਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਵਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap kaa ba(n)dh beRulaa jit la(n)gheh vahelaa ||
verses.translation: Build the raft of meditation and self-discipline, to carry you across the river.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਨਾ ਊਛਲੈ ਐਸਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa saravar naa uoochhalai aaisaa pa(n)th suhelaa ||1||
verses.translation: There will be no ocean, and no rising tides to stop you; this is how comfortable your path shall be. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਜੀਠੜਾ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਸਦ ਰੰਗ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa eko naam ma(n)jeeThaRaa rataa meraa cholaa sadh ra(n)g ddolaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Name alone is the color, in which the robe of my body is dyed. This color is permanent, O my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਚਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saajan chale piaariaa kiau melaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: My beloved friends have departed; how will they meet the Lord?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੰਠੜੀਐ ਮੇਲੇਗਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je gun hoveh ga(n)ThaReeaai melegaa soiee ||2||
verses.translation: If they have virtue in their pack, the Lord will unite them with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: miliaa hoi na veechhuRai je miliaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: Once united with Him, they will not be separated again, if they are truly united.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun nivaariaa hai saachaa soiee ||3||
verses.translation: The True Lord brings their comings and goings to an end. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਸੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਚੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar nivaariaa seetaa hai cholaa ||
verses.translation: One who subdues and eradicates egotism, sews the robe of devotion.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹ ਕੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee fal paiaa seh ke a(n)mirat bolaa ||4||
verses.translation: Following the Word of the Guru's Teachings, she receives the fruits of her reward, the Ambrosial Words of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਹੁ ਖਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai saheleeho sahu kharaa piaaraa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O soul-brides, our Husband Lord is so dear!

verses.original: ਹਮ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੀਆ ਦਾਸੀਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: ham seh kereeaa dhaaseeaa saachaa khasam hamaaraa ||5||2||4||
verses.translation: We are the servants, the hand-maidens of the Lord; He is our True Lord and Master. ||5||2||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਵਾਰਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau bhaa(n)ddai bhaau tinaa savaarasee ||
verses.translation: Those whose minds are filled with love of the Lord, are blessed and exalted.

verses.original: ਸੂਖੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਸਾਉ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: sookhee karai pasaau dhookh visaarasee ||
verses.translation: They are blessed with peace, and their pains are forgotten.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahasaa moole naeh sarapar taarasee ||1||
verses.translation: He will undoubtedly, certainly save them. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲੀਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h)aa miliaa gur aai jin kau leekhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru comes to meet those whose destiny is so pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੀਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har kaa naau dhevai dheekhiaa ||
verses.translation: He blesses them with the Teachings of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਭੀਖਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaaleh satigur bhai bhaveh na bheekhiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those who walk in the Will of the True Guru, never wander begging. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਨਿਵੈ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau mahal hajoor dhooje nivai kis ||
verses.translation: And one who lives in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, why should he bow down to any other?

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਣੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਪੁਛ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhar dharavaanee naeh moole puchh tis ||
verses.translation: The gate-keeper at the Lord's Gate shall not stop him to ask any questions.

verses.original: ਛੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਦਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhuTai taa kai bol saahib nadhar jis ||3||
verses.translation: And one who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace - by his words, others are emancipated as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਲੇ ਆਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਮਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghale aane aap jis naahee dhoojaa matai koi ||
