verses.translation: The Lord Himself sends out, and recalls the mortal beings; no one else gives Him advice.

verses.original: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ddaeh usaare saaj jaanai sabh soi ||
verses.translation: He Himself demolishes, constructs and creates; He knows everything.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: naau naanak bakhasees nadharee karam hoi ||4||3||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord is the blessing, given to those who receive His Mercy, and His Grace. ||4||3||5||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਹਛਾ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhaa(n)ddaa hachhaa soi jo tis bhaavasee ||
verses.translation: That vessel alone is pure, which is pleasing to Him.

verses.original: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਅਤਿ ਮਲੀਣੁ ਧੋਤਾ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhaa(n)ddaa at maleen dhotaa hachhaa na hoisee ||
verses.translation: The filthiest vessel does not become pure, simply by being washed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: guroo dhuaarai hoi sojhee paisee ||
verses.translation: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, one obtains understanding.

verses.original: ਏਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੋਇ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: et dhuaarai dhoi hachhaa hoisee ||
verses.translation: By being washed through this Gate, it becomes pure.

verses.original: ਮੈਲੇ ਹਛੇ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: maile hachhe kaa veechaar aap varataisee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself sets the standards to differentiate between the dirty and the pure.

verses.original: ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਇ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: mat ko jaanai jai agai paisee ||
verses.translation: Do not think that you will automatically find a place of rest hereafter.

verses.original: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jehe karam kamai tehaa hoisee ||
verses.translation: According to the actions one has committed, so does the mortal become.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har kaa naau aap varataisee ||
verses.translation: He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਚਲਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: chaliaa pat siau janam savaar vaajaa vaisee ||
verses.translation: Such a mortal departs with honor and renown; his life is embellished and redeemed, and the trumpets resound with his glory.

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: maanas kiaa vechaaraa tih lok sunaisee ||
verses.translation: Why speak of poor mortals? His glory shall echo throughout the three worlds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਸੀ ॥੧॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak aap nihaal sabh kul taarasee ||1||4||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he himself shall be enraptured, and he shall save his entire ancestry. ||1||4||6||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗਵੈ ਭੋਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jogee hovai jogavai bhogee hovai khai ||
verses.translation: The Yogi practices yoga, and the pleasure-seeker practices eating.

verses.original: ਤਪੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tapeeaa hovai tap kare teerath mal mal nai ||1||
verses.translation: The austere practice austerities, bathing and rubbing themselves at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਹੈ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa sadhaRaa suneejai bhaiee je ko bahai alai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Let me hear some news of You, O Beloved; if only someone would come and sit with me, and tell me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੇ ਜੋ ਖਟੇ ਸੋੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa beejai so lune jo khaTe suo khai ||
verses.translation: As one plants, so does he harvest; whatever he earns, he eats.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਣੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: agai puchh na hoviee je san neesaanai jai ||2||
verses.translation: In the world hereafter, his account is not called for, if he goes with the insignia of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੈਸੋ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taiso jaisaa kaaddeeaai jaisee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: According to the actions the mortal commits, so is he proclaimed.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸੋ ਦਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo dham chit na aaviee so dham birathaa jai ||3||
verses.translation: And that breath which is drawn without thinking of the Lord, that breath goes in vain. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਬੈ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan vechee bai karee je ko le vikai ||
verses.translation: I would sell this body, if someone would only purchase it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak ka(n)m na aaviee jit tan naahee sachaa naau ||4||5||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that body is of no use at all, if it does not enshrine the Name of the True Lord. ||4||5||7||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਡੰਡੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਸਮ ਚੜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jog na khi(n)thaa jog na dda(n)ddai jog na bhasam chaRaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Yoga is not the patched coat, Yoga is not the walking stick. Yoga is not smearing the body with ashes.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਮੁੰਦੀ ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁਡਾਇਐ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jog na mu(n)dhee moo(n)dd muddaiaai jog na si(n)n(g)ee vaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Yoga is not the ear-rings, and not the shaven head. Yoga is not the blowing of the horn.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan raheeaai jog jugat iv paieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਲੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: galee jog na hoiee ||
verses.translation: By mere words, Yoga is not attained.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek dhirasaT kar samasar jaanai jogee kaheeaai soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who looks upon all with a single eye, and knows them to be one and the same - he alone is known as a Yogi. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jog na baahar maRee masaanee jog na taaRee laieeaai ||
verses.translation: Yoga is not wandering to the tombs of the dead; Yoga is not sitting in trances.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵਿਐ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jog na dhes dhisa(n)tar bhaviaai jog na teerath naieeaai ||
verses.translation: Yoga is not wandering through foreign lands; Yoga is not bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan raheeaai jog jugat iv paieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai taa sahasaa tooTai dhaavat varaj rahaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, doubt is dispelled, and the wandering mind is restrained.

verses.original: ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: nijhar jharai sahaj dhun laagai ghar hee parachaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Nectar rains down, celestial music resounds, and deep within, wisdom is obtained.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan raheeaai jog jugat iv paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jeevatiaa mar raheeaai aaisaa jog kamaieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, remain dead while yet alive - practice such a Yoga.

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਤਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: vaaje baajhahu si(n)n(g)ee vaajai tau nirabhau padh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: When the horn is blown without being blown, then you shall attain the state of fearless dignity.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan maeh nira(n)jan raheeaai jog jugat tau paieeaai ||4||1||8||
verses.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||4||1||8||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਉਣ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਕਵਣੁ ਤੁਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaun taraajee kavan tulaa teraa kavan saraaf bulaavaa ||
verses.translation: What scale, what weights, and what assayer shall I call for You, Lord?

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਵਾ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaun guroo kai peh dheekhiaa levaa kai peh mul karaavaa ||1||
verses.translation: From what guru should I receive instruction? By whom should I have Your value appraised? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere laal jeeau teraa a(n)t na jaanaa ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Beloved Lord, Your limits are not known.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa too(n) aape sarab samaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You pervade the water, the land, and the sky; You Yourself are All-pervading. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: man taaraajee chit tulaa teree sev saraaf kamaavaa ||
verses.translation: Mind is the scale, consciousness the weights, and the performance of Your service is the appraiser.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT hee bheetar so sahu tolee in bidh chit rahaavaa ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within my heart, I weigh my Husband Lord; in this way I focus my consciousness. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੰਡਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape ka(n)ddaa tol taraajee aape tolanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the balance, the weights and the scale; You Yourself are the weigher.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape dhekhai aape boojhai aape hai vanajaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: You Yourself see, and You Yourself understand; You Yourself are the trader. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhulaa neech jaat paradhesee khin aavai til jaavai ||
verses.translation: The blind, low class wandering soul, comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਹਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: taa kee sa(n)gat naanak rahadhaa kiau kar mooRaa paavai ||4||2||9||
verses.translation: In its company, Nanak dwells; how can the fool attain the Lord? ||4||2||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: man raam naam aaraadhiaa gur sabadh guroo gur ke ||
verses.translation: My mind worships and adores the Lord's Name, through the Guru, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਇਛਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਜਮ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh ichhaa man tan pooreeaa sabh chookaa ddar jam ke ||1||
verses.translation: All the desires of my mind and body have been fulfilled; all fear of death has been dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gun gaavahu raam naam har ke ||
verses.translation: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਗਟਕੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai man parabodhiaa har peeaa ras gaTake ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: And when the Guru is pleased and satisfied, the mind is instructed; it then joyfully drinks in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat uootam satigur keree gun gaavai har prabh ke ||
verses.translation: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru, is sublime and exalted. They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਮ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਗ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa dhaar melahu satasa(n)gat ham dhoveh pag jan ke ||2||
verses.translation: Bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat; I wash the feet of Your humble servants. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam sabh hai raam naamaa ras gurmat ras rasake ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is all. The Lord's Name is the essence of the Guru's Teachings, the juice, the sweetness of it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਤਿਸ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mrit har jal paiaa sabh laathee tis tis ke ||3||
verses.translation: I have found the Ambrosial Nectar, the Divine Water of the Lord's Name, and all my thirst for it is quenched. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਮ ਵੇਚਿਓ ਸਿਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamaree jaat paat gur satigur ham vechio sir gur ke ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, is my social status and honor; I have sold my head to the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਜਨ ਕੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam pario gur chelaa gur raakhahu laaj jan ke ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is called the chaylaa, the disciple of the Guru; O Guru, save the honor of Your servant. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦਾਲਦ ਦਲਘਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam bhajio purakhotam sabh binase dhaaladh dhalaghaa ||
verses.translation: I chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord God, the Supreme Being, Har, Har; my poverty and problems have all been eradicated.

verses.original: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਘਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhau janam maranaa meTio gur sabadhee har asathir sev sukh samaghaa ||1||
verses.translation: The fear of birth and death has been erased, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; serving the Unmoving, Unchanging Lord, I am absorbed in peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਰਘਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere man bhaj raam naam at piraghaa ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the most Beloved, Darling Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਲੀਓ ਮੁਲਿ ਮਹਘਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai man tan arap dhario gur aagai sir vech leeo mul mahaghaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have dedicated my mind and body, and placed them in offering before the Guru; I have sold my head to the Guru, for a very dear price. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਖੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਲਘਾ ॥
verses.translit: narapat raaje ra(n)g ras maaneh bin naavai pakaR khaRe sabh kalaghaa ||
verses.translation: The kings and the rulers of men enjoy pleasures and delights, but without the Name of the Lord, death seizes and dispatches them all.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ਹਥ ਫਲਘਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharam rai sir dda(n)dd lagaanaa fir pachhutaane hath falaghaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma strikes them over the heads with his staff, and when the fruits of their actions come into their hands, then they regret and repent. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲਘਾ ॥
verses.translit: har raakh raakh jan kiram tumaare saranaagat purakh pratipalaghaa ||
verses.translation: Save me, save me, Lord; I am Your humble servant, a mere worm. I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Primal Lord, Cherisher and Nourisher.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਘਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharasan sa(n)t dheh sukh paavai prabh loch poor jan tumaghaa ||3||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Saint's Darshan, that I may find peace. O God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਘਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum samarath purakh vadde prabh suaamee mo kau keejai dhaan har nimaghaa ||
verses.translation: You are the All-powerful, Great, Primal God, my Lord and Master. O Lord, please bless me with the gift of humility.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਘਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam milai sukh paavai ham naam viTahu sadh ghumaghaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and is at peace; I am forever a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naamaa har ra(n)n(g) hai har ra(n)n(g) majeeThai ra(n)n(g) ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the Love of the Lord. The Lord's Love is the permanent color.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਾੜਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭੰਙੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai har ra(n)g chaaRiaa fir bahuR na hovee bha(n)n(g) ||1||
verses.translation: When the Guru is totally satisfied and pleased, He colors us with the Lord's Love; this color shall never fade away. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har raam naam kar ra(n)n(g) ||
verses.translation: O my mind, enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰਾਉ ਨਿਸੰਙੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai har upadhesiaa har bheTiaa raau nisa(n)n(g) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru, satisfied and pleased, taught me about the Lord, and my Sovereign Lord King met with me at once. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh iaanee manmukhee fir aavan jaanaa a(n)n(g) ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is like the ignorant bride, who comes and goes again and again in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸਹਲੰਙੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har prabh chit na aaio man dhoojaa bhaau sahala(n)n(g) ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord God does not come into her consciousness, and her mind is stuck in the love of duality. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਗੀ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
verses.translit: ham mail bhare dhuhachaareeaa har raakhahu a(n)gee a(n)n(g) ||
verses.translation: I am full of filth, and I practice evil deeds; O Lord, save me, be with me, merge me into Your Being!

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਵਲਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪੰਙੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)mirat sar navalaiaa sabh laathe kilavikh pa(n)n(g) ||3||
verses.translation: The Guru has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar, and all my dirty sins and mistakes have been washed away. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਙੁ ॥
verses.translit: har dheenaa dheen dhiaal prabh satasa(n)gat melahu sa(n)n(g) ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, Merciful to the meek and the poor, please unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)gat har ra(n)g paiaa jan naanak man tan ra(n)n(g) ||4||3||
verses.translation: Joining the Sangat, servant Nanak has obtained the Lord's Love; my mind and body are drenched in it. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har har kareh nit kapaT kamaaveh hiradhaa sudh na hoiee ||
verses.translation: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, while constantly practicing deception, shall never become pure of heart.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin karam kareh bahutere supanai sukh na hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: He may perform all sorts of rituals, night and day, but he shall not find peace, even in dreams. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee gur bin bhagat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: O wise ones, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

verses.original: ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: korai ra(n)g kadhe na chaRai je lochai sabh koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The untreated cloth does not take up the dye, no matter how much everyone may wish it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਵਰਤ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam varat kare poojaa manmukh rog na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh may perform chants, meditations, austere self-discipline, fasts and devotional worship, but his sickness does not go away.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar rog mahaa abhimaanaa dhoojai bhai khuaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within him is the sickness of excessive egotism; in the love of duality he is ruined. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: baahar bhekh bahut chaturaiee manooaa dheh dhis dhaavai ||
verses.translation: Outwardly, he wears religious robes and he is very clever, but his mind wanders in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai biaapiaa sabadh na cheen(h)ai fir fir joonee aavai ||3||
verses.translation: Engrossed in ego, he does not remember the Word of the Shabad; over and over again, he is reincarnated. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: naanak nadhar kare so boojhai so jan naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that mortal who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, understands Him; that humble servant meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee eko boojhai ekas maeh samaae ||4||4||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he understands the One Lord, and is absorbed into the One Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat nagaree khoj khojaiee ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I searched and searched the body-village;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam padhaarath paiee ||1||
verses.translation: I found the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: merai man har har saa(n)t vasaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined peace within my mind.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tisanaa agan bujhee khin a(n)tar gur miliaai sabh bhukh gavaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire was extinguished in an instant, when I met the Guru; all my hunger has been satisfied. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavaa jeevaa meree maiee ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live, O my mother.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur dhiaal gun naam dhiraRaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The Merciful True Guru implanted the Glorious Praises of the Naam within me. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau har prabh piaaraa ddoodd ddooddaiee ||
verses.translation: I search for and seek out my Beloved Lord God, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mil har ras paiee ||3||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhur masatak lekh likhe har paiee ||
verses.translation: By the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I have found the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur naanak tuThaa melai har bhaiee ||4||1||5||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak, pleased and satisfied, has united me with the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||5||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa kare man har ra(n)g laae ||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy, the Lord imbues the mind with His Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har har naam samaae ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raataa man ra(n)g maane ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mortal enjoys the pleasure of His Love.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee poore gur kai sabadh samaane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He remains always blissful, day and night, and he merges into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਕਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g kau lochai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs for the Lord's Love;

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ra(n)g chaloolaa hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: the Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨਰੁ ਕੋਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mugadh nar koraa hoi ||
verses.translation: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is left pale and uncolored.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je sau lochai ra(n)g na hovai koi ||3||
verses.translation: Even if he wishes it a hundred times, he does not obtain the Lord's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa satigur paavai ||
verses.translation: But if the Lord blesses him with His Glance of Grace, then he meets the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak har ras har ra(n)g samaavai ||4||2||6||
verses.translation: Nanak is absorbed into the subtle essence of the Lord's Love. ||4||2||6||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਹੀ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa har ras rahee aghai ||
verses.translation: My tongue remains satisfied with the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh peevai sahaj samai ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh drinks it in, and merges in celestial peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਨ ਚਾਖਹੁ ਜੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har ras jan chaakhahu je bhaiee ||
verses.translation: If you taste the subtle essence of the Lord, O humble Siblings of Destiny,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕਤ ਅਨਤ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tau kat anat saadh lobhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: then how can you be enticed by other flavors? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat ras raakhahu ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instructions, keep this subtle essence enshrined in your heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ras raate ra(n)g muraar ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the subtle essence of the Lord, are immersed in celestial bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh har ras chaakhiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh cannot even taste the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai karai bahutee milai sajai ||3||
verses.translation: He acts out in ego, and suffers terrible punishment. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa har ras paavai ||
verses.translation: But if he is blessed with the Lord's Kind Mercy, then he obtains the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: naanak har ras har gun gaavai ||4||3||7||
verses.translation: O Nanak, absorbed in this subtle essence of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||3||7||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: neech jaat har japatiaa utam padhavee pai ||
verses.translation: When someone of low social class chants the Lord's Name, he obtains the state of highest dignity.

verses.original: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੈ ਕਿਸਨੁ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: poochhahu bidhar dhaasee sutai kisan utariaa ghar jis jai ||1||
verses.translation: Go and ask Bidar, the son of a maid; Krishna himself stayed in his house. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kee akath kathaa sunahu jan bhaiee jit sahasaa dhookh bhookh sabh leh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Listen, O humble Siblings of Destiny, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord; it removes all anxiety, pain and hunger. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਾਰੁ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਇਕ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ravidhaas chamaar usatat kare har keerat nimakh ik gai ||
verses.translation: Ravi Daas, the leather-worker, praised the Lord, and sang the Kirtan of His Praises each and every instant.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾਤਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਪਏ ਪਗਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: patit jaat utam bhiaa chaar varan pe pag aai ||2||
verses.translation: Although he was of low social status, he was exalted and elevated, and people of all four castes came and bowed at his feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਦੇਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਛੀਪਾ ਕਹੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naamadhea preet lagee har setee lok chheepaa kahai bulai ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv loved the Lord; the people called him a fabric dyer.

verses.original: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਪਿਠਿ ਦੇ ਛੋਡੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਲੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khatree braahaman piTh dhe chhodde har naamadheau leeaa mukh lai ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord turned His back on the high-class Kh'shaatriyas and Brahmins, and showed His face to Naam Dayv. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jitane bhagat har sevakaa mukh aThasaTh teerath tin tilak kaddai ||
verses.translation: All of the devotees and servants of the Lord have the tilak, the ceremonial mark, applied to their foreheads at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਪਰਸੇ ਜੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tin kau anadhin parase je kirapaa kare har rai ||4||1||8||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak shall touch their feet night and day, if the Lord, the King, grants His Grace. ||4||1||8||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h)ee a(n)tar har aaraadhiaa jin kau dhur likhiaa likhat lilaaraa ||
verses.translation: They alone worship and adore the Lord deep within, who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny from the very beginning of time.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin kee bakheelee koiee kiaa kare jin kaa a(n)g kare meraa har karataaraa ||1||
verses.translation: What can anyone do to undermine them? My Creator Lord is on their side. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har dhiaai man mere man dhiaai har janam janam ke sabh dhookh nivaaranahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind. Meditate on the Lord, O mind; He is the Eliminator of all the pains of reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhur bhagat janaa kau bakhasiaa har a(n)mirat bhagat bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the very beginning, the Lord blessed His devotees with the Ambrosial Nectar, the treasure of devotion.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: moorakh hovai su un kee rees kare tis halat palat muh kaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Anyone who tries to compete with them is a fool; his face shall be blackened here and hereafter. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: se bhagat se sevakaa jinaa har naam piaaraa ||
verses.translation: They alone are devotees, and they alone are selfless servants, who love the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਪਵੈ ਛਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin kee sevaa te har paieeaai sir ni(n)dhak kai pavai chhaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: By their selfless service, they find the Lord, while ashes fall on the heads of the slanderers. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis ghar viratee soiee jaanai jagat gur naanak poochh karahu beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: He alone knows this, who experiences it within the home of his own self. Ask Guru Nanak, the Guru of the world, and reflect upon it.

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਪੀੜੀ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: chahu peeRee aadh jugaadh bakheelee kinai na paio har sevak bhai nisataaraa ||4||2||9||
verses.translation: Throughout the four generations of the Gurus, from the beginning of time and throughout the ages, no one has ever found the Lord by back-biting and undermining. Only by serving the Lord with love, is one emancipated. ||4||2||9||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jithai har aaraadheeaai tithai har mit sahaiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever the Lord is worshipped in adoration, there the Lord becomes one's friend and helper.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te har man vasai horat bidh liaa na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind; He cannot be obtained in any other way. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan sa(n)cheeaai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: So gather in the wealth of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny,

verses.original: ਜਿ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: j halat palat har hoi sakhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: so that in this world and the next, the Lord shall be your friend and companion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟੀਐ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gatee sa(n)g har dhan khaTeeaai hor thai horat upai har dhan kitai na paiee ||
verses.translation: In the company of the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall earn the wealth of the Lord; this wealth of the Lord is not obtained anywhere else, by any other means, at all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੈ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਧਨੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਕਚੈ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਵਾਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ratanai kaa vaapaareeaa har ratan dhan vihaajhe kachai ke vaapaare'e vaak har dhan liaa na jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: The dealer in the Lord's Jewels purchases the wealth of the Lord's jewels; the dealer in cheap glass jewels cannot acquire the Lord's wealth by empty words. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan ratan javehar maanak har dhanai naal a(n)mirat velai vatai har bhagatee har liv laiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's wealth is like jewels, gems and rubies. At the appointed time in the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours of the morning, the Lord's devotees lovingly center their attention on the Lord, and the wealth of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਵਤੈ ਕਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਭਗਤ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan a(n)mirat velai vatai kaa beejiaa bhagat khai kharach rahe nikhuTai naahee ||
verses.translation: The devotees of the Lord plant the seed of the Lord's wealth in the ambrosial hours of the Amrit Vaylaa; they eat it, and spend it, but it is never exhausted.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: halat palat har dhanai kee bhagataa kau milee vaddiaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: In this world and the next, the devotees are blessed with glorious greatness, the wealth of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅਗਨੀ ਤਸਕਰੈ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਜਮਦੂਤੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan nirabhau sadhaa sadhaa asathir hai saachaa ih har dhan aganee tasakarai paaneeaai jamadhootai kisai kaa gavaiaa na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Fearless Lord is permanent, forever and ever, and true. This wealth of the Lord cannot be destroyed by fire or water; neither thieves nor the Messenger of Death can take it away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਉਚਕਾ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har dhan kau uchakaa neR na aaviee jam jaagaatee dda(n)dd na lagaiee ||4||
verses.translation: Thieves cannot even approach the Lord's wealth; Death, the tax collector cannot tax it. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕ ਵਿਖ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saakatee paap kar kai bikhiaa dhan sa(n)chiaa tinaa ik vikh naal na jaiee ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics commit sins and gather in their poisonous wealth, but it shall not go along with them for even a single step.

verses.original: ਹਲਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ਭਏ ਹਥਹੁ ਛੁੜਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਅਗੈ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: halatai vich saakat dhuhele bhe hathahu chhuRak giaa agai palat saakat har dharageh ddoiee na paiee ||5||
verses.translation: In this world, the faithless cynics become miserable, as it slips away through their hands. In the world hereafter, the faithless cynics find no shelter in the Court of the Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਲਦਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis har dhan kaa saahu har aap hai sa(n)tahu jis no dhei su har dhan ladh chalaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is the Banker of this wealth, O Saints; when the Lord gives it, the mortal loads it and takes it away.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੈ ਕਾ ਤੋਟਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥੩॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: eis har dhanai kaa toTaa kadhe na aaviee jan naanak kau gur sojhee paiee ||6||3||10||
verses.translation: This wealth of the Lord is never exhausted; the Guru has given this understanding to servant Nanak. ||6||3||10||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਰਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no har suprasa(n)n hoi so har gunaa ravai so bhagat so paravaan ||
verses.translation: That mortal, with whom the Lord is pleased, repeats the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he alone is a devotee, and he alone is approved.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਰਨੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis kee mahimaa kiaa varaneeaai jis kai hiradhai vasiaa har purakh bhagavaan ||1||
verses.translation: How can his glory be described? Within his heart, the Primal Lord, the Lord God, abides. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਲਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh gun gaieeaai jeeau lai satiguroo naal dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe; focus your meditation on the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: so satiguroo saa sevaa satigur kee safal hai jis te paieeaai param nidhaan ||
verses.translation: He is the True Guru - service to the True Guru is fruitful and rewarding. By this service, the greatest treasure is obtained.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਅਰਥਿ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo dhoojai bhai saakat kaamanaa arath dhuraga(n)dh sarevadhe so nihafal sabh agiaan ||2||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics in their love of duality and sensual desires, harbor foul-smelling urges. They are totally useless and ignorant. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no parateet hovai tis kaa gaaviaa thai pavai so paavai dharageh maan ||
verses.translation: One who has faith - his singing is approved. He is honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਰਤੀਤੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਅਖੀ ਮੀਟਦੇ ਉਨ ਕਾ ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo bin parateetee kapaTee kooRee kooRee akhee meeTadhe un kaa utar jaigaa jhooTh gumaan ||3||
verses.translation: Those who lack faith may close their eyes, hypocritically pretending and faking devotion, but their false pretenses shall soon wear off. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jetaa jeeau pi(n)dd sabh teraa too(n) a(n)tarajaamee purakh bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: My soul and body are totally Yours, Lord; You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, my Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਹਉ ਕਰੀ ਵਖਿਆਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: dhaasan dhaas kahai jan naanak jehaa too(n) karaieh tehaa hau karee vakhiaan ||4||4||11||
verses.translation: So speaks servant Nanak, the slave of Your slaves; as You make me speak, so do I speak. ||4||4||11||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਗਾਵਾ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tere kavan kavan gun keh keh gaavaa too saahib gunee nidhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I sing and recount, Lord? You are my Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਊਚ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaree mahimaa baran na saakau too(n) Thaakur uooch bhagavaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I cannot express Your Glorious Praises. You are my Lord and Master, lofty and benevolent. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mai har har naam dhar soiee ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my only support.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh mere saahib mai tujh bin avar na koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, please save me, O my Lord and Master; without You, I have no other at all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: mai taan dheebaan toohai mere suaamee mai tudh aagai aradhaas ||
verses.translation: You alone are my strength, and my Court, O my Lord and Master; unto You alone I pray.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mai hor thaau naahee jis peh karau bena(n)tee meraa dhukh sukh tujh hee paas ||2||
verses.translation: There is no other place where I can offer my prayers; I can tell my pains and pleasures only to You. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਿਚੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: viche dharatee viche paanee vich kaasaT agan dhareejai ||
verses.translation: Water is locked up in the earth, and fire is locked up in wood.

verses.original: ਬਕਰੀ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਇਕਤੈ ਥਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bakaree si(n)gh ikatai thai raakhe man har jap bhram bhau dhoor keejai ||3||
verses.translation: The sheep and the lions are kept in one place; O mortal, meditate on the Lord, and your doubts and fears shall be removed. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੇਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kee vaddiaaiee dhekhahu sa(n)tahu har nimaaniaa maan dhevaae ||
verses.translation: So behold the glorious greatness of the Lord, O Saints; the Lord blesses the dishonored with honor.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਤਲੇ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਆਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: jiau dharatee charan tale te uoopar aavai tiau naanak saadh janaa jagat aan sabh pairee paae ||4||1||12||
verses.translation: As dust rises from underfoot, O Nanak, so does the Lord make all people fall at the feet of the Holy. ||4||1||12||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) karataa sabh kichh aape jaaneh kiaa tudh peh aakh sunaieeaai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself, O Creator, know everything; what can I possibly tell You?

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa tudh sabh kichh soojhai jehaa ko kare tehaa ko paieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: You know all the bad and the good; as we act, so are we rewarded. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere saahib too(n) a(n)tar kee bidh jaaneh ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You alone know the state of my inner being.

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa tudh sabh kichh soojhai tudh bhaavai tivai bulaaveh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You know all the bad and the good; as it pleases You, so You make us speak. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh moh maiaa sareer har keeaa vich dhehee maanukh bhagat karaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord has infused the love of Maya into all bodies; through this human body, there comes the opportunity to worship the Lord with devotion.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eikanaa satigur mel sukh dheveh ik manmukh dha(n)dh piTaiee ||2||
verses.translation: You unite some with the True Guru, and bless them with peace; while others, the self-willed manmukhs, are engrossed in worldly affairs. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko teraa too(n) sabhanaa kaa mere karate tudh sabhanaa sir likhiaa lekh ||
verses.translation: All belong to You, and You belong to all, O my Creator Lord; You wrote the words of destiny on the forehead of everyone.

verses.original: ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jehee too(n) nadhar kareh tehaa ko hovai bin nadharee naahee ko bhekh ||3||
verses.translation: As You bestow Your Glance of Grace, so are mortals made; without Your Gracious Glance, no one assumes any form. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: teree vaddiaaiee too(n)hai jaaneh sabh tudhano nit dhiaae ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your Glorious Greatness; everyone constantly meditates on You.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jis no tudh bhaavai tis no too(n) meleh jan naanak so thai paae ||4||2||13||
verses.translation: That being, with whom You are pleased, is united with You; O servant Nanak, only such a mortal is accepted. ||4||2||13||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai a(n)tar vasiaa meraa har har tin ke sabh rog gavaae ||
verses.translation: Those beings, within whose inner selves my Lord, Har, Har, dwells - all their diseases are cured.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: te mukat bhe jin har naam dhiaaiaa tin pavit param padh paae ||1||
verses.translation: They alone become liberated, who meditate on the Name of the Lord; they obtain the supreme status. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਆਰੋਗ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam har jan aarog bhe ||
verses.translation: O my Lord, the Lord's humble servants become healthy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee jinaa japiaa meraa har har tin ke haumai rog ge ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on my Lord, Har, Har, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, are rid of the disease of ego. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰੋਗੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahaadheau trai gun rogee vich haumai kaar kamaiee ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva suffer from the disease of the three gunas - the three qualities; they do their deeds in egotism.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin ke'ee tiseh na cheteh bapuRe har gurmukh sojhee paiee ||2||
verses.translation: The poor fools do not remember the One who created them; this understanding of the Lord is only obtained by those who become Gurmukh. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rog sabh jagat biaapiaa tin kau janam maran dhukh bhaaree ||
verses.translation: The entire world is afflicted by the disease of egotism. They suffer the terrible pains of birth and death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਛੂਟੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ko viralaa chhooTai tis jan kau hau balihaaree ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, a few rare ones are saved; I am a sacrifice to those humble beings. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: jin sisaT saajee soiee har jaanai taa kaa roop apaaro ||
verses.translation: The One who created the Universe, that Lord alone knows. His beauty is incomparable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aape vekh har bigasai gurmukh braham beechaaro ||4||3||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself gazes upon it, and is pleased. The Gurmukh contemplates God. ||4||3||14||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਣਾ ਸਰਬ ਰਜਾਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa karanaa sarab rajaiee kichh keechai je kar sakeeaai ||
verses.translation: All that happens, and all that will happen, is by His Will. If we could do something by ourselves, we would.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aapanaa keetaa kichhoo na hovai jiau har bhaavai tiau rakheeaai ||1||
verses.translation: By ourselves, we cannot do anything at all. As it pleases the Lord, He preserves us. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere har jeeau sabh ko terai vas ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Lord, everything is in Your power.

verses.original: ਅਸਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਸਾਕਹ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬਖਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: asaa jor naahee je kichh kar ham saakeh jiau bhaavai tivai bakhas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have no power to do anything at all. As it pleases You, You forgive us. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jeeau pi(n)dd dheeaa tudh aape tudh aape kaarai laiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself bless us with soul, body and everything. You Yourself cause us to act.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕੋ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jehaa too(n) hukam kareh tehe ko karam kamaavai jehaa tudh dhur likh paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: As You issue Your Commands, so do we act, according to our pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ਕੋਈ ਛੇਵਾ ਕਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat kar tudh sirasaT sabh saajee koiee chhevaa kariau je kichh keetaa hovai ||
verses.translation: You created the entire Universe out of the five elements; if anyone can create a sixth, let him.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬੁਝਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eikanaa satigur mel too(n) bujhaaveh ik manmukh kareh s rovai ||3||
verses.translation: You unite some with the True Guru, and cause them to understand, while others, the self-willed manmukhs, do their deeds and cry out in pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਉ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨੀਚਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kee vaddiaaiee hau aakh na saakaa hau moorakh mugadh neechaan ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe the glorious greatness of the Lord; I am foolish, thoughtless, idiotic and lowly.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪਇਆ ਅਜਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har bakhas lai mere suaamee saranaagat piaa ajaan ||4||4||15||24||
verses.translation: Please, forgive servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I am ignorant, but I have entered Your Sanctuary. ||4||4||15||24||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਬਾਜੀਗਰਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baajeegar jaise baajee paiee ||
verses.translation: The actor stages the play,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa roop bhekh dhikhalaiee ||
verses.translation: playing the many characters in different costumes;

verses.original: ਸਾਂਗੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਥੰਮਿੑਓ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saa(n)g utaar tha(n)mi(h)o paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: but when the play ends, he takes off the costumes,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tab eko eka(n)kaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: and then he is one, and only one. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਓ ਬਿਨਸਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: kavan roop dhirasaTio binasaio ||
verses.translation: How many forms and images appeared and disappeared?

verses.original: ਕਤਹਿ ਗਇਓ ਉਹੁ ਕਤ ਤੇ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kateh gio uh kat te aaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Where have they gone? Where did they come from? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਊਠਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal te uooTheh anik tara(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Countless waves rise up from the water.

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਭੂਖਨ ਕੀਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: kanik bhookhan keene bahu ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Jewels and ornaments of many different forms are fashioned from gold.

verses.original: ਬੀਜੁ ਬੀਜਿ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: beej beej dhekhio bahu parakaaraa ||
verses.translation: I have seen seeds of all kinds being planted

verses.original: ਫਲ ਪਾਕੇ ਤੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: fal paake te eka(n)kaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: - when the fruit ripens, the seeds appear in the same form as the original. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਘਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਆਕਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sahas ghaTaa meh ek aakaas ||
verses.translation: The one sky is reflected in thousands of water jugs,

verses.original: ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ ਤੇ ਓਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT fooTe te ohee pragaas ||
verses.translation: but when the jugs are broken, only the sky remains.

verses.original: ਭਰਮ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bharam lobh moh maiaa vikaar ||
verses.translation: Doubt comes from greed, emotional attachment and the corruption of Maya.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੇ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhram chhooTe te eka(n)kaar ||3||
verses.translation: Freed from doubt, one realizes the One Lord alone. ||3||

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: oh abinaasee binasat naahee ||
verses.translation: He is imperishable; He will never pass away.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko aavai naa ko jaahee ||
verses.translation: He does not come, and He does not go.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai haumai mal dhoiee ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has washed away the filth of ego.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak meree param gat hoiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have obtained the supreme status. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa loReh so prabh hoi ||
verses.translation: Whatever God wills, that alone happens.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin dhoojaa naahee koi ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਜ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan seve tis pooran kaaj ||
verses.translation: The humble being serves Him, and so all his works are perfectly successful.

verses.original: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaas apune kee raakhahu laaj ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slaves. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree saran pooran dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect, Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin kavan kare pratipaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without You, who would cherish and love me? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: nikaT vasai naahee prabh dhoor ||
verses.translation: God dwells near at hand; He is not far away.

verses.original: ਲੋਕ ਪਤੀਆਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: lok pateeaarai kachhoo na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: By trying to please other people, nothing is accomplished.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saach lagai taa haumai jaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: When someone is attached to the True Lord, his ego is taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no lai le so laagai ||
verses.translation: He alone is attached, whom the Lord Himself attaches.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: giaan ratan a(n)tar tis jaagai ||
verses.translation: The jewel of spiritual wisdom is awakened deep within.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat jai param padh paae ||
verses.translation: Evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the supreme status is attained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee naam dhiaae ||3||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਕਰਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR karau aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Pressing my palms together, I offer my prayer;

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਆਣਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai taa aaneh raas ||
verses.translation: if it pleases You, Lord, please bless me and fulfill me.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apanee bhagatee lai ||
verses.translation: Grant Your Mercy, Lord, and bless me with devotion.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak prabh sadhaa dhiaai ||4||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on God forever. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhan sohaagan jo prabhoo pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that soul-bride, who realizes God.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਜੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: maanai hukam tajai abhimaanai ||
verses.translation: She obeys the Hukam of His Order, and abandons her self-conceit.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pria siau raatee raleeaa maanai ||1||
verses.translation: Imbued with her Beloved, she celebrates in delight. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sun sakhe'ee prabh milan neesaanee ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my companions - these are the signs on the Path to meet God.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arap taj laaj lokaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dedicate your mind and body to Him; stop living to please others. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee sahelee kau samajhaavai ||
verses.translation: One soul-bride counsels another,

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee kamaavai jo prabh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: to do only that which pleases God.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saa sohaagan a(n)k samaavai ||2||
verses.translation: Such a soul-bride merges into the Being of God. ||2||

verses.original: ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: garab gahelee mahal na paavai ||
verses.translation: One who is in the grip of pride does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਜਬ ਰੈਣਿ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: fir pachhutaavai jab rain bihaavai ||
verses.translation: She regrets and repents, when her life-night passes away.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਹੀਣਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karamaheen manmukh dhukh paavai ||3||
verses.translation: The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: binau karee je jaanaa dhoor ||
verses.translation: I pray to God, but I think that He is far away.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh abinaasee rahiaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: God is imperishable and eternal; He is pervading and permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gaavai dhekh hadhoor ||4||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak sings of Him; I see Him Ever-present everywhere. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਵਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਉ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: girahu vas gur keenaa hau ghar kee naar ||
verses.translation: The Giver has put this household of my being under my own control. I am now the mistress of the Lord's Home.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਭਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhas dhaasee kar dheenee bhataar ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord has made the ten senses and organs of actions my slaves.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਮੈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree mai ghar kee joRee ||
verses.translation: I have gathered together all the faculties and facilities of this house.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਉ ਲੋੜੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aas piaasee pir kau loRee ||1||
verses.translation: I am thirsty with desire and longing for my Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kahaa gun ka(n)t piaare ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Virtues of my Beloved Husband Lord should I describe?

verses.original: ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sughaR saroop dhiaal muraare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is All-knowing, totally beautiful and merciful; He is the Destroyer of ego. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਭਉ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sat seegaar bhau a(n)jan paiaa ||
verses.translation: I am adorned with Truth, and I have applied the mascara of the Fear of God to my eyes.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੰਬੋਲੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam ta(n)bol mukh khaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have chewed the betel-leaf of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੰਗਨ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਗਹਨੇ ਬਨੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)gan basatr gahane bane suhaave ||
verses.translation: My bracelets, robes and ornaments beautifully adorn me.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhan sabh sukh paavai jaa(n) pir ghar aavai ||2||
verses.translation: The soul-bride becomes totally happy, when her Husband Lord comes to her home. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun kaaman kar ka(n)t reejhaiaa ||
verses.translation: By the charms of virtue, I have enticed and fascinated my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vas kar leenaa gur bharam chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is under my power - the Guru has dispelled my doubts.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uoochaa ma(n)dhar meraa ||
verses.translation: My mansion is lofty and elevated.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh kaaman tiaagee priau preetam meraa ||3||
verses.translation: Renouncing all other brides, my Beloved has become my lover. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸੂਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTiaa soor jot ujeeaaraa ||
verses.translation: The sun has risen, and its light shines brightly.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਸਰਧ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sej vichhaiee saradh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: I have prepared my bed with infinite care and faith.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲੁ ਸੇਜ ਰਾਵਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nav ra(n)g laal sej raavan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: My Darling Beloved is new and fresh; He has come to my bed to enjoy me.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak pir dhan mil sukh paiaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: O Servant Nanak, my Husband Lord has come; the soul-bride has found peace. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਉਮਕਿਓ ਹੀਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aumakio heeau milan prabh taiee ||
verses.translation: An intense yearning to meet God has welled up in my heart.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਚਰਿਓ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: khojat chario dhekhau pria jaiee ||
verses.translation: I have gone out searching to find my Beloved Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦੇਸਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sunat sadhesaro pria gireh sej vichhaiee ||
verses.translation: Hearing news of my Beloved, I have laid out my bed in my home.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ਤਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhram bhram aaio tau nadhar na paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Wandering, wandering all around, I came, but I did not even see Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੀਅਰੋ ਧੀਰੈ ਨਿਮਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: kin bidh heearo dheerai nimaano ||
verses.translation: How can this poor heart be comforted?

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਜਨ ਹਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil saajan hau tujh kurabaano ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Come and meet me, O Friend; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛੀ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa sej vichhee dhan ka(n)taa ||
verses.translation: One bed is spread out for the bride and her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਸੂਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan sootee pir sadh jaaga(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The bride is asleep, while her Husband Lord is always awake.

verses.original: ਪੀਓ ਮਦਰੋ ਧਨ ਮਤਵੰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: peeo madharo dhan matava(n)taa ||
verses.translation: The bride is intoxicated, as if she has drunk wine.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਜਾਗੈ ਜੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਬੋਲੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhan jaagai je pir bola(n)taa ||2||
verses.translation: The soul-bride only awakens when her Husband Lord calls to her. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਿਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhiee niraasee bahut dhin laage ||
verses.translation: She has lost hope - so many days have passed.

verses.original: ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਝਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhes dhisa(n)tar mai sagale jhaage ||
verses.translation: I have travelled through all the lands and the countries.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗ ਪਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: khin rahan na paavau bin pag paage ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive, even for an instant, without the feet of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hoi kirapaal prabh mileh sabhaage ||3||
verses.translation: When God becomes Merciful, I become fortunate, and then I meet Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal satasa(n)g milaiaa ||
verses.translation: Becoming Merciful, He has united me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਬੂਝੀ ਤਪਤਿ ਘਰਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: boojhee tapat ghareh pir paiaa ||
verses.translation: The fire has been quenched, and I have found my Husband Lord within my own home.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਹੁਣਿ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sagal seegaar hun mujheh suhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am now adorned with all sorts of decorations.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur bharam chukaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh pir hai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see my Husband Lord there, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਖੋਲਿੑਓ ਕਪਾਟੁ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kholi(h)o kapaaT taa man Thaharaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||5||
verses.translation: When the door is opened, then the mind is restrained. ||1||Second Pause||5||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere saar sam(h)aalee moh niragun ke dhaataare ||
verses.translation: What virtues and excellences of Yours should I cherish and contemplate? I am worthless, while You are the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਥਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bai khareedh kiaa kare chaturaiee ih jeeau pi(n)dd sabh thaare ||1||
verses.translation: I am Your slave - what clever tricks could I ever try? This soul and body are totally Yours||1||

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laal ra(n)geele preetam manmohan tere dharasan kau ham baare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my Darling, Blissful Beloved, who fascinates my mind - I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਉਪਕਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhaataa moh dheen bhekhaaree tum(h) sadhaa sadhaa upakaare ||
verses.translation: O God, You are the Great Giver, and I am just a poor beggar; You are forever and ever benevolent.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿ ਮੈ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: so kichh naahee j mai te hovai mere Thaakur agam apaare ||2||
verses.translation: I cannot accomplish anything by myself, O my Unapproachable and Infinite Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa sev kamaavau kiaa keh reejhaavau bidh kit paavau dharasaare ||
verses.translation: What service can I perform? What should I say to please You? How can I gain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan?

verses.original: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਸੈ ਚਰਨਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mit nahee paieeaai a(n)t na laheeaai man tarasai charanaare ||3||
verses.translation: Your extent cannot be found - Your limits cannot be found. My mind longs for Your Feet. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਢੀਠੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਗਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paavau dhaan ddeeTh hoi maagau mukh laagai sa(n)t renaare ||
verses.translation: I beg with persistence to receive this gift, that the dust of the Saints might touch my face.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree prabh haath dhei nisataare ||4||6||
verses.translation: The Guru has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; reaching out with His Hand, God has delivered him. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਥੋਰੀ ਮਾਗਨੁ ਬਹੁਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa thoree maagan bahutaa ||
verses.translation: His service is insignificant, but his demands are very great.

verses.original: ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਹਤੋ ਪਹੁਤਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahal na paavai kahato pahutaa ||1||
verses.translation: He does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he says that he has arrived there||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮਾਨੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਰੀਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo pria maane tin kee reesaa ||
verses.translation: He competes with those who have been accepted by the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਹਾਠੀਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kooRe moorakh kee haaTheesaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is how stubborn the false fool is! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੇਖ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhekh dhikhaavai sach na kamaavai ||
verses.translation: He wears religious robes, but he does not practice Truth.

verses.original: ਕਹਤੋ ਮਹਲੀ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahato mahalee nikaT na aavai ||2||
verses.translation: He says that he has found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, but he cannot even get near it. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਤੀਤੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ateet sadhaae maiaa kaa maataa ||
verses.translation: He says that he is unattached, but he is intoxicated with Maya.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man nahee preet kahai mukh raataa ||3||
verses.translation: There is no love in his mind, and yet he says that he is imbued with the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh binau suneejai ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, hear my prayer, God:

verses.original: ਕੁਚਲੁ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਕਾਮੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kuchal kaThor kaamee mukat keejai ||4||
verses.translation: I am silly, stubborn and filled with sexual desire - please, liberate me! ||4||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekhe kee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: I gaze upon the glorious greatness of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: tum(h) sukhadhaate purakh subhaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||7||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of Peace, the Loving Primal Being. ||1||Second Pause||1||7||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੁਰੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਉ ਊਠਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bure kaam kau uooTh khaloiaa ||
verses.translation: He gets up early, to do his evil deeds,

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਸੋਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam kee belaa pai pai soiaa ||1||
verses.translation: but when it is time to meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, then he sleeps. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਉਸਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਨ ਇਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aausar apanaa boojhai na iaanaa ||
verses.translation: The ignorant person does not take advantage of the opportunity.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਰੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh ra(n)g lapaTaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is attached to Maya, and engrossed in worldly delights. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਗਸਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਬੈਠਾ ॥
verses.translit: lobh lahar kau bigas fool baiThaa ||
verses.translation: He rides the waves of greed, puffed up with joy.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kaa dharas na ddeeThaa ||2||
verses.translation: He does not see the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kabahoo na samajhai agiaan gavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The ignorant clown will never understand.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahur bahur lapaTio ja(n)jaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Again and again, he becomes engrossed in entanglements. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਨਾਦ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai naadh karan sun bheenaa ||
verses.translation: He listens to the sounds of sin and the music of corruption, and he is pleased.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਆਲਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jas sunat aalas man keenaa ||3||
verses.translation: His mind is too lazy to listen to the Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਅੰਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT naahee re pekhat a(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: You do not see with your eyes - you are so blind!

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd jaeh jhooThe sabh dha(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall have to leave all these false affairs. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh bakhas kareejai ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, please forgive me, God.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa moh saadhasa(n)g dheejai ||4||
verses.translation: Have Mercy upon me, and bless me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਹੋਈਐ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tau kichh paieeaai jau hoieeaai renaa ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains something, who becomes the dust under the feet of all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨॥੮॥
