verses.translit: jiseh bujhaae tis naam lainaa ||1|| rahaau ||2||8||
verses.translation: And he alone repeats the Naam, whom God causes to understand. ||1||Pause||2||8||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar meh Thaakur nadhar na aavai ||
verses.translation: Within the home of his own self, he does not even come to see his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗਲ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਣੁ ਲੈ ਲਟਕਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gal meh paahan lai laTakaavai ||1||
verses.translation: And yet, around his neck, he hangs a stone god. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolaa saakat firataa ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic wanders around, deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਨੀਰੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: neer birolai khap khap marataa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He churns water, and after wasting his life away, he dies. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਹਣ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis paahan kau Thaakur kahataa ||
verses.translation: That stone, which he calls his god,

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਪਾਹਣੁ ਲੈ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਡੁਬਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oh paahan lai us kau ddubataa ||2||
verses.translation: that stone pulls him down and drowns him. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: gunahagaar loon haraamee ||
verses.translation: O sinner, you are untrue to your own self;

verses.original: ਪਾਹਣ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਪਾਰਗਿਰਾਮੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paahan naav na paaragiraamee ||3||
verses.translation: a boat of stone will not carry you across. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil naanak Thaakur jaataa ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Guru, O Nanak, I know my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal pooran bidhaataa ||4||3||9||
verses.translation: The Perfect Architect of Destiny is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky. ||4||3||9||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਵਨ ਗਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: laalan raaviaa kavan gatee ree ||
verses.translation: How have you enjoyed your Dear Beloved?

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਮਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sakhee bataavahu mujheh matee ree ||1||
verses.translation: O sister, please teach me, please show me. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਬ ਸੂਹਵੀ ॥ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soohab soohab soohavee || apane preetam kai ra(n)g ratee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Crimson, crimson, crimson - this is the color of the soul-bride who is imbued with the Love of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੈਨ ਭਤੀਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: paav malovau sa(n)g nain bhateeree ||
verses.translation: I wash Your Feet with my eye-lashes.

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਪਠਾਵਹੁ ਜਾਂਉ ਤਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jahaa paThaavahu jaa(n)au tatee ree ||2||
verses.translation: Wherever You send me, there I will go. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਦੇਉ ਜਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam dheau jatee ree ||
verses.translation: I would trade meditation, austerity, self-discipline and celibacy,

verses.original: ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eik nimakh milaavahu moh praanapatee ree ||3||
verses.translation: if I could only meet the Lord of my life, for even an instant. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਹਤੀ ਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: maan taan aha(n)budh hatee ree ||
verses.translation: She who eradicates her self-conceit, power and arrogant intellect,

verses.original: ਸਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਵਤੀ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: saa naanak sohaagavatee ree ||4||4||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is the true soul-bride. ||4||4||10||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) jeevan too(n) praan adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are my Life, the very Support of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tujh hee pekh pekh man saadhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon You, beholding You, my mind is soothed and comforted. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) saajan too(n) preetam meraa ||
verses.translation: You are my Friend, You are my Beloved.

verses.original: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chiteh na bisareh kaahoo beraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I shall never forget You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਹਉ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bai khareedh hau dhaasaro teraa ||
verses.translation: I am Your indentured servant; I am Your slave.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਭਾਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too(n) bhaaro Thaakur gunee gaheraa ||2||
verses.translation: You are my Great Lord and Master, the treasure of excellence. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਸ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koT dhaas jaa kai dharabaare ||
verses.translation: There are millions of servants in Your Court - Your Royal Darbaar.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nimakh nimakh vasai tin(h) naale ||3||
verses.translation: Each and every instant, You dwell with them. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau kichh naahee sabh kichh teraa ||
verses.translation: I am nothing; everything is Yours.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: ot pot naanak sa(n)g baseraa ||4||5||11||
verses.translation: Through and through, You abide with Nanak. ||4||5||11||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਮਹਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਊਚ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sookh mahal jaa ke uooch dhuaare ||
verses.translation: His Mansions are so comfortable, and His gates are so lofty.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa meh vaaseh bhagat piaare ||1||
verses.translation: Within them, His beloved devotees dwell. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj kathaa prabh kee at meeThee ||
verses.translation: The Natural Speech of God is so very sweet.

verses.original: ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਡੀਠੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: viralai kaahoo netrahu ddeeThee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How rare is that person, who sees it with his eyes. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਹ ਗੀਤ ਨਾਦ ਅਖਾਰੇ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh geet naadh akhaare sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: There, in the arena of the congregation, the divine music of the Naad, the sound current, is sung.

verses.original: ਊਹਾ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: uoohaa sa(n)t kareh har ra(n)gaa ||2||
verses.translation: There, the Saints celebrate with their Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਤਹ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹਰਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: teh maran na jeevan sog na harakhaa ||
verses.translation: Neither birth nor death is there, neither pain nor pleasure.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਰਖਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saach naam kee a(n)mirat varakhaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name rains down there. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: guhaj kathaa ieh gur te jaanee ||
verses.translation: From the Guru, I have come to know the mystery of this speech.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bolai har har baanee ||4||6||12||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||12||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai dharas paap koT utaare ||
verses.translation: By the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, millions of sins are erased.

verses.original: ਭੇਟਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bheTat sa(n)g ih bhavajal taare ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with them, this terrifying world-ocean is crossed over||1||

verses.original: ਓਇ ਸਾਜਨ ਓਇ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: oi saajan oi meet piaare ||
verses.translation: They are my companions, and they are my dear friends,

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo ham kau har naam chitaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: who inspire me to remember the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa sabadh sunat sukh saare ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Word of His Shabad, I am totally at peace.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kee Tahal jamadhoot bidhaare ||2||
verses.translation: When I serve Him, the Messenger of Death is chased away. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਧੀਰਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee dheerak is maneh sadhaare ||
verses.translation: His comfort and consolation soothes and supports my mind.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran mukh ujalaare ||3||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, my face is radiant and bright. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ke sevak prabh aap savaare ||
verses.translation: God embellishes and supports His servants.

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: saran naanak tin(h) sadh balihaare ||4||7||13||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Protection of their Sanctuary; he is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||7||13||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: rahan na paaveh sur nar dhevaa ||
verses.translation: The angelic beings and demi-gods are not permitted to remain here.

verses.original: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: uooTh sidhaare kar mun jan sevaa ||1||
verses.translation: The silent sages and humble servants also must arise and depart. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਪੇਖੇ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat pekhe jin(h)ee har har dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Only those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, are seen to live on.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g tin(h)ee dharasan paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਮਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: baadhisaeh saeh vaapaaree maranaa ||
verses.translation: Kings, emperors and merchants must die.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਖਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so kaaleh kharanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Whoever is seen shall be consumed by death. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kooRai moh lapaT lapaTaanaa ||
verses.translation: Mortal beings are entangled, clinging to false worldly attachments.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhodd chaliaa taa fir pachhutaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: And when they must leave them behind, then they regret and grieve. ||3||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidhaan naanak kau karahu dhaat ||
verses.translation: O Lord, O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with this gift,

verses.translit: naam teraa japee dhin raat ||4||8||14||
verses.translation: that he may chant Your Name, day and night. ||4||8||14||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਬਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar tumeh basaare ||
verses.translation: You dwell deep within the heart of each and every being.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸੂਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal samagree soot tumaare ||1||
verses.translation: The entire universe is strung on Your Thread. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) preetam too(n) praan adhaare ||
verses.translation: You are my Beloved, the Support of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum hee pekh pekh man bigasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Beholding You, gazing upon You, my mind blossoms forth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anik jon bhram bhram bhram haare ||
verses.translation: Wandering, wandering, wandering through countless incarnations, I have grown so weary.

verses.original: ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਅਬ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: oT gahee ab saadh sa(n)gaare ||2||
verses.translation: Now, I hold tight to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar alakh apaare ||
verses.translation: You are inaccessible, incomprehensible, invisible and infinite.

verses.translit: naanak simarai dhin rainaare ||3||9||15||
verses.translation: Nanak remembers You in meditation, day and night. ||3||9||15||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kaaj maiaa vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: What is the use of the glory of Maya?

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kau binasat baar na kaiee ||1||
verses.translation: It disappears in no time at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਸੋਵਤ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih supanaa sovat nahee jaanai ||
verses.translation: This is a dream, but the sleeper does not know it.

verses.original: ਅਚੇਤ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: achet bivasathaa meh lapaTaanai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In his unconscious state, he clings to it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa moh mohio gaavaaraa ||
verses.translation: The poor fool is enticed by the great attachments of the world.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਤ ਪੇਖਤ ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pekhat pekhat uooTh sidhaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Gazing upon them, watching them, he must still arise and depart. ||2||

verses.original: ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: uooch te uooch taa kaa dharabaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Royal Court of His Darbaar is the highest of the high.

verses.original: ਕਈ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਨਾਹਿ ਉਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kiee ja(n)t binaeh upaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: He creates and destroys countless beings. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੂਸਰ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoosar hoaa naa ko hoiee ||
verses.translation: There has never been any other, and there shall never be.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jap naanak prabh eko soiee ||4||10||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the One God. ||4||10||16||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar taa kau hau jeevaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan kamal tere dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
verses.translation: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in the wash water. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: so har meraa a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: He is my Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kai sa(n)g suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master abides with His humble devotees. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun a(n)mirat naam dhiaavaa ||
verses.translation: Hearing, hearing Your Ambrosial Naam, I meditate on it.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar tere gun gaavaa ||2||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਲੀਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh leelaa man aana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Beholding, beholding Your divine play, my mind is in bliss.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gun apaar prabh paramaana(n)dhaa ||3||
verses.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are infinite, O God, O Lord of supreme bliss. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran kachh bhau na biaapai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on Him, fear cannot touch me.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa naanak har jaapai ||4||11||17||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, Nanak meditates on the Lord. ||4||11||17||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bachan ridhai dhiaan dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Within my heart, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rasanaa jaap japau banavaaree ||1||
verses.translation: With my tongue, I chant the Chant of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: safal moorat dharasan balihaaree ||
verses.translation: The image of His vision is fruitful; I am a sacrifice to it.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal man praan adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His Lotus Feet are the Support of the mind, the Support of the very breath of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g janam maran nivaaree ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the cycle of birth and death is ended.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰਨ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat kathaa sun karan adhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: To hear the Ambrosial Sermon is the support of my ears. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh tajaaree ||
verses.translation: I have renounced sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਸੁਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhiraR naam dhaan isanaan suchaaree ||3||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the Naam within myself, with charity, true cleansing and righteous conduct. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ih tat beechaaree ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have contemplated this essence of reality;

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: raam naam jap paar utaaree ||4||12||18||
verses.translation: chanting the Name of the Lord, I am carried across. ||4||12||18||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: lobh moh magan aparaadhee ||
verses.translation: The sinner is absorbed in greed and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਕਰਣਹਾਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਸਾਧੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karanahaar kee sev na saadhee ||1||
verses.translation: He has not performed any service to the Creator Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan prabh naam tumaare ||
verses.translation: O God, Your Name is the Purifier of sinners.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raakh leh moh niraguneeaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am worthless - please save me! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaataa prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: O God, You are the Great Giver, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaachee dheh maanukh abhimaanee ||2||
verses.translation: The body of the egotistical human is perishable. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਆਦ ਬਾਦ ਈਰਖ ਮਦ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: suaadh baadh ieerakh madh maiaa ||
verses.translation: Tastes and pleasures, conflicts and jealousy, and intoxication with Maya

verses.original: ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ein sa(n)g laag ratan janam gavaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: - attached to these, the jewel of human life is wasted. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bha(n)jan jagajeevan har raiaa ||
verses.translation: The Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of pain, the Life of the world.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: sagal tiaag naanak saranaiaa ||4||13||19||
verses.translation: Forsaking everything, Nanak has entered His Sanctuary. ||4||13||19||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੇਖਤ ਚਾਖਤ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਅੰਧਾ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: pekhat chaakhat kaheeat a(n)dhaa suneeat suneeaai naahee ||
verses.translation: He sees with his eyes, but he is called blind; he hears, but he does not hear.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nikaT vasat kau jaanai dhoore paapee paap kamaahee ||1||
verses.translation: And the One who dwells near at hand, he thinks that He is far away; the sinner is committing sins. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: so kichh kar jit chhuTeh paraanee ||
verses.translation: Do only those deeds which will save you, O mortal being.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam jap a(n)mirat baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘੋਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghor mahal sadhaa ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: You are forever imbued with the love of horses and mansions.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g tum(h)aarai kachhoo na jaataa ||2||
verses.translation: Nothing shall go along with you. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਖਹਿ ਪੋਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਂਡਾ ॥
verses.translit: rakheh pochaar maaTee kaa bhaa(n)ddaa ||
verses.translation: You may clean and decorate the vessel of clay,

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਮ ਡਾਂਡਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: at kucheel milai jam ddaa(n)ddaa ||3||
verses.translation: but it is so very filthy; it shall receive its punishment from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh baadhaa ||
verses.translation: You are bound by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਗਰਤ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mahaa garat meh nigharat jaataa ||4||
verses.translation: You are sinking down into the great pit. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kee aradhaas suneejai ||
verses.translation: Hear this prayer of Nanak, O Lord;

verses.original: ਡੂਬਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: ddoobat paahan prabh mere leejai ||5||14||20||
verses.translation: I am a stone, sinking down - please, rescue me! ||5||14||20||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai bujhai prabh soi ||
verses.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive understands God.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis jan karam paraapat hoi ||1||
verses.translation: He meets that humble being according to the karma of his past actions. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਇਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sun saajan iau dhutar tareeaai ||
verses.translation: Listen, O friend - this is how to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo har naam uchareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meet with the Holy, and chant the Lord's Name||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: ek binaa dhoojaa nahee jaanai ||
verses.translation: There is no other to know, except for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar paarabraham pachhaanai ||2||
verses.translation: So realize that the Supreme Lord God is within each and every heart. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karai soiee bhal maanai ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, accept that as good.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aadh a(n)t kee keemat jaanai ||3||
verses.translation: Know the value of the beginning and the end. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis jan balihaaree ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that humble being,

verses.translit: jaa kai hiradhai vaseh muraaree ||4||15||21||
verses.translation: within whose heart the Lord dwells. ||4||15||21||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur paramesar karanaihaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal sirasaT kau dhe aadhaar ||1||
verses.translation: He gives His Support to the entire Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan kamal man dhiaai ||
verses.translation: Meditate within your mind on the Lotus Feet of the Guru.

verses.original: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh is tan te jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Pain and suffering shall leave this body. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhavajal ddoobat satigur kaaddai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru saves the drowning being from the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਟੂਟਾ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa TooTaa gaaddai ||2||
verses.translation: He reunites those who were separated for countless incarnations. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa karahu dhin raat ||
verses.translation: Serve the Guru, day and night.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਮਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj man aavai saa(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: Your mind shall come to have peace, pleasure and poise. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee ren vaddabhaagee paavai ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one obtains the dust of the feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gur kau sadh bal jaavai ||4||16||22||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||4||16||22||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur apune uoopar bal jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har har jas gaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: simarau so prabh apanaa suaamee ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on God, your Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal ghaTaa kaa a(n)tarajaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau laagee preet ||
verses.translation: So love the Lord's Lotus Feet,

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachee pooran niramal reet ||2||
verses.translation: and live a lifestyle which is true, perfect and spotless. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh vasai man maahee ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind,

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh jaahee ||3||
verses.translation: and the sins of countless incarnations are eradicated. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Please be Merciful, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

verses.translit: naanak maagai sa(n)t ravaalaa ||4||17||23||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||17||23||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekh jeevaa gur teraa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pooran karam hoi prabh meraa ||1||
verses.translation: My karma is perfect, O my God. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eeh bena(n)tee sun prabh mere ||
verses.translation: Please, listen to this prayer, O my God.

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਚੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheh naam kar apane chere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me Your chaylaa, Your disciple. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: apanee saran raakh prabh dhaate ||
verses.translation: Please keep me under Your Protection, O God, O Great Giver.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh kinai viralai jaate ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, a few people understand this. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sunahu binau prabh mere meetaa ||
verses.translation: Please hear my prayer, O God, my Friend.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal vaseh merai cheetaa ||3||
verses.translation: May Your Lotus Feet abide within my consciousness. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ek karai aradhaas ||
verses.translation: Nanak makes one prayer:

verses.original: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: visar naahee pooran gunataas ||4||18||24||
verses.translation: may I never forget You, O perfect treasure of virtue. ||4||18||24||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੀਤੁ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meet saajan sut ba(n)dhap bhaiee ||
verses.translation: He is my friend, companion, child, relative and sibling.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jat kat pekhau har sa(n)g sahaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord as my companion and helper. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jat meree pat meree dhan har naam ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is my social status, my honor and wealth.

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਸਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh bisaraam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is my pleasure, poise, bliss and peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਨਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jap pahir sanaeh ||
verses.translation: I have strapped on the armor of meditation on the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਆਵਧ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੇਧਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koT aavadh tis bedhat naeh ||2||
verses.translation: It cannot be pierced, even by millions of weapons. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਟ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har charan saran gaR koT hamaarai ||
verses.translation: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet is my fortress and battlement.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਜਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਦਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaal ka(n)Tak jam tis na bidhaarai ||3||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death, the torturer, cannot demolish it. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sadhaa balihaaree ||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak is forever a sacrifice

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੰਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: sevak sa(n)t raajaa raam muraaree ||4||19||25||
verses.translation: to the selfless servants and Saints of the Sovereign Lord, the Destroyer of ego. ||4||19||25||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gun gopaal prabh ke nit gaahaa ||
verses.translation: Where the Glorious Praises of God, the Lord of the world are continually sung,

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਤਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadh binodh ma(n)gal sukh taahaa ||1||
verses.translation: there is bliss, joy, happiness and peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: chal sakhe'ee prabh raavan jaahaa ||
verses.translation: Come, O my companions - let us go and enjoy God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa kee charanee paahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Let us fall at the feet of the holy, humble beings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਛਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar benatee jan dhoor baachhaahaa ||
verses.translation: I pray for the dust of the feet of the humble.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਲਾਹਾਂ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh laahaa(n) ||2||
verses.translation: It shall wash away the sins of countless incarnations. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan praan jeeau arapaahaa ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind, body, breath of life and soul to God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਾਹਾਂ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har simar simar maan moh kaTaahaa(n) ||3||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, I have eradicated pride and emotional attachment. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਤਸਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal karahu utasaahaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, O Merciful to the meek, please give me faith and confidence,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨੦॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas har saran samaahaa ||4||20||26||
verses.translation: so that slave Nanak may remain absorbed in Your Sanctuary. ||4||20||26||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਨਗਰੁ ਜਹਾ ਸੰਤ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: baiku(n)Th nagar jahaa sa(n)t vaasaa ||
verses.translation: The city of heaven is where the Saints dwell.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh charan kamal ridh maeh nivaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: They enshrine the Lotus Feet of God within their hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: sun man tan tujh sukh dhikhalaavau ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my mind and body, and let me show you the way to find peace,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤੁਝੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੁੰਚਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har anik bi(n)jan tujh bhog bhu(n)chaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: so that you may eat and enjoy the various delicacies of the Lord||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁੰਚੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam bhu(n)ch man maahee ||
verses.translation: Taste the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your mind.

verses.original: ਅਚਰਜ ਸਾਦ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: acharaj saadh taa ke barane na jaahee ||2||
verses.translation: Its taste is wondrous - it cannot be described. ||2||

verses.original: ਲੋਭੁ ਮੂਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਿ ਥਾਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: lobh mooaa tirasanaa bujh thaakee ||
verses.translation: Your greed shall die, and your thirst shall be quenched.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kee saran jan taakee ||3||
verses.translation: The humble beings seek the Sanctuary of the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke bhai moh nivaare ||
verses.translation: The Lord dispels the fears and attachments of countless incarnations.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas prabh kirapaa dhaare ||4||21||27||
verses.translation: God has showered His Mercy and Grace upon slave Nanak. ||4||21||27||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੀਂਗ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: anik bee(n)g dhaas ke parahariaa ||
verses.translation: God covers the many shortcomings of His slaves.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh apanaa kariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Granting His Mercy, God makes them His own. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛਡਾਇ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumeh chhaddai leeo jan apanaa ||
verses.translation: You emancipate Your humble servant,

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aurajh pario jaal jag supanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and rescue him from the noose of the world, which is just a dream. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰਬਤ ਦੋਖ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: parabat dhokh mahaa bikaraalaa ||
verses.translation: Even huge mountains of sin and corruption

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khin meh dhoor ke'ee dhiaalaa ||2||
verses.translation: are removed in an instant by the Merciful Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਗ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sog rog bipat at bhaaree ||
verses.translation: Sorrow, disease and the most terrible calamities

verses.original: ਦੂਰਿ ਭਈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhoor bhiee jap naam muraaree ||3||
verses.translation: are removed by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhaar leeno laR lai ||
verses.translation: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He attaches us to the hem of His robe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: har charan gahe naanak saranai ||4||22||28||
verses.translation: Grasping the Lord's Feet, O Nanak, we enter His Sanctuary. ||4||22||28||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੀਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਦੁਨੀ ਜੋ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dheen chhaddai dhunee jo laae ||
verses.translation: One who withdraws from God's Path, and attaches himself to the world,

verses.original: ਦੁਹੀ ਸਰਾਈ ਖੁਨਾਮੀ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuhee saraiee khunaamee kahaae ||1||
verses.translation: is known as a sinner in both worlds. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan ||
verses.translation: He alone is approved, who pleases the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee kudharat aape jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only He Himself knows His creative omnipotence. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa dharam pu(n)n bhalaa karaae ||
verses.translation: One who practices truth, righteous living, charity and good deeds,

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਕੈ ਤੋਸੈ ਦੁਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheen kai tosai dhunee na jaae ||2||
verses.translation: has the supplies for God's Path. Worldly success shall not fail him. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar eko jaagai ||
verses.translation: Within and among all, the One Lord is awake.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jit jit laiaa tit tit ko laagai ||3||
verses.translation: As He attaches us, so are we attached. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar sach saahib meraa ||
verses.translation: You are inaccessible and unfathomable, O my True Lord and Master.

verses.translit: naanak bolai bolaiaa teraa ||4||23||29||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks as You inspire him to speak. ||4||23||29||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਤਹਕਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: praatahakaal har naam uchaaree ||
verses.translation: In the early hours of the morning, I chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot kee oT savaaree ||1||
verses.translation: I have fashioned a shelter for myself, here and hereafter. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa japeeaai har naam ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hoveh man ke kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and the desires of my mind are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh abinaasee rain dhin gaau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God, night and day.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeevat marat nihachal paaveh thaau ||2||
verses.translation: In life, and in death, you shall find your eternal, unchanging home. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so saahu sev jit toT na aavai ||
verses.translation: So serve the Sovereign Lord, and you shall never lack anything.

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਸੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: khaat kharachat sukh anadh vihaavai ||3||
verses.translation: While eating and consuming, you shall pass your life in peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan purakh saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
verses.translation: O Life of the World, O Primal Being, I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨੪॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh naanak naam dhiaaiaa ||4||24||30||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||24||30||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore jab bhe dhiaal ||
verses.translation: When the Perfect Guru becomes merciful,

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhukh binase pooran bhiee ghaal ||1||
verses.translation: my pains are taken away, and my works are perfectly completed. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh jeevaa dharas tum(h)aaraa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon, beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live;

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਜਾਈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal jaiee balihaaraa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin Thaakur kavan hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without You, O my Lord and Master, who belongs to me? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat siau preet ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poorab karam likhat dhur paiee ||2||
verses.translation: by the karma of my past actions and my pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: jap har har naam acharaj parataap ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; how wondrous is His glory!

verses.original: ਜਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤੀਨੇ ਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaal na saakeh teene taap ||3||
verses.translation: The three types of illness cannot consume it. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nimakh na bisareh har charan tum(h)aare ||
verses.translation: May I never forget, even for an instant, the Lord's Feet.

verses.translit: naanak maagai dhaan piaare ||4||25||31||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for this gift, O my Beloved. ||4||25||31||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: se sa(n)jog karahu mere piaare ||
verses.translation: May there be such an auspicious time, O my Beloved,

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit rasanaa har naam uchaare ||1||
verses.translation: when, with my tongue, I may chant the Lord's Name||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun benatee prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: Hear my prayer, O God, O Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਸਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh gaaveh gun sadhaa rasaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Holy Saints ever sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan roop simaran prabh teraa ||
verses.translation: Your meditation and remembrance is life-giving, God.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis kirapaa kareh baseh tis neraa ||2||
verses.translation: You dwell near those upon whom You show mercy. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee bhookh teraa naam ahaar ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the food to satisfy the hunger of Your humble servants.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhaataa prabh dhevanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver, O Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam ramat sa(n)tan sukh maanaa ||
verses.translation: The Saints take pleasure in repeating the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhevanahaar sujaanaa ||4||26||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord, the Great Giver, is All-knowing. ||4||26||32||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਹਤੀ ਜਾਤ ਕਦੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਧਾਰਤ ॥
verses.translit: bahatee jaat kadhe dhirasaT na dhaarat ||
verses.translation: Your life is slipping away, but you never even notice.

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਰਚ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mithiaa moh ba(n)dheh nit paarach ||1||
verses.translation: You are constantly entangled in false attachments and conflicts. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਭਜੁ ਦਿਨ ਨਿਤ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: maadhave bhaj dhin nit rainee ||
verses.translation: Meditate, vibrate constantly, day and night, on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath jeet har saranee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You shall be victorious in this priceless human life, in the Protection of the Lord's Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੋਊ ਕਰ ਝਾਰਤ ॥ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਧਾਰਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karat bikaar dhouoo kar jhaarat || raam ratan ridh til nahee dhaarat ||2||
verses.translation: You eagerly commit sins and practice corruption, but you do not enshrine the jewel of the Lord's Name within your heart, even for an instant. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਰਣ ਪੋਖਣ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bharan pokhan sa(n)g aaudh bihaanee ||
verses.translation: Feeding and pampering your body, your life is passing away,

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jai jagadhees kee gat nahee jaanee ||3||
verses.translation: but you do not experience the state of victory of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: saran samarath agochar suaamee ||
verses.translation: So enter the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Unfathomable Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: audhar naanak prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||4||27||33||
verses.translation: O God, O Searcher of hearts, please, save Nanak! ||4||27||33||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g tarai bhai saagar ||
verses.translation: Cross over the terrifying world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har naam simar ratanaagar ||1||
verses.translation: Remember in meditation the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the source of jewels. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar jeevaa naarain ||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, I live.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh rog sog sabh binase gur poore mil paap tajain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All pain, disease and suffering is dispelled, meeting the Perfect Guru; sin has been eradicated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan padhavee har kaa naau ||
verses.translation: The immortal status is obtained through the Name of the Lord;

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal saach suaau ||2||
verses.translation: the mind and body become spotless and pure, which is the true purpose of life. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar paarabraham dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poorab likhat hoi taa paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, the Name is obtained. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਜਪਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: saran pe jap dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: I have entered His Sanctuary, and I meditate on the Lord, Merciful to the meek.

verses.translit: naanak jaachai sa(n)t ravaalaa ||4||28||34||
verses.translation: Nanak longs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||28||34||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਰੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar kaa kaaj na jaanee rooRaa ||
verses.translation: The beautiful one does not know the work of his own home.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਰਚਿਓ ਮੂੜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhooThai dha(n)dhai rachio mooRaa ||1||
verses.translation: The fool is engrossed in false attachments. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit too(n) laaveh tit tit laganaa ||
verses.translation: As You attach us, so we are attached.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too(n) dheh teraa naau japanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When You bless us with Your Name, we chant it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke dhaas har setee raate ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slaves are imbued with the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam rasain anadhin maate ||2||
verses.translation: They are intoxicated with the Lord, night and day. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥
verses.translit: baeh pakar prabh aape kaadde ||
verses.translation: Reaching out to grasp hold of our arms, God lifts us up.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਟੂਟੇ ਗਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke TooTe gaadde ||3||
verses.translation: Separated for countless incarnations, we are united with Him again. ||3||

verses.original: ਉਧਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: audhar suaamee prabh kirapaa dhaare ||
verses.translation: Save me, O God, O my Lord and Master - shower me with Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas har saran dhuaare ||4||29||35||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door, O Lord. ||4||29||35||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh nihachal ghar paiaa ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found my eternal home.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੋੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh fir nahee dduolaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have found total peace, and I shall not waver again. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੑੇ ॥
verses.translit: guroo dhiaai har charan man cheen(h)e ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Guru, and the Lord's Feet, within my mind.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa te karatai asathir keen(h)e ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this way, the Creator Lord has made me steady and stable. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat achut abinaasee ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the unchanging, eternal Lord God,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa te kaaTee jam kee faasee ||2||
verses.translation: and the noose of death is snapped. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੀਨੇ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa leene laR laae ||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy, he has attached me to the hem of His robe.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥੩੦॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: sadhaa anadh naanak gun gaae ||3||30||36||
verses.translation: In constant bliss, Nanak sings His Glorious Praises. ||3||30||36||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat bachan saadh kee baanee ||
verses.translation: The Words, the Teachings of the Holy Saints, are Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo japai tis kee gat hovai har har naam nit rasan bakhaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on the Lord's Name is emancipated; he chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with his tongue. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: kalee kaal ke miTe kalesaa ||
verses.translation: The pains and sufferings of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga are eradicated,

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eko naam man meh paravesaa ||1||
verses.translation: when the One Name abides within the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo dhoor mukh masatak laiee ||
verses.translation: I apply the dust of the feet of the Holy to my face and forehead.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੩੧॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: naanak udhare har gur saranaiee ||2||31||37||
verses.translation: Nanak has been saved, in the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord. ||2||31||37||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla: Third House:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dhaa gun gaau dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dheh pooran kirapaalaa || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Perfect, Compassionate Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa tum hee pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: Please, grant Your Grace, and cherish me.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tumaraa maalaa ||1||
verses.translation: My soul and body are all Your property. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਲੈ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam chalai jap naalaa ||
verses.translation: Only meditation on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, will go along with you.

verses.translit: naanak jaachai sa(n)t ravaalaa ||2||32||38||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||2||32||38||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: Without Him, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਥੰਮੈ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape tha(n)mai sachaa soiee ||1||
verses.translation: The True Lord Himself is our anchor. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam meraa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is our only support.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Creator, the Cause of causes, is All-powerful and Infinite. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਾਵੇ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh rog miTaave navaa niroaa ||
verses.translation: He has eradicated all illness, and healed me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਖਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥੩੩॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: naanak rakhaa aape hoaa ||2||33||39||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself has become my Savior. ||2||33||39||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan kau lochai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag paraapat hoiee || rahaau ||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, it is obtained. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਤਜਿ ਨੀਦ ਕਿਉ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: siaam su(n)dhar taj needh kiau aaiee ||
verses.translation: Forsaking the Beautiful Lord, how can they go to sleep?

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਦੂਤਾ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa mohanee dhootaa laiee ||1||
verses.translation: The great enticer Maya has led them down the path of sin. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹਾ ਕਰਤ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prem bichhohaa karat kasaiee ||
verses.translation: This butcher has separated them from the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਦੈ ਜੰਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: niradhai ja(n)t tis dhiaa na paiee ||2||
verses.translation: This merciless one shows no mercy at all to the poor beings. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬੀਤੀਅਨ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anik janam beeteean bharamaiee ||
verses.translation: Countless lifetimes have passed away, wandering aimlessly.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੁਤਰ ਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ghar vaas na dhevai dhutar maiee ||3||
verses.translation: The terrible, treacherous Maya does not even allow them to dwell in their own home. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain apanaa keeaa paiee ||
verses.translation: Day and night, they receive the rewards of their own actions.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਭਵਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kis dhos na dheejai kirat bhavaiee ||4||
verses.translation: Don't blame anyone else; your own actions lead you astray. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sun saajan sa(n)t jan bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Listen, O Friend, O Saint, O humble Sibling of Destiny:

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥੩੪॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: charan saran naanak gat paiee ||5||34||40||
verses.translation: in the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found Salvation. ||5||34||40||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭਲੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਛਾਪਰੀ ਜਾ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhalee suhaavee chhaaparee jaa meh gun gaae ||
verses.translation: Even a crude hut is sublime and beautiful, if the Lord's Praises are sung within it.

verses.original: ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kit hee kaam na dhaulahar jit har bisaraae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those mansions where the Lord is forgotten are useless. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadh gareebee saadhasa(n)g jit prabh chit aae ||
verses.translation: Even poverty is bliss, if God comes to mind in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਏਹੁ ਬਡਪਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jal jaau eh baddapanaa maiaa lapaTaae ||1||
verses.translation: This worldly glory might just as well burn; it only traps the mortals in Maya. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੀਸਨੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਓਢਿ ਕਾਮਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: peesan pees odd kaamaree sukh man sa(n)tokhaae ||
verses.translation: One may have to grind corn, and wear a coarse blanket, but still, one can find peace of mind and contentment.

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaiso raaj na kitai kaaj jit neh tirapataae ||2||
verses.translation: Even empires are of no use at all, if they do not bring satisfaction. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nagan firat ra(n)g ek kai oh sobhaa paae ||
verses.translation: Someone may wander around naked, but if he loves the One Lord, he receives honor and respect.

verses.original: ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਰਚਿ ਲੋਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paaT paTa(n)bar birathiaa jeh rach lobhaae ||3||
verses.translation: Silk and satin clothes are worthless, if they lead to greed. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh tum(h)rai haath prabh aap kare karaae ||
verses.translation: Everything is in Your Hands, God. You Yourself are the Doer, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: saas saas simarat rahaa naanak dhaan paae ||4||1||41||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, may I continue to remember You. Please, bless Nanak with this gift. ||4||1||41||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਪਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਨਿਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa sa(n)t paraan dhan tis kaa panihaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Saint is my life and wealth. I am his water-carrier.

verses.original: ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaiee meet sut sagal te jeea hoo(n) te piaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is dearer to me than all my siblings, friends and children. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਚਉਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: kesaa kaa kar beejanaa sa(n)t chaur ddulaavau ||
verses.translation: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over the Saint.

verses.original: ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਚਰਣ ਤਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sees nihaarau charan tal dhoor mukh laavau ||1||
verses.translation: I bow my head low, to touch his feet, and apply his dust to my face. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਸਟ ਬਚਨ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਉ ਦੀਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: misaT bachan benatee karau dheen kee niaaiee ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayer with sweet words, in sincere humility.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taj abhimaan saranee parau har gun nidh paiee ||2||
verses.translation: Renouncing egotism, I enter His Sanctuary. I have found the Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਵਲੋਕਨ ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: avalokan puneh puneh karau jan kaa dharasaar ||
verses.translation: I gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant, again and again.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਉ ਬੰਦਉ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat bachan man meh si(n)chau ba(n)dhau baar baar ||3||
verses.translation: I cherish and gather in His Ambrosial Words within my mind; time and time again, I bow to Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਕਰਉ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਗਉ ॥
verses.translit: chitavau man aasaa karau jan kaa sa(n)g maagau ||
verses.translation: In my mind, I wish, hope and beg for the Society of the Lord's humble servants.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh dhiaa kar dhaas charanee laagau ||4||2||42||
verses.translation: Be Merciful to Nanak, O God, and lead him to the feet of Your slaves. ||4||2||42||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਤਾਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin mohe brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd taahoo meh paau ||
verses.translation: She has enticed the worlds and solar systems; I have fallen into her clutches.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raakh leh ih bikhiee jeeau dheh apunaa naau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please save this corrupt soul of mine; please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te naahee ko sukhee taa kai paachhai jaau ||
verses.translation: She has not brought anyone peace, but still, I chase after her.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhodd jaeh jo sagal kau fir fir lapaTaau ||1||
verses.translation: She forsakes everyone, but still, I cling to her, again and again. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karahu kirapaa karunaapate tere har gun gaau ||
verses.translation: Have Mercy on me, O Lord of Compassion; please let me sing Your Glorious Praises, O Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: naanak kee prabh benatee saadhasa(n)g samaau ||2||3||43||
verses.translation: This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord, that he may join and merge with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||3||43||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa paRataal
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House, Partaal:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੁਰੀਆ ਮੋਹਨ ਲਾਲਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: preet preet gureeaa mohan laalanaa ||
verses.translation: Love of the enticing Beloved Lord is the most glorious love.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਏਕੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੰਤ ਲਾਗੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਛਾਡੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਕੁਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap man gobi(n)dh ekai avar nahee ko lekhai sa(n)t laag maneh chhaadd dhubidhaa kee kureeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O mind, on the One Lord of the Universe - nothing else is of any account. Attach your mind to the Saints, and abandon the path of duality. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਹਰੀਆ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਧਰੀਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀਆ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿਨ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: niragun hareeaa saragun dhareeaa anik koThareeaa bhi(n)n bhi(n)n bhi(n)n bhin kareeaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is absolute and unmanifest; He has assumed the most sublime manifestation. He has fashioned countless body chambers of many, varied, different, myriad forms.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਮਨ ਕੋਟਵਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: vich man koTavareeaa ||
verses.translation: Within them, the mind is the policeman;

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਪਿਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: nij ma(n)dhar pireeaa ||
verses.translation: my Beloved lives in the temple of my inner self.

verses.original: ਤਹਾ ਆਨਦ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tahaa aanadh kareeaa ||
verses.translation: He plays there in ecstasy.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਮਰੀਆ ਨਹ ਜਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: neh mareeaa neh jareeaa ||1||
verses.translation: He does not die, and he never grows old. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤਨਿ ਜੁਰੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੀਆ ਪਰ ਕਉ ਹਿਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kiratan jureeaa bahu bidh fireeaa par kau hireeaa ||
verses.translation: He is engrossed in worldly activities, wandering around in various ways. He steals the property of others,

verses.original: ਬਿਖਨਾ ਘਿਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bikhanaa ghireeaa ||
verses.translation: and is surrounded by corruption and sin.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ab saadhoo sa(n)g pareeaa ||
verses.translation: But now, he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਖਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dhuaarai khareeaa ||
verses.translation: and stands before the Lord's Gate.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan kareeaa ||
verses.translation: He obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gur mireeaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak has met the Guru;

verses.translit: bahur na fireeaa ||2||1||44||
verses.translation: he shall not be reincarnated again. ||2||1||44||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਸਿ ਮੰਡਲੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਖਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raas ma(n)ddal keeno aakhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has made this world a stage;

verses.original: ਸਗਲੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਰਖਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagalo saaj rakhio paasaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He fashioned the expanse of the entire creation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh roop ra(n)g aapaaraa ||
verses.translation: He fashioned it in various ways, with limitless colors and forms.

verses.original: ਪੇਖੈ ਖੁਸੀ ਭੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pekhai khusee bhog nahee haaraa ||
verses.translation: He watches over it with joy, and He never tires of enjoying it.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh ras lait basat niraaraa ||1||
verses.translation: He enjoys all the delights, and yet He remains unattached. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baran chihan naahee mukh na maasaaraa ||
verses.translation: He has no color, no sign, no mouth and no beard.

verses.original: ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahan na jaiee khel tuhaaraa ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe Your play.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: naanak ren sa(n)t charanaaraa ||2||2||45||
verses.translation: Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||45||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਉ ਮੈ ਆਇਆ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tau mai aaiaa saranee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have come to You. I have come to Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਭਰੋਸੈ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bharosai aaiaa kirapaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have come to place my faith in You. I have come seeking Mercy.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee maarag gureh paThaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If it pleases You, save me, O my Lord and Master. The Guru has placed me upon the Path. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mahaa dhutar maiaa || jaise pavan jhulaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Maya is very treacherous and difficult to pass through. It is like a violent wind-storm. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਹੀ ਡਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sun sun hee ddaraiaa ||
verses.translation: I am so afraid to hear

verses.original: ਕਰਰੋ ਧ੍ਰਮਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kararo dhramaraiaa ||2||
verses.translation: that the Righteous Judge of Dharma is so strict and stern. ||2||

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gireh a(n)dh koopaiaa ||
verses.translation: The world is a deep, dark pit;

verses.original: ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਗਰਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paavak sagaraiaa ||3||
verses.translation: it is all on fire. ||3||

verses.original: ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਸਾਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gahee oT saadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the Support of the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naanak har dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak meditates on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: ab mai pooraa paiaa ||4||3||46||
verses.translation: Now, I have found the Perfect Lord. ||4||3||46||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀਆ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur paas bena(n)teeaa milai naam aadhaaraa ||
verses.translation: I offer this prayer to the True Guru, to bless me with the sustenance of the Naam.

verses.original: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tuThaa sachaa paatisaahu taap giaa sa(n)saaraa ||1||
verses.translation: When the True King is pleased, the world is rid of its diseases. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kee Tek too(n) sa(n)taa kee oT too(n) sachaa sirajanahaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Support of Your devotees, and the Shelter of the Saints, O True Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach teree saamagaree sach teraa dharabaaraa ||
verses.translation: True are Your devices, and True is Your Court.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਖਾਜੀਨਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach tere khaajeeniaa sach teraa paasaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: True are Your treasures, and True is Your expanse. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa roop aga(n)m hai anoop teraa dharasaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Form is inaccessible, and Your Vision is incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: hau kurabaanee teriaa sevakaa jin(h) har naam piaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your servants; they love Your Name, O Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭੇ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabhe ichhaa pooreeaa jaa paiaa agam apaaraa ||
verses.translation: All desires are fulfilled, when the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਚਰਣਾ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: gur naanak miliaa paarabraham teriaa charanaa kau balihaaraa ||4||1||47||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak has met the Supreme Lord God; I am a sacrifice to Your Feet. ||4||1||47||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਾਇਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa bhaanaa toohai manaieh jis no hoh dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: He alone obeys Your Will, O Lord, unto whom You are Merciful.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saiee bhagat jo tudh bhaavai too(n) sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: That alone is devotional worship, which is pleasing to Your Will. You are the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸੰਤਾ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam rai sa(n)taa Tek tum(h)aaree ||
verses.translation: O my Sovereign Lord, You are the Support of the Saints.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai so paravaan man tan toohai adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases You, they accept. You are the sustenance of their minds and bodies. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) dhiaal kirapaal kirapaa nidh manasaa pooranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the fulfiller of our hopes.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੂੰ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat tere sabh praanapat preetam too(n) bhagatan kaa piaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Beloved Lord of life of all Your devotees; You are the Beloved of Your devotees. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: too athaahu apaar at uoochaa koiee avar na teree bhaate ||
verses.translation: You are unfathomable, infinite, lofty and exalted. There is no one else like You.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eeh aradhaas hamaaree suaamee visar naahee sukhadhaate ||3||
verses.translation: This is my prayer, O my Lord and Master; may I never forget You, O Peace-giving Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain saas saas gun gaavaa je suaamee tudh bhaavaa ||
verses.translation: Day and night, with each and every breath, I sing Your Glorious Praises, if it is pleasing to Your Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: naam teraa sukh naanak maagai saahib tuThai paavaa ||4||1||48||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the peace of Your Name, O Lord and Master; as it is pleasing to Your Will, I shall attain it. ||4||1||48||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: visareh naahee jit too kabahoo so thaan teraa kehaa ||
verses.translation: Where is that place, where You are never forgotten, Lord?

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar jit tudh dhiaaiee niramal hovai dhehaa ||1||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate on You, and their bodies become spotless and pure. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਉ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਭਾਲਣ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam hau so thaan bhaalan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: O my Lord, I have come searching for that place.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat bhiaa saadhasa(n)g tin(h) saranaiee paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: After seeking and searching, I found Sanctuary in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਹਾਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bedh paRe paR brahame haare ik til nahee keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: Reading and reciting the Vedas, Brahma grew weary, but he did not find even a tiny bit of God's worth.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਭੀ ਮੋਹੇ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh fireh bilalaate te bhee mohe maiee ||2||
verses.translation: The seekers and Siddhas wander around bewailing; they too are enticed by Maya. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਰਾਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੇ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhas aautaar raaje hoi varate mahaadhev aaudhootaa ||
