verses.translation: There were ten regal incarnations of Vishnu; and then there was Shiva, the renunciate.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਾਇ ਥਕੇ ਬਿਭੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin(h) bhee a(n)t na paio teraa lai thake bibhootaa ||3||
verses.translation: He did not find Your limits either, although he grew weary of smearing his body with ashes. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sookh aana(n)dh naam ras har sa(n)tee ma(n)gal gaiaa ||
verses.translation: Peace, poise and bliss are found in the subtle essence of the Naam. The Lord's Saints sing the songs of joy.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: safal dharasan bheTio gur naanak taa man tan har har dhiaaiaa ||4||2||49||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Fruitful Vision of Guru Nanak's Darshan, and with my mind and body I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||49||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਜੋ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਲੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam paakha(n)dd jo dheeseh tin jam jaagaatee looTai ||
verses.translation: The religious rites, rituals and hypocrisies which are seen, are plundered by the Messenger of Death, the ultimate tax collector.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nirabaan keeratan gaavahu karate kaa nimakh simarat jit chhooTai ||1||
verses.translation: In the state of Nirvaanaa, sing the Kirtan of the Creator's Praises; contemplating Him in meditation, even for an instant, one is saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu saagar paar utareeaai ||
verses.translation: O Saints, cross over the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: je ko bachan kamaavai sa(n)tan kaa so gur parasaadhee tareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who practices the Teachings of the Saints, by Guru's Grace, is carried across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: koT teerath majan isanaanaa is kal meh mail bhareejai ||
verses.translation: Millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage only fill the mortal with filth in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jo har gun gaavai so niramal kar leejai ||2||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, becomes spotlessly pure. ||2||

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਇਨੑ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bedh kateb simirat sabh saasat in(h) paRiaa mukat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: One may read all the books of the Vedas, the Bible, the Simritees and the Shaastras, but they will not bring liberation.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek akhar jo gurmukh jaapai tis kee niramal soiee ||3||
verses.translation: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the One Word, acquires a spotlessly pure reputation. ||3||

verses.original: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਝਾ ॥
verses.translit: khatree braahaman soodh vais upadhes chahu varanaa kau saajhaa ||
verses.translation: The four castes - the Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas - are equal in respect to the teachings.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਉਧਰੈ ਸੋ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਝਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam japai udharai so kal meh ghaT ghaT naanak maajhaa ||4||3||50||
verses.translation: One who, as Gurmukh, chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is saved. In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, God is permeating the hearts of each and every being. ||4||3||50||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਓਇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karai soiee prabh maaneh oi raam naam ra(n)g raate ||
verses.translation: Whatever God causes to happen is accepted, by those who are attuned to the Love of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਜਿਨੑ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin(h) kee sobhaa sabhanee thaiee jin(h) prabh ke charan paraate ||1||
verses.translation: Those who fall at the Feet of God are respected everywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam har sa(n)taa jevadd na koiee ||
verses.translation: O my Lord, no one is as great as the Lord's Saints.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਿਉ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa ban aaiee prabh apane siau jal thal maheeal soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The devotees are in harmony with their God; He is in the water, the land, and the sky. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koT apraadhee sa(n)tasa(n)g udharai jam taa kai neR na aavai ||
verses.translation: Millions of sinners have been saved in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa bichhuRiaa hovai tin(h) har siau aan milaavai ||2||
verses.translation: Those who have been separated from the Lord, for countless incarnations, are reunited with the Lord again. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh bharam bhau kaaTai sa(n)t saran jo aavai ||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya, doubt and fear are eradicated, when one enters the Sanctuary of the Saints.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jehaa manorath kar aaraadhe so sa(n)tan te paavai ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever wishes one harbors, are obtained from the Saints. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee mahimaa ketak baranau jo prabh apane bhaane ||
verses.translation: How can I describe the glory of the Lord's humble servants? They are pleasing to their God.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jin satigur bheTiaa se sabh te bhe nikaane ||4||4||51||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, those who meet the True Guru, become independent of all obligations. ||4||4||51||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa agan te tudh haath dhe raakhe pe teree saranaiee ||
verses.translation: Giving me Your Hand, You saved me from the terrible fire, when I sought Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਰ ਦੂਜੀ ਆਸ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teraa maan taan ridh a(n)tar hor dhoojee aas chukaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Deep within my heart, I respect Your strength; I have abandoned all other hopes. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਐ ਉਬਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam rai tudh chit aaiaai ubare ||
verses.translation: O my Sovereign Lord, when You enter my consciousness, I am saved.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਉਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teree Tek bharavaasaa tum(h)raa jap naam tum(h)aaraa udhare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my support. I count on You. Meditating on You, I am saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਤੁਮੑ ਆਪਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop te kaadd le'ee tum(h) aap bhe kirapaalaa ||
verses.translation: You pulled me up out of the deep, dark pit. You have become merciful to me.

verses.original: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਏ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saar sam(h)aal sarab sukh dhe'ee aap kare pratipaalaa ||2||
verses.translation: You care for me, and bless me with total peace; You Yourself cherish me. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਛਡਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee nadhar kare paramesar ba(n)dhan kaaT chhaddaae ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace; breaking my bonds, He has delivered me.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aapanee bhagat prabh aap karaiee aape sevaa laae ||3||
verses.translation: God Himself inspires me to worship Him; He Himself inspires me to serve Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bharam giaa bhai moh binaase miTiaa sagal visooraa ||
verses.translation: My doubts have gone, my fears and infatuations have been dispelled, and all my sorrows are gone.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੈ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhiaa karee sukhadhaatai bheTiaa satigur pooraa ||4||5||52||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord, the Giver of peace has been merciful to me. I have met the Perfect True Guru. ||4||5||52||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਬ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab kachh na seeo tab kiaa karataa kavan karam kar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: When nothing existed, what deeds were being done? And what karma caused anyone to be born at all?

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: apanaa khel aap kar dhekhai Thaakur rachan rachaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself set His play in motion, and He Himself beholds it. He created the Creation. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam rai mujh te kachhoo na hoiee ||
verses.translation: O my Sovereign Lord, I cannot do anything at all by myself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa aap karaae sarab nira(n)tar soiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, He Himself is the Cause. He is pervading deep within all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਕਤਹੂ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਇਆਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ganatee ganee na chhooTai katahoo kaachee dheh iaanee ||
verses.translation: If my account were to be judged, I would never be saved. My body is transitory and ignorant.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kirapaa karahu prabh karanaihaare teree bakhas niraalee ||2||
verses.translation: Take pity upon me, O Creator Lord God; Your Forgiving Grace is singular and unique. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਹੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh tere keete ghaT ghaT tuhee dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: You created all beings and creatures. Each and every heart meditates on You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: teree gat mit toohai jaaneh kudharat keem na paieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Your condition and expanse are known only to You; the value of Your creative omnipotence cannot be estimated. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: niragun mugadh ajaan agiaanee karam dharam nahee jaanaa ||
verses.translation: I am worthless, foolish, thoughtless and ignorant. I know nothing about good actions and righteous living.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਿਠਾ ਲਗੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu naanak gun gaavai miThaa lagai teraa bhaanaa ||4||6||53||
verses.translation: Take pity on Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; and that Your Will may seem sweet to him. ||4||6||53||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਾਗਠੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhaagaThaRe har sa(n)t tum(h)aare jin(h) ghar dhan har naamaa ||
verses.translation: Your Saints are very fortunate; their homes are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਗਣੀ ਸੇਈ ਇਹ ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paravaan ganee seiee ieh aae safal tinaa ke kaamaa ||1||
verses.translation: Their birth is approved, and their actions are fruitful. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam har jan kai hau bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: O my Lord, I am a sacrifice to the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੇਸਾ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਵਰੁ ਢੁਲਾਵਾ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kesaa kaa kar chavar ddulaavaa charan dhooR mukh laiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I make my hair into a fan, and wave it over them; I apply the dust of their feet to my face. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhuhahoo meh naahee jan paraupakaaree aae ||
verses.translation: Those generous, humble beings are above both birth and death.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੈਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeea dhaan dhe bhagatee lain har siau lain milaae ||2||
verses.translation: They give the gift of the soul, and practice devotional worship; they inspire others to meet the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa amar sachee paatisaahee sache setee raate ||
verses.translation: True are their commands, and true are their empires; they are attuned to the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sachaa sukh sachee vaddiaaiee jis ke se tin jaate ||3||
verses.translation: True is their happiness, and true is their greatness. They know the Lord, to whom they belong. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪੀਸਣੁ ਪੀਸਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: pakhaa feree paanee ddovaa har jan kai peesan pees kamaavaa ||
verses.translation: I wave the fan over them, carry water for them, and grind corn for the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: naanak kee prabh paas bena(n)tee tere jan dhekhan paavaa ||4||7||54||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to God - please, grant me the sight of Your humble servants. ||4||7||54||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesar satigur aape karanaihaaraa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God; He Himself is the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan dhooR teree sevak maagai tere dharasan kau balihaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: Your servant begs for the dust of Your feet. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam rai jiau raakheh tiau raheeaai ||
verses.translation: O my Sovereign Lord, as You keep me, so do I remain.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai taa naam japaaveh sukh teraa dhitaa laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When it pleases You, I chant Your Name. You alone can grant me peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mukat bhugat jugat teree sevaa jis too(n) aap karaieh ||
verses.translation: Liberation, comfort and proper lifestyle come from serving You; You alone cause us to serve You.

verses.original: ਤਹਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਇਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tahaa baiku(n)Th jeh keeratan teraa too(n) aape saradhaa laieh ||2||
verses.translation: That place is heaven, where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung. You Yourself instill faith into us. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar naam jeevaa tan man hoi nihaalaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Naam, I live; my mind and body are enraptured.

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal tere dhoi dhoi peevaa mere satigur dheen dhiaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: I wash Your Lotus Feet, and drink in this water, O my True Guru, O Merciful to the meek. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਈ ਉਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kurabaan jaiee us velaa suhaavee jit tumarai dhuaarai aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that most wonderful time when I came to Your Door.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: naanak kau prabh bhe kirapaalaa satigur pooraa paiaa ||4||8||55||
verses.translation: God has become compassionate to Nanak; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||8||55||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tudh chit aae mahaa ana(n)dhaa jis visareh so mar jaae ||
verses.translation: When You come to mind, I am totally in bliss. One who forgets You might just as well be dead.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaal hoveh jis uoopar karate so tudh sadhaa dhiaae ||1||
verses.translation: That being, whom You bless with Your Mercy, O Creator Lord, constantly meditates on You. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere saahib too(n) mai maan nimaanee ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are the honor of the dishonored such as me.

verses.original: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਆਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aradhaas karee prabh apane aagai sun sun jeevaa teree baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I offer my prayer to You, God; listening, listening to the Word of Your Bani, I live. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: charan dhooR tere jan kee hovaa tere dharasan kau bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: May I become the dust of the feet of Your humble servants. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat bachan ridhai ur dhaaree tau kirapaa te sa(n)g paiee ||2||
verses.translation: I enshrine Your Ambrosial Word within my heart. By Your Grace, I have found the Company of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਹਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar kee gat tudh peh saaree tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: I place the state of my inner being before You; there is no other as great as You.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਗਤੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis no lai laih so laagai bhagat tuhaaraa soiee ||3||
verses.translation: He alone is attached, whom You attach; he alone is Your devotee. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhui kar joR maagau ik dhaanaa saahib tuThai paavaa ||
verses.translation: With my palms pressed together, I beg for this one gift; O my Lord and Master, if it pleases You, I shall obtain it.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: saas saas naanak aaraadhe aaTh pahar gun gaavaa ||4||9||56||
verses.translation: With each and every breath, Nanak adores You; twenty-four hours a day, I sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||9||56||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke sir uoopar too(n) suaamee so dhukh kaisaa paavai ||
verses.translation: When You stand over our heads, O Lord and Master, how can we suffer in pain?

verses.original: ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਰਣਾ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bol na jaanai maiaa madh maataa maranaa cheet na aavai ||1||
verses.translation: The mortal being does not know how to chant Your Name - he is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, and the thought of death does not even enter his mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam rai too(n) sa(n)taa kaa sa(n)t tere ||
verses.translation: O my Sovereign Lord, You belong to the Saints, and the Saints belong to You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tere sevak kau bhau kichh naahee jam nahee aavai nere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your servant is not afraid of anything; the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo terai ra(n)g raate suaamee tin(h) kaa janam maran dhukh naasaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to Your Love, O my Lord and Master, are released from the pains of birth and death.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teree bakhas na meTai koiee satigur kaa dhilaasaa ||2||
verses.translation: No one can erase Your Blessings; the True Guru has given me this assurance. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaain sukh fal pain aaTh pahar aaraadheh ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtain the fruits of peace. Twenty-four hours a day, they worship and adore You.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਲੈ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: teree saran terai bharavaasai pa(n)ch dhusaT lai saadheh ||3||
verses.translation: In Your Sanctuary, with Your Support, they subdue the five villains. ||3||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan kichh karam na jaanaa saar na jaanaa teree ||
verses.translation: I know nothing about wisdom, meditation and good deeds; I know nothing about Your excellence.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: sabh te vaddaa satigur naanak jin kal raakhee meree ||4||10||57||
verses.translation: Guru Nanak is the greatest of all; He saved my honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||4||10||57||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagal tiaag gur saranee aaiaa raakhahu raakhanahaare ||
verses.translation: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary; save me, O my Savior Lord!

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jit too laaveh tit ham laageh kiaa eh ja(n)t vichaare ||1||
verses.translation: Whatever You link me to, to that I am linked; what can this poor creature do? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere raam jee too(n) prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Lord God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gurdhev dhiaalaa gun gaavaa nit suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Be Merciful to me, O Divine, Compassionate Guru, that I may constantly sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar prabh apanaa dhiaaieeaai gur prasaadh bhau tareeaai ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my God; by Guru's Grace, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਰੇਣਾ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap tiaag hoieeaai sabh renaa jeevatiaa iau mareeaai ||2||
verses.translation: Renouncing self-conceit, I have become the dust of all men's feet; in this way, I die, while I am still alive. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam tis kaa jag bheetar saadhasa(n)g naau jaape ||
verses.translation: How fruitful is the life of that being in this world, who chants the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath tis ke pooran jis dhiaa kare prabh aape ||3||
verses.translation: All desires are fulfilled, for the one who is blessed with God's Kindness and Mercy. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal kirapaal prabh suaamee teree saran dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: O Merciful to the meek, Kind and Compassionate Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apanaa naam dheejai naanak saadh ravaalaa ||4||11||58||
verses.translation: Take pity upon me, and bless me with Your Name. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||11||58||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soohee asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Ashtapadee, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh avagan mai gun nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: I am totally without virtue; I have no virtue at all.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kiau kar ka(n)t milaavaa hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: How can I meet my Husband Lord? ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਬੰਕੇ ਨੈਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa mai roop na ba(n)ke nainaa ||
verses.translation: I have no beauty, no enticing eyes.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੁਲ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naa kul dda(n)g na meeThe bainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not have a noble family, good manners or a sweet voice. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj seegaar kaaman kar aavai ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride adorns herself with peace and poise.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa sohaagan jaa ka(n)tai bhaavai ||2||
verses.translation: But she is a happy soul-bride, only if her Husband Lord is pleased with her. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis roop na rekhiaa kaiee ||
verses.translation: He has no form or feature;

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na saahib simariaa jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: at the very last instant, he cannot suddenly be contemplated. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: surat mat naahee chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: I have no understanding, intellect or cleverness.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh laavahu paiee ||4||
verses.translation: Have Mercy upon me, God, and attach me to Your Feet. ||4||

verses.original: ਖਰੀ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kharee siaanee ka(n)t na bhaanee ||
verses.translation: She may be very clever, but this does not please her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: maiaa laagee bharam bhulaanee ||5||
verses.translation: Attached to Maya, she is deluded by doubt. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jaiee taa ka(n)t samaiee ||
verses.translation: But if she gets rid of her ego, then she merges in her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tau kaaman piaare nav nidh paiee ||6||
verses.translation: Only then can the soul-bride obtain the nine treasures of her Beloved. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anik janam bichhurat dhukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Separated from You for countless incarnations, I have suffered in pain.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kar geh leh preetam prabh raiaa ||7||
verses.translation: Please take my hand, O my Beloved Sovereign Lord God. ||7||

verses.original: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhanat naanak sahu hai bhee hosee ||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the Lord is, and shall always be.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤੈ ਰਾਵੇਸੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: jai bhaavai piaaraa tai raavesee ||8||1||
verses.translation: She alone is ravished and enjoyed, with whom the Beloved Lord is pleased. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੯
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ghar nauvaa
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla, Ninth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kachaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa thoRaRiaa dhin chaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: The color of safflower is transitory; it lasts for only a few days.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀਆ ਠਗਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai bhram bhuleeaa Thag muThee kooRiaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the false woman is deluded by doubt and plundered by thieves.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sache setee ratiaa janam na dhoojee vaar jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: But those who are attuned to the True Lord, are not reincarnated again. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੰਗੇ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)ge kaa kiaa ra(n)geeaai jo rate ra(n)g lai jeeau ||
verses.translation: How can one who is already dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, be colored any other color?

verses.original: ਰੰਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)gan vaalaa seveeaai sache siau chit lai jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So serve God the Dyer, and focus your consciousness on the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਜੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)ddaa je bhaveh bin bhaagaa dhan naeh jeeau ||
verses.translation: You wander around in the four directions, but without the good fortune of destiny, you shall never obtain wealth.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਧਿਕ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: avagan muThee je fireh badhik thai na paeh jeeau ||
verses.translation: If you are plundered by corruption and vice, you shall wander around, but like a fugitive, you shall find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare sabadh rate man maeh jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Only those who are protected by the Guru are saved; their minds are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਿਟੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: chiTe jin ke kapaRe maile chit kaThor jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those who wear white clothes, but have filthy and stone-hearted minds,

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਚੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin mukh naam na uoopajai dhoojai viaape chor jeeau ||
verses.translation: may chant the Lord's Name with their mouths, but they are engrossed in duality; they are thieves.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਸੇ ਢੋਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mool na boojheh aapanaa se pasooaa se ddor jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: They do not understand their own roots; they are beasts. They are just animals! ||3||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗੈ ਸੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit khuseeaa man kare nit nit ma(n)gai sukh jeeau ||
verses.translation: Constantly, continually, the mortal seeks pleasures. Constantly, continually, he begs for peace.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: karataa chit na aaviee fir fir lageh dhukh jeeau ||
verses.translation: But he does not think of the Creator Lord, and so he is overtaken by pain, again and again.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh dhaataa man vasai tit tan kaisee bhukh jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: But one, within whose mind the Giver of pleasure and pain dwells - how can his body feel any need? ||4||

verses.original: ਬਾਕੀ ਵਾਲਾ ਤਲਬੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: baakee vaalaa talabeeaai sir maare ja(n)dhaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: One who has a karmic debt to pay off is summoned, and the Messenger of Death smashes his head.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਪੁਛੈ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa ma(n)gai dhevanaa puchhai kar beechaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: When his account is called for, it has to be given. After it is reviewed, payment is demanded.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sache kee liv ubarai bakhase bakhasanahaar jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: Only love for the True One will save you; the Forgiver forgives. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਨ ਕੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਮਿਤੜਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: an ko keejai mitaRaa khaak ralai mar jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: If you make any friend other than God, you shall die and mingle with the dust.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahu ra(n)g dhekh bhulaiaa bhul bhul aavai jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the many games of love, you are beguiled and bewildered; you come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: nadhar prabhoo te chhuTeeaai nadharee mel milai jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: Only by God's Grace can you be saved. By His Grace, He unites in His Union. ||6||

verses.original: ਗਾਫਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gaafal giaan vihooniaa gur bin giaan na bhaal jeeau ||
verses.translation: O careless one, you are totally lacking any wisdom; do not seek wisdom without the Guru.

verses.original: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: khi(n)chotaan vigucheeaai buraa bhalaa dhui naal jeeau ||
verses.translation: By indecision and inner conflict, you shall come to ruin. Good and bad both pull at you.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭੈ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai bhai ratiaa sabh johee jamakaal jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: Without being attuned to the Word of the Shabad and the Fear of God, all come under the gaze of the Messenger of Death. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa sabhasai dhei aadhaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: He who created the creation and sustains it, gives sustenance to all.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau manahu visaareeaai sadhaa sadhaa dhaataar jeeau ||
verses.translation: How can you forget Him from your mind? He is the Great Giver, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam na veesarai nidhaaraa aadhaar jeeau ||8||1||2||
verses.translation: Nanak shall never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of the unsupported. ||8||1||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕਾਫੀ ਘਰੁ ੧੦
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa kaafee ghar dasvaa
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla, Kaafee, Tenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maanas janam dhula(n)bh gurmukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: It is difficult to receive this human body, but only the Guru's disciple understands its value. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੁਲੰਭੁ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tan hoi chula(n)bh je satigur bhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The mind and body are dyed in the deep red color of devotional love, if it pleases the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: chalai janam savaar vakhar sach lai ||
verses.translation: He departs with his life embellished and successful, taking the merchandise of the True Name.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pat paae dharabaar satigur sabadh bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is honored in the Darbaar, the Royal Court, of the Lord, through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, and the Fear of God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan sach salaeh saache man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: One who praises the True Lord with his mind and body, pleases the Mind of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: laal rataa man maaniaa gur pooraa paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Beloved Lord, the mind is appeased, and finds the Perfect Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau jeevaa gun saar a(n)tar too vasai ||
verses.translation: I live, by cherishing Your Glorious Virtues; You dwell deep within me.

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too(n) vaseh man maeh sahaje ras rasai ||3||
verses.translation: You dwell within my mind, and so it naturally celebrates in joyful delight. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਆਖਉ ਕੇਤੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh man samajhai aakhau ketaRaa ||
verses.translation: O my foolish mind, how can I teach and instruct you?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇਤੜਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har gun gai ra(n)g ra(n)getaRaa ||4||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and so become attuned to His Love. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਆਪਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: nit nit ridhai samaal preetam aapanaa ||
verses.translation: Continually, continuously, remember and cherish your Beloved Lord in your heart.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਲਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪਣਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: je chaleh gun naal naahee dhukh sa(n)taapanaa ||5||
verses.translation: For if you depart with virtue, then pain shall never afflict you. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bharam bhulaanaa naa tis ra(n)g hai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh wanders around, deluded by doubt; he does not enshrine love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਰਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ਹੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: marasee hoi viddaanaa man tan bha(n)g hai ||6||
verses.translation: He dies as a stranger to his own self, and his mind and body are spoiled. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee kaar kamai laahaa ghar aaniaa ||
verses.translation: Performing service to the Guru, you shall go home with the profit.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee nirabaan sabadh pachhaaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, and the Shabad, the Word of God, the state of Nirvaanaa is attained. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik naanak kee aradhaas je tudh bhaavasee ||
verses.translation: Nanak makes this one prayer: if it pleases Your Will,

verses.original: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਸੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: mai dheejai naam nivaas har gun gaavasee ||8||1||3||
verses.translation: bless me with a home in Your Name, Lord, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||8||1||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਆਰਣਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਇ ਭੰਨਿ ਘੜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jiau aaran lohaa pai bha(n)n ghaRaieeaai ||
verses.translation: As iron is melted in the forge and re-shaped,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiau saakat jonee pai bhavai bhavaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: so is the godless materialist reincarnated, and forced to wander aimlessly. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe sabh dhukh dhukh kamaavanaa ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, everything is suffering, earning only more suffering.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai aavai jai bharam bhulaavanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In his ego, he comes and goes, wandering in confusion, deluded by doubt. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) gurmukh rakhanahaar har naam dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: You save those who are Gurmukh, O Lord, through meditation on Your Naam.

verses.original: ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਰਜਾਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meleh tujheh rajai sabadh kamaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: You blend with Yourself, by Your Will, those who practice the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) kar kar vekheh aap dheh su paieeaai ||
verses.translation: You created the Creation, and You Yourself gaze upon it; whatever You give, is received.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਦਰਿ ਬੀਨਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too dhekheh thaap uthaap dhar beenaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: You watch, establish and disestablish; You keep all in Your vision at Your Door. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਹੋਵਗਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਪਵਣੁ ਉਡਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee hovag khaak pavan uddaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The body shall turn to dust, and the soul shall fly away.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਕਿਥੈ ਘਰੁ ਅਉਤਾਕੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eih kithai ghar aautaak mahal na paieeaai ||4||
verses.translation: So where are their homes and resting places now? They do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, either. ||4||

verses.original: ਦਿਹੁ ਦੀਵੀ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰੁ ਘਬੁ ਮੁਹਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhih dheevee a(n)dh ghor ghab muhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: In the pitch darkness of broad daylight, their wealth is being plundered.

verses.original: ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਰੂਆਈਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: garab musai ghar chor kis rooaaieeaai ||5||
verses.translation: Pride is looting their homes like a thief; where can they file their complaint? ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਜਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh chor na laag har naam jagaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The thief does not break into the home of the Gurmukh; he is awake in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਆਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀਪਾਈਐ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabadh nivaaree aag jot dheepaieeaai ||6||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad puts out the fire of desire; God's Light illuminates and enlightens. ||6||

verses.original: ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: laal ratan har naam gur surat bujhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a jewel, a ruby; the Guru has taught me the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਕਾਮੁ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sadhaa rahai nihakaam je gurmat paieeaai ||7||
verses.translation: One who follows the Guru's Teachings remains forever free of desire. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: raat dhihai har naau ma(n)n vasaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਈਐ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak mel milai je tudh bhaieeaai ||8||2||4||
verses.translation: Please unite Nanak in Union, O Lord, if it is pleasing to Your Will. ||8||2||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: manahu na naam visaar ahinis dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from your mind; night and day, meditate on it.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau raakheh kirapaa dhaar tivai sukh paieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: As You keep me, in Your Merciful Grace, so do I find peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਕੁਟੀ ਟੋਹਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mai a(n)dhule har naam lakuTee Tohanee ||
verses.translation: I am blind, and the Lord's Name is my cane.

verses.original: ਰਹਉ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਮੋਹੈ ਮੋਹਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rahau saahib kee Tek na mohai mohanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I remain under the Sheltering Support of my Lord and Master; I am not enticed by Maya the enticer. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhau teh naal gur dhekhaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there the Guru has shown me that God is always with me.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar bhaal sabadh nihaaliaa ||2||
verses.translation: Searching inwardly and outwardly as well, I came to see Him, through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevee satigur bhai naam nira(n)janaa ||
verses.translation: So serve the True Guru with love, through the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai tivai rajai bharam bhau bha(n)janaa ||3||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, so by Your Will, You destroy my doubts and fears. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨਮਤ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: janamat hee dhukh laagai maranaa aai kai ||
verses.translation: At the very moment of birth, he is afflicted with pain, and in the end, he comes only to die.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: janam maran paravaan har gun gai kai ||4||
verses.translation: Birth and death are validated and approved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau naahee too hoveh tudh hee saajiaa ||
verses.translation: When there is no ego, there You are; You fashioned all of this.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aape thaap uthaap sabadh nivaajiaa ||5||
verses.translation: You Yourself establish and disestablish; through the Word of Your Shabad, You elevate and exalt. ||5||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਭਸਮ ਰੁਲਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਹ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee bhasam rulai na jaapee keh giaa ||
verses.translation: When the body rolls in the dust, it is not known where the soul has gone.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਸੋ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aape rahiaa samai so visamaadh bhiaa ||6||
verses.translation: He Himself is permeating and pervading; this is wonderful and amazing! ||6||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੂਰਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) naahee prabh dhoor jaaneh sabh too hai ||
verses.translation: You are not far away, God; You know everything.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭੀ ਤੂ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vekh hadhoor a(n)tar bhee too hai ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sees You ever-present; You are deep within the nucleus of our inner self. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: mai dheejai naam nivaas a(n)tar saa(n)t hoi ||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with a home in Your Name; may my inner self be at peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai naanak dhaas satigur mat dhei ||8||3||5||
verses.translation: May slave Nanak sing Your Glorious Praises; O True Guru, please share the Teachings with me. ||8||3||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Third Mehla, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: naamai hee te sabh kichh hoaa bin satigur naam na jaapai ||
verses.translation: Everything comes from the Naam, the Name of the Lord; without the True Guru, the Naam is not experienced.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh mahaa ras meeThaa bin chaakhe saadh na jaapai ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sweetest and most sublime essence, but without tasting it, its flavor cannot be experienced.

verses.original: ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: kauddee badhalai janam gavaiaa cheenas naahee aapai ||
verses.translation: He wastes this human life in exchange for a mere shell; he does not understand his own self.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai taa eko jaanai haumai dhukh na sa(n)taapai ||1||
verses.translation: But, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to know the One Lord, and the disease of egotism does not afflict him. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur apane viTahu jin saache siau liv laiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has lovingly attached me to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਆਤਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh cheeni(h) aatam paragaasiaa sahaje rahiaa samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Concentrating on the Word of the Shabad, the soul is illumined and enlightened. I remain absorbed in celestial ecstasy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gaavai gurmukh boojhai gurmukh sabadh beechaare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sings the Praises of the Lord; the Gurmukh understands. The Gurmukh contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh gur te upajai gurmukh kaaraj savaare ||
verses.translation: Body and soul are totally rejuvenated through the Guru; the Gurmukh's affairs are resolved in his favor.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaavai bikh khaTe sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: The blind self-willed manmukh acts blindly, and earns only poison in this world.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sadhaa dhukh paae bin gur at piaare ||2||
verses.translation: Enticed by Maya, he suffers in constant pain, without the most Beloved Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਚਾਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: soiee sevak je satigur seve chaalai satigur bhaae ||
verses.translation: He alone is a selfless servant, who serves the True Guru, and walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa sabadh sifat hai saachee saachaa ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: The True Shabad, the Word of God, is the True Praise of God; enshrine the True Lord within your mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee gurmukh aakhai haumai vichahu jaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh speaks the True Word of Gurbani, and egotism departs from within.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape dhaataa karam hai saachaa saachaa sabadh sunaae ||3||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Giver, and True are His actions. He proclaims the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਟੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ghaale gurmukh khaTe gurmukh naam japaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh works, and the Gurmukh earns; the Gurmukh inspires others to chant the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa alipat saachai ra(n)g raataa gur kai sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: He is forever unattached, imbued with the Love of the True Lord, intuitively in harmony with the Guru.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਕੂੜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh sadh hee kooRo bolai bikh beejai bikh khaae ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh always tells lies; he plants the seeds of poison, and eats only poison.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਧਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਵਣੁ ਛਡਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jamakaal baadhaa tirasanaa dhaadhaa bin gur kavan chhaddaae ||4||
verses.translation: He is bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death, and burnt in the fire of desire; who can save him, except the Guru? ||4||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa teerath jit sat sar naavan gurmukh aap bujhaae ||
verses.translation: True is that place of pilgrimage, where one bathes in the pool of Truth, and achieves self-realization as Gurmukh. The Gurmukh understands his own self.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਤੈ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh teerath gur sabadh dhikhaae tit naatai mal jaae ||
verses.translation: The Lord has shown that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage; bathing in it, filth is washed away.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh sachaa hai niramal naa mal lagai na laae ||
verses.translation: True and Immaculate is the True Word of His Shabad; no filth touches or clings to Him.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sachee sifat sachee saalaeh poore gur te paae ||5||
verses.translation: True Praise, True Devotional Praise, is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tan man sabh kichh har tis keraa dhuramat kahan na jaae ||
verses.translation: Body, mind, everything belongs to the Lord; but the evil-minded ones cannot even say this.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hukam hovai taa niramal hovai haumai vichahu jaae ||
verses.translation: If such is the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then one becomes pure and spotless, and the ego is taken away from within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਚਾਖੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee saakhee sahaje chaakhee tirasanaa agan bujhaae ||
verses.translation: I have intuitively tasted the Guru's Teachings, and the fire of my desire has been quenched.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh raataa sahaje maataa sahaje rahiaa samaae ||6||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is naturally intoxicated, merging imperceptibly into the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam sat kar jaanai gur kai bhai piaare ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is known as True, through the Love of the Beloved Guru.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sachee vaddiaaiee gur te paiee sachai nai piaare ||
verses.translation: True Glorious Greatness is obtained from the Guru, through the Beloved True Name.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eko sachaa sabh meh varatai viralaa ko veechaare ||
verses.translation: The One True Lord is permeating and pervading among all; how rare is the one who contemplates this.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਤਾ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aape mel le taa bakhase sachee bhagat savaare ||7||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself unites us in Union, and forgives us; He embellishes us with true devotional worship. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabho sach sach sach varatai gurmukh koiee jaanai ||
verses.translation: All is Truth; Truth, and Truth alone is pervading; how rare is the Gurmukh who knows this.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੁਕਮੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maranaa hukamo varatai gurmukh aap pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: Birth and death occur by the Hukam of His Command; the Gurmukh understands his own self.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਏ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaae taa satigur bhaae jo ichhai so fal paae ||
verses.translation: He meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and so pleases the True Guru. He receives whatever rewards he desires.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tis dhaa sabh kichh hovai j vichahu aap gavaae ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who eradicates self-conceit from within, has everything. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਆਲਿੑਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kaaman at suaali(h)au pir vasai jis naale ||
verses.translation: The body-bride is very beautiful; she dwells with her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਸਚੇ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: pir sache te sadhaa suhaagan gur kaa sabadh sam(h)aale ||
verses.translation: She becomes the happy soul-bride of her True Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat sadhaa ra(n)g raataa haumai vichahu jaale ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotee is forever attuned to the Lord's Love; her ego is burnt away from within. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu poore gur kee baanee ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed, blessed is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te upajee saach samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It wells up and springs forth from the Perfect Guru, and merges into Truth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸੈ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਾਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar sabh kichh vasai kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal paataalaa ||
verses.translation: Everything is within the Lord - the continents, worlds and nether regions.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar jagajeevan dhaataa vasai sabhanaa kare pratipaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, dwells within the body; He is the Cherisher of all.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kaaman sadhaa suhelee gurmukh naam sam(h)aalaa ||2||
verses.translation: The body-bride is eternally beautiful; the Gurmukh contemplates the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਸੈ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar aape vasai alakh na lakhiaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He is invisible and cannot be seen.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mugadh boojhai naahee baahar bhaalan jaiee ||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand; he goes out searching for the Lord externally.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur seve sadhaa sukh paae satigur alakh dhitaa lakhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: One who serves the True Guru is always at peace; the True Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar ratan padhaarath bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the body there are jewels and precious treasures, the over-flowing treasure of devotion.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਉਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis kaiaa a(n)dhar naukha(n)dd pirathamee haaT paTan baajaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within this body are the nine continents of the earth, its markets, cities and streets.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eis kaiaa a(n)dhar naam nau nidh paieeaai gur kai sabadh veechaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Within this body are the nine treasures of the Naam; contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is obtained. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar tol tulaavai aape tolanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the body, the Lord estimates the weight; He Himself is the weigher.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih man ratan javaahar maanak tis kaa mol afaaraa ||
verses.translation: This mind is the jewel, the gem, the diamond; it is absolutely priceless.

verses.original: ਮੋਲਿ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: mol kit hee naam paieeaai naahee naam paieeaai gur beechaaraa ||5||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, cannot be purchased at any price; the Naam is obtained by contemplating the Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਖੋਜੈ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su kaiaa khojai hor sabh bharam bhulaiee ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh searches this body; all others just wander around in confusion.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no dhei soiee jan paavai hor kiaa ko kare chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: That humble being alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord bestows it. What other clever tricks can anyone try?

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar bhau bhaau vasai gur parasaadhee paiee ||6||
verses.translation: Within the body, the Fear of God and Love for Him abides; by Guru's Grace, they are obtained. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ਸਭ ਓਪਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar brahamaa bisan mahesaa sabh opat jit sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Within the body, are Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, from whom the whole world emanated.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sachai aapanaa khel rachaiaa aavaa gaun paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord has staged and contrived His own play; the expanse of the Universe comes and goes.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: poorai satigur aap dhikhaiaa sach naam nisataaraa ||7||
verses.translation: The Perfect True Guru Himself has made it clear, that emancipation comes through the True Name. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saa kaiaa jo satigur sevai sachai aap savaaree ||
verses.translation: That body, which serves the True Guru, is embellished by the True Lord Himself.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai dhar ddoiee naahee taa jam kare khuaaree ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the mortal finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord; he shall be tortured by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sach vaddiaaiee paae jis no har kirapaa dhaaree ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, true glory is bestowed, when the Lord showers His Mercy. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧੦
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa teejaa ghar dasvaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Third Mehla, Tenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਵੰਞਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa na saalaeh jo mar va(n)n(j)see ||
verses.translation: Do not praise the world; it shall simply pass away.

verses.original: ਲੋਕਾ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਥੀਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lokaa na saalaeh jo mar khaak theeiee ||1||
verses.translation: Do not praise other people; they shall die and turn to dust. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu mere saahibaa vaahu ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail to my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa salaaheeaai sachaa veparavaahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, forever praise the One who is forever True, Independent and Carefree. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਝਿ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa keree dhosatee manmukh dhajh mara(n)n ||
verses.translation: Making worldly friendships, the self-willed manmukhs burn and die.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਾਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jam pur badhe maare'eh velaa na laaha(n)n ||2||
verses.translation: In the City of Death, they are bound and gagged and beaten; this opportunity shall never come again. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh janam sakaarathaa sachai sabadh laga(n)n ||
verses.translation: The lives of the Gurmukhs are fruitful and blessed; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aatam raam pragaasiaa sahaje sukh raha(n)n ||3||
verses.translation: Their souls are illuminated by the Lord, and they dwell in peace and pleasure. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh visaariaa dhoojai bhai racha(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Word of the Guru's Shabad are engrossed in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਫਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tisanaa bhukh na utarai anadhin jalat fira(n)n ||4||
verses.translation: Their hunger and thirst never leave them, and night and day, they wander around burning. ||4||

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaTaa naal dhosatee naal sa(n)taa vair kara(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those who make friendships with the wicked, and harbor animosity to the Saints,

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aap ddube kuTa(n)b siau sagale kul ddoba(n)n ||5||
verses.translation: shall drown with their families, and their entire lineage shall be obliterated. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhaa bhalee kisai kee naahee manmukh mugadh kara(n)n ||
verses.translation: It is not good to slander anyone, but the foolish, self-willed manmukhs still do it.

verses.original: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰਿ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: muh kaale tin ni(n)dhakaa narake ghor pava(n)n ||6||
verses.translation: The faces of the slanderers turn black, and they fall into the most horrible hell. ||6||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਜੈਸਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man jaisaa seveh taisaa hoveh tehe karam kamai ||
verses.translation: O mind, as you serve, so do you become, and so are the deeds that you do.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap beej aape hee khaavanaa kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||7||
verses.translation: Whatever you yourself plant, that is what you shall have to eat; nothing else can be said about this. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa purakhaa kaa bolanaa hovai kitai parathai ||
verses.translation: The speech of the great spiritual beings has a higher purpose.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: oi a(n)mirat bhare bharapoor heh onaa til na tamai ||8||
verses.translation: They are filled to over-flowing with Ambrosial Nectar, and they have absolutely no greed at all. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਘਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: gunakaaree gun sa(n)gharai avaraa upadhesen ||
verses.translation: The virtuous accumulate virtue, and teach others.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee j onaa mil rahe anadhin naam len ||9||
verses.translation: Those who meet with them are so very fortunate; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਦੇਸੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhesee rijak sa(n)baeh jin upaiee medhanee ||
verses.translation: He who created the Universe, gives sustenance to it.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: eko hai dhaataar sachaa aap dhanee ||10||
verses.translation: The One Lord alone is the Great Giver. He Himself is the True Master. ||10||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: so sach terai naal hai gurmukh nadhar nihaal ||
verses.translation: That True Lord is always with you; the Gurmukh is blessed with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase mel le so prabh sadhaa samaal ||11||
verses.translation: He Himself shall forgive you, and merge you into Himself; forever cherish and contemplate God. ||11||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mailaa sach niramalaa kiau kar miliaa jai ||
verses.translation: The mind is impure; only the True Lord is pure. So how can it merge into Him?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: prabh mele taa mil rahai haumai sabadh jalai ||12||
verses.translation: God merges it into Himself, and then it remains merged; through the Word of His Shabad, the ego is burnt away. ||12||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: so sahu sachaa veesarai dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the life in this world, of one who forgets her True Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare naa veesarai gurmatee veechaar ||13||
verses.translation: The Lord grants His Mercy, and she does not forget Him, if she contemplates the Guru's Teachings. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mele taa mil rahaa saach rakhaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru unites her, and so she remains united with Him, with the True Lord enshrined within her heart.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: miliaa hoi na veechhuRai gur kai het piaar ||14||
verses.translation: And so united, she will not be separated again; she remains in the love and affection of the Guru. ||14||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pir saalaahee aapanaa gur kai sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: I praise my Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: mil preetam sukh paiaa sobhaava(n)tee naar ||15||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; I am His most beautiful and happy soul-bride. ||15||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਅਤਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh man na bhijiee at maile chit kaThor ||
verses.translation: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is not softened; his consciousness is totally polluted and stone-hearted.

verses.original: ਸਪੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: sapai dhudh peeaaieeaai a(n)dhar vis nikor ||16||
verses.translation: Even if the venomous snake is fed on milk, it shall still be filled with poison. ||16||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap kare kis aakheeaai aape bakhasanahaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself does - who else should I ask? He Himself is the Forgiving Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee mail utarai taa sach baniaa seegaar ||17||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, filth is washed away, and then, one is embellished with the ornament of Truth. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਓਥੈ ਕੂੜੇ ਨ ਟਿਕੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare othai kooRe na Tika(n)n ||
verses.translation: True is the Banker, and True are His traders. The false ones cannot remain there.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚੰਨਿ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: onaa sach na bhaaviee dhukh hee maeh pacha(n)n ||18||
verses.translation: They do not love the Truth - they are consumed by their pain. ||18||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mailaa jag firai mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: The world wanders around in the filth of egotism; it dies, and is re-born, over and again.

verses.original: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: piaai kirat kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||19||
verses.translation: He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||19||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat mil rahai taa sach lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: But if he joins the Society of the Saints, then he comes to embrace love for the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sach salaahee sach man dhar sachai sachiaar ||20||
verses.translation: Praising the True Lord with a truthful mind, he becomes true in the Court of the True Lord. ||20||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore pooree mat hai ahinis naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: The Teachings of the Perfect Guru are perfect; meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa vadd rog hai vichahu Thaak rahai ||21||
verses.translation: Egotism and self-conceit are terrible diseases; tranquility and stillness come from within. ||21||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur saalaahee aapanaa niv niv laagaa pai ||
verses.translation: I praise my Guru; bowing down to Him again and again, I fall at His Feet.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੀ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: tan man saupee aagai dharee vichahu aap gavai ||22||
verses.translation: I place my body and mind in offering unto Him, eradicating self-conceit from within. ||22||

verses.original: ਖਿੰਚੋਤਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khi(n)chotaan vigucheeaai ekas siau liv lai ||
verses.translation: Indecision leads to ruin; focus your attention on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: haumai meraa chhadd too taa sach rahai samai ||23||
verses.translation: Renounce egotism and self-conceit, and remain merged in Truth. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਭਾਇਰਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur no mile s bhairaa sachai sabadh laga(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those who meet with the True Guru are my Siblings of Destiny; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: sach mile se na vichhuReh dhar sachai dhisa(n)n ||24||
verses.translation: Those who merge with the True Lord shall not be separated again; they are judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||24||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: se bhaiee se sajanaa jo sachaa seva(n)n ||
verses.translation: They are my Siblings of Destiny, and they are my friends, who serve the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲੑਰਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੰਨਿੑ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: avagan vikan pal(h)ran gun kee saajh kara(n)ni(h) ||25||
verses.translation: They sell off their sins and demerits like straw, and enter into the partnership of virtue. ||25||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: gun kee saajh sukh uoopajai sachee bhagat karen ||
verses.translation: In the partnership of virtue, peace wells up, and they perform true devotional worship service.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: sach vana(n)jeh gur sabadh siau laahaa naam len ||26||
verses.translation: They deal in Truth, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and they earn the profit of the Naam. ||26||

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: suinaa rupaa paap kar kar sa(n)cheeaai chalai na chaladhiaa naal ||
verses.translation: Gold and silver may be earned by committing sins, but they will not go with you when you die.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: vin naavai naal na chalasee sabh muThee jamakaal ||27||
verses.translation: Nothing will go with you in the end, except the Name; all are plundered by the Messenger of Death. ||27||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤੋਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa tosaa har naam hai hiradhai rakhahu sam(h)aal ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the nourishment of the mind; cherish it, and preserve it carefully within your heart.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਖਰਚੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: eh kharach akhuT hai gurmukh nibahai naal ||28||
verses.translation: This nourishment is inexhaustible; it is always with the Gurmukhs. ||28||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e man moolahu bhuliaa jaaseh pat gavai ||
verses.translation: O mind, if you forget the Primal Lord, you shall depart, having lost your honor.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: eih jagat moh dhoojai viaapiaa gurmatee sach dhiaai ||29||
verses.translation: This world is engrossed in the love of duality; follow the Guru's Teachings, and meditate on the True Lord. ||29||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee keemat na pavai har jas likhan na jai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; the Lord's Praises cannot be written down.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh man tan rapai har siau rahai samai ||30||
verses.translation: When one's mind and body are attuned to the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one remains merged in the Lord. ||30||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so sahu meraa ra(n)gulaa ra(n)ge sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord is playful; He has imbued me with His Love, with natural ease.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਾ ਚੜੈ ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: kaaman ra(n)g taa chaRai jaa pir kai a(n)k samai ||31||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is imbued with His Love, when her Husband Lord merges her into His Being. ||31||

verses.original: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: chiree vichhu(n)ne bhee milan jo satigur seva(n)n ||
verses.translation: Even those who have been separated for so very long, are reunited with Him, when they serve the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਰਚਨਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਵੰਨਿ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar nav nidh naam hai khaan kharachan na nikhuTiee har gun sahaj rava(n)n ||32||
verses.translation: The nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are deep within the nucleus of the self; consuming them, they are still never exhausted. Chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with natural ease. ||32||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa oi janameh naa mareh naa oi dhukh saha(n)n ||
verses.translation: They are not born, and they do not die; they do not suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare har siau kel kara(n)n ||33||
verses.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved. They celebrate with the Lord. ||33||

verses.original: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
