verses.translit: sajan mile na vichhuReh j anadhin mile raha(n)n ||
verses.translation: Those who are united with the Lord, the True Friend, are not separated again; night and day, they remain blended with Him.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੩੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: eis jag meh virale jaane'eeh naanak sach laha(n)n ||34||1||3||
verses.translation: In this world, only a rare few are known, O Nanak, to have obtained the True Lord. ||34||1||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jee sookham agam hai kit bidh miliaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord is subtle and inaccessible; how can we ever meet Him?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh bhram kaTeeaai achi(n)t vasai man aai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, doubt is dispelled, and the Carefree Lord comes to abide in the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har har naam japa(n)n ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੰਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau tin kai balihaaranai man har gun sadhaa rava(n)n ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord in their minds forever. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਲਹੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: gur saravar maan sarovar hai vaddabhaagee purakh laha(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: The Guru is like the Mansarovar Lake; only the very fortunate beings find Him.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੰਸੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sevak gurmukh khojiaa se ha(n)sule naam laha(n)n ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, seek out the Guru; the swan-souls feed there on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿੑ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaaini(h) ra(n)g siau gurmukh naam laga(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and remain linked to the Naam.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏਨਿੑ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhur poorab hovai likhiaa gur bhaanaa ma(n)n leni(h) ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever is pre-ordained, accept it as the Will of the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee ghar khojiaa paiaa naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I searched my home, and found the treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gur poorai vekhaaliaa prabh aatam raam pachhaan ||4||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has shown God to me; I have realized the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa prabh ek hai dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: There is One God of all; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee man vasai tit ghaT paragaT hoi ||5||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to abide in the mind; in the heart of such a one, He is revealed. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh a(n)tarajaamee braham hai braham vasai sabh thai ||
verses.translation: God is the Inner-knower of all hearts; God dwells in every place.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhaa kis no aakheeaai sabadh vekhahu liv lai ||6||
verses.translation: So who should we call evil? Behold the Word of the Shabad, and lovingly dwell upon it. ||6||

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਆਖਦਾ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: buraa bhalaa tichar aakhadhaa jichar hai dhuh maeh ||
verses.translation: He calls others bad and good, as long as he is in duality.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh eko bujhiaa ekas maeh samai ||7||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh understands the One and Only Lord; He is absorbed in the One Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sevaa saa prabh bhaavasee jo prabh paae thai ||
verses.translation: That is selfless service, which pleases God, and which is approved by God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har aaraadhiaa gur charanee chit lai ||8||2||4||9||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak worships the Lord in adoration; he focuses his consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||2||4||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag soohee asaTapadheeaa mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koiee aan milaavai meraa preetam piaaraa hau tis peh aap vechaiee ||1||
verses.translation: If only someone would come, and lead me to meet my Darling Beloved; I would sell myself to him. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan har dhekhan kai taiee ||
verses.translation: I long for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kareh taa satigur meleh har har naam dhiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the Lord shows Mercy unto me, then I meet the True Guru; I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je sukh dheh ta tujheh araadhee dhukh bhee tujhai dhiaaiee ||2||
verses.translation: If You will bless me with happiness, then I will worship and adore You. Even in pain, I will meditate on You. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਭੁਖ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਇਤ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੂਖ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je bhukh dheh ta it hee raajaa dhukh vich sookh manaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Even if You give me hunger, I will still feel satisfied; I am joyful, even in the midst of sorrow. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਭੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tan man kaaT kaaT sabh arapee vich aganee aap jalaiee ||4||
verses.translation: I would cut my mind and body apart into pieces, and offer them all to You; I would burn myself in fire. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pakhaa feree paanee ddovaa jo dheveh so khaiee ||5||
verses.translation: I wave the fan over You, and carry water for You; whatever You give me, I take. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗਰੀਬੁ ਢਹਿ ਪਇਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gareeb ddeh piaa dhuaarai har mel laih vaddiaaiee ||6||
verses.translation: Poor Nanak has fallen at the Lord's Door; please, O Lord, unite me with Yourself, by Your Glorious Greatness. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਤ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: akhee kaadd dharee charanaa tal sabh dharatee fir mat paiee ||7||
verses.translation: Taking out my eyes, I place them at Your Feet; after travelling over the entire earth, I have come to understand this. ||7||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਾਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਜੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਹਿ ਭੀ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: je paas bahaaleh taa tujheh araadhee je maar kaddeh bhee dhiaaiee ||8||
verses.translation: If You seat me near You, then I worship and adore You. Even if You beat me and drive me out, I will still meditate on You. ||8||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲੋਕੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜੇ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: je lok salaahe taa teree upamaa je ni(n)dhai ta chhodd na jaiee ||9||
verses.translation: If people praise me, the praise is Yours. Even if they slander me, I will not leave You. ||9||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਆਖਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: je tudh val rahai taa koiee kih aakhau tudh visariaai mar jaiee ||10||
verses.translation: If You are on my side, then anyone can say anything. But if I were to forget You, then I would die. ||10||

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਪੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: vaar vaar jaiee gur uoopar pai pairee sa(n)t manaiee ||11||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my Guru; falling at His Feet, I surrender to the Saintly Guru. ||11||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਤਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak vichaaraa bhiaa dhivaanaa har tau dharasan kai taiee ||12||
verses.translation: Poor Nanak has gone insane, longing for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||12||

verses.original: ਝਖੜੁ ਝਾਗੀ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jhakhaR jhaagee meeh varasai bhee gur dhekhan jaiee ||13||
verses.translation: Even in violent storms and torrential rain, I go out to catch a glimpse of my Guru. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਖਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਲੰਘਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: samu(n)dh saagar hovai bahu khaaraa gursikh la(n)gh gur peh jaiee ||14||
verses.translation: Even though the oceans and the salty seas are very vast, the GurSikh will cross over it to get to his Guru. ||14||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਰਤਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jiau praanee jal bin hai marataa tiau sikh gur bin mar jaiee ||15||
verses.translation: Just as the mortal dies without water, so does the Sikh die without the Guru. ||15||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਸੋਭ ਕਰੇ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: jiau dharatee sobh kare jal barasai tiau sikh gur mil bigasaiee ||16||
verses.translation: Just as the earth looks beautiful when the rain falls, so does the Sikh blossom forth meeting the Guru. ||16||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਵਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: sevak kaa hoi sevak varataa kar kar binau bulaiee ||17||
verses.translation: I long to be the servant of Your servants; I call upon You reverently in prayer. ||17||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak kee bena(n)tee har peh gur mil gur sukh paiee ||18||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to the Lord, that he may meet the Guru, and find peace. ||18||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਚੁ ਦੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: too aape gur chelaa hai aape gur vich dhe tujheh dhiaaiee ||19||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Guru, and You Yourself are the chaylaa, the disciple; through the Guru, I meditate on You. ||19||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jo tudh seveh so toohai hoveh tudh sevak paij rakhaiee ||20||
verses.translation: Those who serve You, become You. You preserve the honor of Your servants. ||20||

verses.original: ਭੰਡਾਰ ਭਰੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: bha(n)ddaar bhare bhagatee har tere jis bhaavai tis dhevaiee ||21||
verses.translation: O Lord, Your devotional worship is a treasure over-flowing. One who loves You, is blessed with it. ||21||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਹੋਰ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਭ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: jis too(n) dheh soiee jan paae hor nihafal sabh chaturaiee ||22||
verses.translation: That humble being alone receives it, unto whom You bestow it. All other clever tricks are fruitless. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਸੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: simar simar simar gur apunaa soiaa man jaagaiee ||23||
verses.translation: Remembering, remembering, remembering my Guru in meditation, my sleeping mind is awakened. ||23||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: eik dhaan ma(n)gai naanak vechaaraa har dhaasan dhaas karaiee ||24||
verses.translation: Poor Nanak begs for this one blessing, that he may become the slave of the slaves of the Lord. ||24||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਤ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਤ ਗੁਰ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: je gur jhiRake ta meeThaa laagai je bakhase ta gur vaddiaaiee ||25||
verses.translation: Even if the Guru rebukes me, He still seems very sweet to me. And if He actually forgives me, that is the Guru's greatness. ||25||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਏ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh boleh so thai paae manmukh kichh thai na paiee ||26||
verses.translation: That which Gurmukh speaks is certified and approved. Whatever the self-willed manmukh says is not accepted. ||26||

verses.original: ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਵਰਫ ਵਰਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖਣ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: paalaa kakar varaf varasai gursikh gur dhekhan jaiee ||27||
verses.translation: Even in the cold, the frost and the snow, the GurSikh still goes out to see his Guru. ||27||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੇਖਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਖੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰ ਧਰਾਈ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: sabh dhinas rain dhekhau gur apunaa vich akhee gur pair dharaiee ||28||
verses.translation: All day and night, I gaze upon my Guru; I install the Guru's Feet in my eyes. ||28||

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: anek upaav karee gur kaaran gur bhaavai so thai paiee ||29||
verses.translation: I make so many efforts for the sake of the Guru; only that which pleases the Guru is accepted and approved. ||29||

verses.original: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਅਰਾਧੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਈ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: rain dhinas gur charan araadhee dhiaa karahu mere saiee ||30||
verses.translation: Night and day, I worship the Guru's Feet in adoration; have Mercy upon me, O my Lord and Master. ||30||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa jeeau pi(n)dd guroo hai gur mil tirapat aghaiee ||31||
verses.translation: The Guru is Nanak's body and soul; meeting the Guru, he is satisfied and satiated. ||31||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੩੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaa prabh poor rahio hai jat kat tat gosaiee ||32||1||
verses.translation: Nanak's God is perfectly permeating and all-pervading. Here and there and everywhere, the Lord of the Universe. ||32||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੦
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa chauthhaa asaTapadheeaa ghar dasvaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar sachaa neh laiaa preetam aapanai ||
verses.translation: Deep within myself, I have enshrined true love for my Beloved.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਜਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਾ ਸਾਮੑਣੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tan man hoi nihaal jaa gur dhekhaa saam(h)ne ||1||
verses.translation: My body and soul are in ecstasy; I see my Guru before me. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: mai har har naam visaahu ||
verses.translation: I have purchased the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te paiaa a(n)mrit agam athaahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Ambrosial Nectar from the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau satigur vekh vigaseeaa har naame lagaa piaar ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the True Guru, I blossom forth in ecstasy; I am in love with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kar kai melian paiaa mokh dhuaar ||2||
verses.translation: Through His Mercy, the Lord has united me with Himself, and I have found the Door of Salvation. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur birahee naam kaa je milai ta tan man dheau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Lover of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Meeting Him, I dedicate my body and mind to Him.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਏਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je poorab hovai likhiaa taa a(n)mrit sahaj pe'eeau ||3||
verses.translation: And if it is so pre-ordained, then I shall automatically drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਭੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sutiaa gur saalaaheeaai uThadhiaa bhee gur aalaau ||
verses.translation: Praise the Guru while you are asleep, and call on the Guru while you are up.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਾਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: koiee aaisaa gurmukh je milai hau taa ke dhovaa paau ||4||
verses.translation: If only I could meet such a Gurmukh; I would wash His Feet. ||4||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aaisaa sajan loR lahu mai preetam dhei milai ||
verses.translation: I long for such a Friend, to unite me with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai har paiaa miliaa sahaj subhai ||5||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, I have found the Lord. He has met me, easily and effortlessly. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saagar gun naam kaa mai tis dhekhan kaa chaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Ocean of Virtue of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have such a yearning to see Him!

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hau tis bin ghaRee na jeevuoo bin dhekhe mar jaau ||6||
verses.translation: Without Him, I cannot live, even for an instant. If I do not see Him, I die. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau machhulee vin paaneeaai rahai na kitai upai ||
verses.translation: As the fish cannot survive at all without water,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tiau har bin sa(n)t na jeeviee bin har naamai mar jai ||7||
verses.translation: the Saint cannot live without the Lord. Without the Lord's Name, he dies. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai satigur setee pirahaRee kiau gur bin jeevaa maau ||
verses.translation: I am so much in love with my True Guru! How could I even live without the Guru, O my mother?

verses.original: ਮੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: mai gurbaanee aadhaar hai gurbaanee laag rahaau ||8||
verses.translation: I have the Support of the Word of the Guru's Bani. Attached to Gurbani, I survive. ||8||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam rata(n)n hai gur tuThaa dhevai mai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is a jewel; by the Pleasure of His Will, the Guru has given it, O my mother.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਧਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: mai dhar sache naam kee har naam rahaa liv lai ||9||
verses.translation: The True Name is my only Support. I remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||9||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur giaan padhaarath naam hai har naamo dhei dhiraRai ||
verses.translation: The wisdom of the Guru is the treasure of the Naam. The Guru implants and enshrines the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jis paraapat so lahai gur charanee laagai aai ||10||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, he alone gets it, who comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||10||

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਆਖੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: akath kahaanee prem kee ko preetam aakhai aai ||
verses.translation: If only someone would come and tell me the Unspoken Speech of the Love of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: tis dhevaa man aapanaa niv niv laagaa pai ||11||
verses.translation: I would dedicate my mind to him; I would bow down in humble respect, and fall at his feet. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sajan meraa ek too(n) karataa purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: You are my only Friend, O my All-knowing, All-powerful Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: satigur meet milaiaa mai sadhaa sadhaa teraa taan ||12||
verses.translation: You have brought me to meet with my True Guru. Forever and ever, You are my only strength. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur meraa sadhaa sadhaa naa aavai na jai ||
verses.translation: My True Guru, forever and ever, does not come and go.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: oh abinaasee purakh hai sabh meh rahiaa samai ||13||
verses.translation: He is the Imperishable Creator Lord; He is permeating and pervading among all. ||13||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan sa(n)chiaa saabat poo(n)jee raas ||
verses.translation: I have gathered in the wealth of the Lord's Name. My facilities and faculties are intact, safe and sound.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੧੪॥੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dharageh ma(n)niaa gur poore saabaas ||14||1||2||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am approved and respected in the Court of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has blessed me! ||14||1||2||11||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soohee asaTapadheeaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: aurajh rahio bikhiaa kai sa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: He is entangled in sinful associations;

verses.original: ਮਨਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maneh biaapat anik tara(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: his mind is troubled by so very many waves. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ॥ ਕਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere man agam agochar || kat paieeaai pooran paramesar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, how can the Unapproachable and Incomprehensible Lord be found? He is the Perfect Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੇ ॥
verses.translit: moh magan meh rahiaa biaape ||
verses.translation: He remains entangled in the intoxication of worldly love.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: at tirasanaa kabahoo nahee dhraape ||2||
verses.translation: His excessive thirst is never quenched. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਸਇ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਚੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: basi karodh sareer cha(n)ddaaraa ||
verses.translation: Anger is the outcaste which hides within his body;

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: agiaan na soojhai mahaa gubaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: he is in the utter darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand. ||3||

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਜਰੇ ਕਿਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhramat biaapat jare kivaaraa ||
verses.translation: Afflicted by doubt, the shutters are shut tight;

verses.original: ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jaan na paieeaai prabh dharabaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: he cannot go to God's Court. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa a(n)dhesaa ba(n)dh paraanaa ||
verses.translation: The mortal is bound and gagged by hope and fear;

verses.original: ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: mahal na paavai firat bigaanaa ||5||
verses.translation: he cannot find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and so he wanders around like a stranger. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal biaadh kai vas kar dheenaa ||
verses.translation: He falls under the power of all negative influences;

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: firat piaas jiau jal bin meenaa ||6||
verses.translation: he wanders around thirsty like a fish out of water. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਛੂ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kachhoo siaanap ukat na moree ||
verses.translation: I have no clever tricks or techniques;

verses.original: ਏਕ ਆਸ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ek aas Thaakur prabh toree ||7||
verses.translation: You are my only hope, O my Lord God Master. ||7||

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: karau benatee sa(n)tan paase ||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this prayer to the Saints

verses.original: ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: mel laih naanak aradhaase ||8||
verses.translation: - please let me merge and blend with You. ||8||

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhio kirapaal saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
verses.translation: God has shown Mercy, and I have found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tirapate pooraa paiaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is satisfied, finding the Perfect Lord. ||1||Second Pause||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਿਥਨ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੋਕ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
verses.translit: mithan moh agan sok saagar ||
verses.translation: Attachment to sex is an ocean of fire and pain.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਉਧਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa udhar har naagar ||1||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, O Sublime Lord, please save me from it. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal saranai narain ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਾਇਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa naath bhagat parain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the meek, the Support of His devotees. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥ ਭਗਤ ਭੈ ਮੇਟਨ ॥
verses.translit: anaathaa naath bhagat bhai meTan ||
verses.translation: Master of the masterless, Patron of the forlorn, Eradicator of fear of His devotees.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਨ ਭੇਟਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jamadhoot na bheTan ||2||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot even touch them. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeevan roop anoop dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: The Merciful, Incomparably Beautiful, Embodiment of Life.

verses.original: ਰਵਣ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ravan gunaa kaTeeaai jam jaalaa ||3||
verses.translation: Vibrating the Glorious Virtues of the Lord, the noose of the Messenger of Death is cut away. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam rasan nit jaapai ||
verses.translation: One who constantly chants the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam with his tongue,

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: rog roop maiaa na biaapai ||4||
verses.translation: is not touched or affected by Maya, the embodiment of disease. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jap gobi(n)dh sa(n)gee sabh taare ||
verses.translation: Chant and meditate on God, the Lord of the Universe, and all of your companions shall be carried across;

verses.original: ਪੋਹਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: pohat naahee pa(n)ch baTavaare ||5||
verses.translation: the five thieves will not even approach. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: man bach karam prabh ek dhiaae ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the One God in thought, word and deed

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਫਲਾ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sarab falaa soiee jan paae ||6||
verses.translation: - that humble being receives the fruits of all rewards. ||6||

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu apanaa prabh keenaa ||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy, God has made me His own;

verses.original: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: keval naam bhagat ras dheenaa ||7||
verses.translation: He has blessed me with the unique and singular Naam, and the sublime essence of devotion. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aadh madh a(n)t prabh soiee ||
verses.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, He is God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tis bin avar na koiee ||8||1||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without Him, there is no other at all. ||8||1||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੯
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa ghar nauvaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Ninth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਡਿਠਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਿਨੑ ਸੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin ddiThiaa man rahaseeaai kiau paieeaai tin(h) sa(n)g jeeau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon them, my mind is enraptured. How can I join them and be with them?

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਲਾਇਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sajan man mitr se lain prabh siau ra(n)g jeeau ||
verses.translation: They are Saints and friends, good friends of my mind, who inspire me and help me tune in to God's Love.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਭੰਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin(h) siau preet na tuTiee kabahu na hovai bha(n)g jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: My love for them shall never die; it shall never, ever be broken. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh kar dhiaa gun gaavaa tere nit jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, please grant me Your Grace, that I might constantly sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਜਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aai milahu sa(n)t sajanaa naam japeh man mit jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Come, and meet with me, O Saints, and good friends; let us chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Best Friend of my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhai sune na jaaniee maiaa mohiaa a(n)dh jeeau ||
verses.translation: He does not see, he does not hear, and he does not understand; he is blind, enticed and bewitched by Maya.

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹਾ ਵਿਣਸਣੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaachee dhehaa vinasanee kooR kamaavai dha(n)dh jeeau ||
verses.translation: His body is false and transitory; it shall perish. And still, he entangles himself in false pursuits.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaaveh se jin chale gur poore sanaba(n)dh jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: They alone depart victorious, who have meditated on the Naam; they stick with the Perfect Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਚਲਣੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukame jug meh aaiaa chalan hukam sa(n)jog jeeau ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of God's Will, they come into this world, and they leave upon receipt of His Hukam.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hukame parapa(n)ch pasariaa hukam kare ras bhog jeeau ||
verses.translation: By His Hukam, the Expanse of the Universe is expanded. By His Hukam, they enjoy pleasures.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis no karataa visarai tiseh vichhoRaa sog jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: One who forgets the Creator Lord, suffers sorrow and separation. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaRe prabh bhaaniaa dharageh paidhaa jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: One who is pleasing to his God, goes to His Court dressed in robes of honor.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaithai sukh mukh ujalaa iko naam dhiaai jeeau ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Naam, the One Name, finds peace in this world; his face is radiant and bright.

verses.original: ਆਦਰੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aadhar dhitaa paarabraham gur seviaa sat bhai jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord confers honor and respect on those who serve the Guru with true love. ||4||

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa sarab jeeaa pratipaal jeeau ||
verses.translation: He is pervading and permeating the spaces and interspaces; He loves and cherishes all beings.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach khajaanaa sa(n)chiaa ek naam dhan maal jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have accumulated the true treasure, the wealth and riches of the One Name.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: man te kabahu na veesarai jaa aape hoi dhiaal jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: I shall never forget Him from my mind, since He has been so merciful to me. ||5||

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa reh ge man vuThaa nira(n)kaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: My comings and goings have ended; the Formless Lord now dwells within my mind.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa kaa a(n)t na paieeaai uoochaa agam apaar jeeau ||
verses.translation: His limits cannot be found; He is lofty and exalted, inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis prabh apanaa visarai so mar ja(n)mai lakh vaar jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: One who forgets His God, shall die and be reincarnated, hundreds of thousands of times. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach neh tin preetamaa jin man vuThaa aap jeeau ||
verses.translation: They alone bear true love for their God, within whose minds He Himself dwells.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gun saajhee tin sa(n)g base aaTh pahar prabh jaap jeeau ||
verses.translation: So dwell only with those who share their virtues; chant and meditate on God, twenty-four hours a day.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rate paramesarai binase sagal sa(n)taap jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: They are attuned to the Love of the Transcendent Lord; all their sorrows and afflictions are dispelled. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) karataa too(n) karanahaar toohai ek anek jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, You are the Cause of causes; You are the One and the many.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too samarath too sarab mai toohai budh bibek jeeau ||
verses.translation: You are All-powerful, You are present everywhere; You are the subtle intellect, the clear wisdom.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam sadhaa japee bhagat janaa kee Tek jeeau ||8||1||3||
verses.translation: Nanak chants and meditates forever on the Naam, the Support of the humble devotees. ||8||1||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ਕਾਫੀ
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa ghar dasvaa kaafee
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House, Kaafee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੇ ਚੁਕੀ ਸਾੲਂੀ ਭੀ ਤਹਿੰਜੀ ਕਾਢੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: je bhulee je chukee saae(n)ee bhee tahi(n)jee kaaddeeaa ||
verses.translation: Even though I have made mistakes, and even though I have been wrong, I am still called Yours, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਦੂਜਾਣੇ ਲਗਾ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਸੇ ਵਾਢੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin(h)aa neh dhoojaane lagaa jhoor marahu se vaaddeeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who enshrine love for another, die regretting and repenting. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਨਾ ਛੋਡਉ ਕੰਤ ਪਾਸਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau naa chhoddau ka(n)t paasaraa ||
verses.translation: I shall never leave my Husband Lord's side.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਹਿੰਜਾ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ra(n)geelaa laal piaaraa eh mahi(n)jaa aasaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lover is always and forever beautiful. He is my hope and inspiration. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਜਣੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਸੈਣੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਉਪਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sajan toohai sain too mai tujh upar bahu maaneeaa ||
verses.translation: You are my Best Friend; You are my relative. I am so proud of You.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa too a(n)dhar taa sukhe too(n) nimaanee maaneeaa ||2||
verses.translation: And when You dwell within me, I am at peace. I am without honor - You are my honor. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਤੁਠਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਵੇਖਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: je too tuThaa kirapaa nidhaan naa dhoojaa vekhaal ||
verses.translation: And when You are pleased with me, O treasure of mercy, then I do not see any other.

verses.original: ਏਹਾ ਪਾਈ ਮੂ ਦਾਤੜੀ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ehaa paiee moo dhaataRee nit hiradhai rakhaa samaal ||3||
verses.translation: Please grant me this blessing, that that I may forever dwell upon You and cherish You within my heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਵ ਜੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਤਉ ਨੈਣੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: paav julaiee pa(n)dh tau nainee dharas dhikhaal ||
verses.translation: Let my feet walk on Your Path, and let my eyes behold the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sravanee sunee kahaaneeaa je gur theevai kirapaal ||4||
verses.translation: With my ears, I will listen to Your Sermon, if the Guru becomes merciful to me. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਿਤੀ ਲਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਪਿਰੀਏ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਨਿ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kitee lakh karoR pire'e rom na pujan teriaa ||
verses.translation: Hundreds of thousands and millions do not equal even one hair of Yours, O my Beloved.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਾਹੀ ਹੂ ਸਾਹੁ ਹਉ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: too saahee hoo saahu hau keh na sakaa gun teriaa ||5||
verses.translation: You are the King of kings; I cannot even describe Your Glorious Praises. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਹੀਆ ਤਊ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੰਞਹੁ ਹਭਿ ਵਧਾਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: saheeaa tuoo asa(n)kh ma(n)n(j)h habh vadhaaneeaa ||
verses.translation: Your brides are countless; they are all greater than I am.

verses.original: ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hik bhoree nadhar nihaal dheh dharas ra(n)g maaneeaa ||6||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Glance of Grace, even for an instant; please bless me with Your Darshan, that I may revel in Your Love. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਡਿਠੇ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੀਐ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਵੰਞਨਿੑ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jai ddiThe man dheereeaai kilavikh va(n)n(j)ni(h) dhoore ||
verses.translation: Seeing Him, my mind is comforted and consoled, and my sins and mistakes are far removed.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮਾਉ ਮੈ ਜੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: so kiau visarai maau mai jo rahiaa bharapoore ||7||
verses.translation: How could I ever forget Him, O my mother? He is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||7||

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਢਹਿ ਪਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hoi nimaanee ddeh piee miliaa sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: In humility, I bowed down in surrender to Him, and He naturally met me.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: poorab likhiaa paiaa naanak sa(n)t sahai ||8||1||4||
verses.translation: I have received what was pre-ordained for me, O Nanak, with the help and assistance of the Saints. ||8||1||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਨਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: simirat bedh puraan pukaaran potheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Simritees, the Vedas, the Puraanas and the other holy scriptures proclaim

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਗਾਲੑੀ ਹੋਛੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam binaa sabh kooR gaal(h)ee hochheeaa ||1||
verses.translation: that without the Naam, everything is false and worthless. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan apaar bhagataa man vasai ||
verses.translation: The infinite treasure of the Naam abides within the minds of the devotees.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran moh dhukh saadhoo sa(n)g nasai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Birth and death, attachment and suffering, are erased in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਬਾਦਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: moh baadh aha(n)kaar sarapar ru(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: Those who indulge in attachment, conflict and egotism shall surely weep and cry.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਮੂਲਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sukh na paini(h) mool naam vichhu(n)niaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are separated from the Naam shall never find any peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree dhaar ba(n)dhan ba(n)dhiaa ||
verses.translation: Crying out, Mine! Mine!, he is bound in bondage.

verses.original: ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: narak surag avataar maiaa dha(n)dhiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Entangled in Maya, he is reincarnated in heaven and hell. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sodhat sodhat sodh tat beechaariaa ||
verses.translation: Searching, searching, searching, I have come to understand the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam binaa sukh naeh sarapar haariaa ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, there is no peace at all, and the mortal will surely fail. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaveh jaeh anek mar mar janamate ||
verses.translation: Many come and go; they die, and die again, and are reincarnated.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਵਾਦਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮਤੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe sabh vaadh jonee bharamate ||5||
verses.translation: Without understanding, they are totally useless, and they wander in reincarnation. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kau bhe dhiaal tin(h) saadhoo sa(n)g bhiaa ||
verses.translation: They alone join the Saadh Sangat, unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਜਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har kaa naam tin(h)ee janee jap liaa ||6||
verses.translation: They chant and meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: khojeh koT asa(n)kh bahut ana(n)t ke ||
verses.translation: Uncounted millions, so many they are endless, search for Him.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਨੇੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis bujhaae aap neRaa tis he ||7||
verses.translation: But only that one, who understands his own self, sees God near at hand. ||7||

verses.original: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: visar naahee dhaataar aapanaa naam dheh ||
verses.translation: Never forget me, O Great Giver - please bless me with Your Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਉ ਏਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: gun gaavaa dhin raat naanak chaau eh ||8||2||5||16||
verses.translation: To sing Your Glorious Praises day and night - O Nanak, this is my heart-felt desire. ||8||2||5||16||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਕੁਚਜੀ
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa pehilaa kuchajee
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, First Mehla, Kuchajee ~ The Ungraceful Bride:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮੰਞੁ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਅੰਮਾਵਣਿ ਡੋਸੜੇ ਹਉ ਕਿਉ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)n(j) kuchajee a(n)maavan ddosaRe hau kiau sahu raavan jaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am ungraceful and ill-mannered, full of endless faults. How can I go to enjoy my Husband Lord?

verses.original: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕਿ ਚੜੰਦੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhoo ik chaRa(n)dheeaa kaun jaanai meraa naau jeeau ||
verses.translation: Each of His soul-brides is better than the rest - who even knows my name?

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅੰਬੀ ਛਾਵੜੀਏਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee sakhee sahu raaviaa se a(n)bee chhaavaRe'eh jeeau ||
verses.translation: Those brides who enjoy their Husband Lord are very blessed, resting in the shade of the mango tree.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੰਞੁ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਜੀ ਦੋਸ ਧਰੇਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: se gun ma(n)n(j) na aavanee hau kai jee dhos dhareau jeeau ||
verses.translation: I do not have their virtue - who can I blame for this?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿਥਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਘਿਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere vitharaa hau kiaa kiaa ghinaa teraa naau jeeau ||
verses.translation: Which of Your Virtues, O Lord, should I speak of? Which of Your Names should I chant?

verses.original: ਇਕਤੁ ਟੋਲਿ ਨ ਅੰਬੜਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eikat Tol na a(n)baRaa hau sadh kurabaanai terai jaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: I cannot even reach one of Your Virtues. I am forever a sacrifice to You.

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਤੈ ਮਾਣਿਕੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: suinaa rupaa ra(n)gulaa motee tai maanik jeeau ||
verses.translation: Gold, silver, pearls and rubies are pleasing.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਸਤੂ ਸਹਿ ਦਿਤੀਆ ਮੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: se vasatoo seh dhiteeaa mai tin(h) siau laiaa chit jeeau ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord has blessed me with these things, and I have focused my thoughts on them.

verses.original: ਮੰਦਰ ਮਿਟੀ ਸੰਦੜੇ ਪਥਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)dhar miTee sa(n)dhaRe pathar keete raas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Palaces of brick and mud are built and decorated with stones;

verses.original: ਹਉ ਏਨੀ ਟੋਲੀ ਭੁਲੀਅਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau enee Tolee bhuleeas tis ka(n)t na baiThee paas jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have been fooled by these decorations, and I do not sit near my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਬਰਿ ਕੂੰਜਾ ਕੁਰਲੀਆ ਬਗ ਬਹਿਠੇ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)bar koo(n)jaa kuraleeaa bag bahiThe aai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The cranes shriek overhead in the sky, and the herons have come to rest.

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਚਲੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan chalee saahurai kiaa muh dhesee agai jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: The bride has gone to her father-in-law's house; in the world hereafter, what face will she show?

verses.original: ਸੁਤੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਝਾਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਭੁਲੀ ਵਾਟੜੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sutee sutee jhaal theeaa bhulee vaaTaReeaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: She kept sleeping as the day dawned; she forgot all about her journey.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਹੁ ਮੁਤੀਅਸੁ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੂੰ ਧਰੀਆਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tai seh naalahu muteeas dhukhaa koo(n) dhareeaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: She separated herself from her Husband Lord, and now she suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tudh gun mai sabh avaganaa ik naanak kee aradhaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Virtue is in You, O Lord; I am totally without virtue. This is Nanak's only prayer:

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh raatee sohaaganee mai ddohaagan kaiee raat jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: You give all Your nights to the virtuous soul-brides. I know I am unworthy, but isn't there a night for me as well? ||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਸੁਚਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa suchajee ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla, Suchajee ~ The Noble And Graceful Bride:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੂ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too taa mai sabh ko too saahib meree raas jeeau ||
verses.translation: When I have You, then I have everything. O my Lord and Master, You are my wealth and capital.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tudh a(n)tar hau sukh vasaa too(n) a(n)tar saabaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Within You, I abide in peace; within You, I am congratulated.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਣੈ ਭੀਖ ਉਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai takhat vaddaieeaa bhaanai bheekh udhaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, You bestow thrones and greatness. And by the Pleasure of Your Will, You make us beggars and wanderers.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਵਹੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਫੁਲੈ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai thal sir sar vahai kamal fulai aakaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, the ocean flows in the desert, and the lotus blossoms in the sky.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਭਾਣੈ ਮੰਝਿ ਭਰੀਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai bhavajal la(n)gheeaai bhaanai ma(n)jh bhareeaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; by the Pleasure of Your Will, he sinks down into it.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai so sahu ra(n)gulaa sifat rataa gunataas jeeau ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of His Will, that Lord becomes my Husband, and I am imbued with the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਸਹੁ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਹਉ ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਮੁਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai sahu bheehaavalaa hau aavan jaan muieeaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will, O my Husband Lord, I am afraid of You, and I come and go, and die.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਹਉ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: too sahu agam atolavaa hau keh keh ddeh pieeaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: You, O my Husband Lord, are inaccessible and immeasurable; talking and speaking of You, I have fallen at Your Feet.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਮੈ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa maagau kiaa keh sunee mai dharasan bhookh piaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: What should I beg for? What should I say and hear? I am hungry and thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee sahu paiaa sach naanak kee aradhaas jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have found my Husband Lord. This is Nanak's true prayer. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa panjavaa gunava(n)tee ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehla, Gunvantee ~ The Worthy And Virtuous Bride:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai gursikhaRaa tis niv niv laagau pai jeeau ||
verses.translation: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet.

verses.original: ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aakhaa birathaa jeea kee gur sajan dheh milai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I tell to him the pain of my soul, and beg him to unite me with the Guru, my Best Friend.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਦਸਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: soiee dhas upadhesaRaa meraa man anat na kaahoo jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I ask that he impart to me such an understanding, that my mind will not go out wandering anywhere else.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂੰ ਡੇਵਸਾ ਮੈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih man tai koo(n) ddevasaa mai maarag dheh batai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I dedicate this mind to you. Please, show me the Path to God.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਆਇਆ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਚਲਿ ਕੈ ਮੈ ਤਕੀ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau aaiaa dhoorahu chal kai mai takee tau saranai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have come so far, seeking the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਆਸਾ ਰਖੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai aasaa rakhee chit meh meraa sabho dhukh gavai jeeau ||
verses.translation: Within my mind, I place my hopes in You; please, take my pain and suffering away!

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਭਾਈਅੜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eit maarag chale bhaieeaRe gur kahai su kaar kamai jeeau ||
verses.translation: So walk on this Path, O sister soul-brides; do that work which the Guru tells you to do.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗੇਂ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤੜੀ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiaage(n) man kee mataRee visaare(n) dhoojaa bhaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: Abandon the intellectual pursuits of the mind, and forget the love of duality.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਾਵੜਾ ਨਹ ਲਗੈ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: eiau paaveh har dharasaavaRaa neh lagai tatee vaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: In this way, you shall obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; the hot winds shall not even touch you.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਆਪਹੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਮੈ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau aapahu bol na jaanadhaa mai kahiaa sabh hukamaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: By myself, I do not even know how to speak; I speak all that the Lord commands.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਸਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagat khajaanaa bakhasiaa gur naanak keeaa pasaau jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am blessed with the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship; Guru Nanak has been kind and compassionate to me.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੜੀ ਹਉ ਰਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai bahuR na tirasanaa bhukhaRee hau rajaa tirapat aghai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I shall never again feel hunger or thirst; I am satisfied, satiated and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਖੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo gur dheesai sikhaRaa tis niv niv laagau pai jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: When I see a Sikh of the Guru, I humbly bow and fall at his feet. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮੈ ਮਤ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਹੁਣੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhar joban mai mat peieeaRai ghar paahunee bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with the wine of youth, I did not realize that I was only a guest at my parents' home (in this world).

verses.original: ਮੈਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਨੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mailee avagan chit bin gur gun na samaavanee bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: My consciousness is polluted with faults and mistakes; without the Guru, virtue does not even enter into me.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun saar na jaanee bharam bhulaanee joban baadh gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have not known the value of virtue; I have been deluded by doubt. I have wasted away my youth in vain.

verses.original: ਵਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: var ghar dhar dharasan nahee jaataa pir kaa sahaj na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have not known my Husband Lord, His celestial home and gate, or the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. I have not had the pleasure of my Husband Lord's celestial peace.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਾਲੀ ਸੂਤੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poochh na maarag chaalee sootee rain vihaanee ||
verses.translation: After consulting the True Guru, I have not walked on the Path; the night of my life is passing away in sleep.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਲਤਣਿ ਰਾਡੇਪਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak baalatan raaddepaa bin pir dhan kumalaanee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the prime of my youth, I am a widow; without my Husband Lord, the soul-bride is wasting away. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa mai var dheh mai har var bhaavai tis kee bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: O father, give me in marriage to the Lord; I am pleased with Him as my Husband. I belong to Him.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa jug chaar tirabhavan baanee jis kee bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: He is pervading throughout the four ages, and the Word of His Bani permeates the three worlds.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਕੰਤੁ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan ka(n)t ravai sohaagan avaganava(n)tee dhoore ||
verses.translation: The Husband Lord of the three worlds ravishes and enjoys His virtuous brides, but He keeps the ungraceful and unvirtuous ones far away.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੈਸੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee aasaa taisee manasaa poor rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: As are our hopes, so are our minds' desires, which the All-pervading Lord brings to fulfillment.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਾਂਡ ਨ ਮੈਲੈ ਵੇਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee naar su sarab suhaagan raa(n)dd na mailai vese ||
verses.translation: The bride of the Lord is forever happy and virtuous; she shall never be a widow, and she shall never have to wear dirty clothes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੈਸੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak mai var saachaa bhaavai jug jug preetam taise ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I love my True Husband Lord; my Beloved is the same, age after age. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa lagan ganai ha(n) bhee va(n)n(j)aa saahurai bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: O Baba, calculate that auspicious moment, when I too shall be going to my in-laws' house.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਨ ਟਲੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: saahaa hukam rajai so na Talai jo prabh karai bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: The moment of that marriage will be set by the Hukam of God's Command; His Will cannot be changed.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kirat piaa karatai kar paiaa meT na sakai koiee ||
verses.translation: The karmic record of past deeds, written by the Creator Lord, cannot be erased by anyone.

verses.original: ਜਾਞੀ ਨਾਉ ਨਰਹ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaan(j)ee naau nareh nihakeval rav rahiaa tih loiee ||
verses.translation: The most respected member of the marriage party, my Husband, is the independent Lord of all beings, pervading and permeating the three worlds.

verses.original: ਮਾਇ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਹੇਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: mai niraasee roi vichhu(n)nee baalee baalai hete ||
verses.translation: Maya, crying out in pain, leaves, seeing that the bride and the groom are in love.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saach sabadh sukh mahalee gur charanee prabh chete ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the peace of the Mansion of God's Presence comes through the True Word of the Shabad; the bride keeps the Guru's Feet enshrined in her mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਾਬੁਲਿ ਦਿਤੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਪੇਈਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: baabul dhitaRee dhoor naa aavai ghar peieeaai bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: My father has given me in marriage far away, and I shall not return to my parents' home.

verses.original: ਰਹਸੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਐ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rahasee vekh hadhoor pir raavee ghar soheeaai bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am delighted to see my Husband Lord near at hand; in His Home, I am so beautiful.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਪਿਰ ਲੋੜੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜੋੜੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: saache pir loRee preetam joRee mat pooree paradhaane ||
verses.translation: My True Beloved Husband Lord desires me; He has joined me to Himself, and made my intellect pure and sublime.

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jogee melaa thaan suhelaa gunava(n)tee gur giaane ||
verses.translation: By good destiny I met Him, and was given a place of rest; through the Guru's Wisdom, I have become virtuous.

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh sadhaa sach palai sach bolai pir bhaae ||
verses.translation: I gather lasting Truth and contentment in my lap, and my Beloved is pleased with my truthful speech.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak vichhuR naa dhukh paae gurmat a(n)k samaae ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I shall not suffer the pain of separation; through the Guru's Teachings, I merge into the loving embrace of the Lord's Being. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤੁ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, First Mehla, Chhant, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: ham ghar saajan aae ||
verses.translation: My friends have come into my home.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachai mel milaae ||
verses.translation: The True Lord has united me with them.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj milaae har man bhaae pa(n)ch mile sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord automatically united me with them when it pleased Him; uniting with the chosen ones, I have found peace.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saiee vasat paraapat hoiee jis setee man laiaa ||
verses.translation: I have obtained that thing, which my mind desired.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin mel bhiaa man maaniaa ghar ma(n)dhar sohaae ||
verses.translation: Meeting with them, night and day, my mind is pleased; my home and mansion are beautified.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sabadh dhun anahadh vaaje ham ghar saajan aae ||1||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrates and resounds; my friends have come into my home. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu meet piaare || ma(n)gal gaavahu naare ||
verses.translation: So come, my beloved friends, and sing the songs of joy, O sisters.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sach ma(n)gal gaavahu taa prabh bhaavahu sohilaRaa jug chaare ||
verses.translation: Sing the true songs of joy and God will be pleased. You shall be celebrated throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: apanai ghar aaiaa thaan suhaiaa kaaraj sabadh savaare ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord has come into my home, and my place is adorned and decorated. Through the Shabad, my affairs have been resolved.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: giaan mahaa ras netree a(n)jan tirabhavan roop dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Applying the ointment, the supreme essence, of divine wisdom to my eyes, I see the Lord's form throughout the three worlds.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਰਸਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sakhee milahu ras ma(n)gal gaavahu ham ghar saajan aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: So join with me, my sisters, and sing the songs of joy and delight; my friends have come into my home. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)mirat bhi(n)naa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are drenched with Ambrosial Nectar;

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਤੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar prem rata(n)naa ||
verses.translation: deep within the nucleus of my self, is the jewel of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ratan padhaarath merai param tat veechaaro ||
verses.translation: This invaluable jewel is deep within me; I contemplate the supreme essence of reality.

verses.original: ਜੰਤ ਭੇਖ ਤੂ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: ja(n)t bhekh too safalio dhaataa sir sir dhevanahaaro ||
verses.translation: Living beings are mere beggars; You are the Giver of rewards; You are the Giver to each and every being.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਾਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: too jaan giaanee a(n)tarajaamee aape kaaran keenaa ||
verses.translation: You are Wise and All-knowing, the Inner-knower; You Yourself created the creation.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sunahu sakhee man mohan mohiaa tan man a(n)mirat bheenaa ||3||
verses.translation: So listen, O my sisters - the Enticer has enticed my mind. My body and mind are drenched with Nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aatam raam sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Soul of the World,

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa khel tum(h)aaraa ||
verses.translation: Your play is true.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sach khel tum(h)aaraa agam apaaraa tudh bin kaun bujhaae ||
verses.translation: Your play is true, O Inaccessible and Infinite Lord; without You, who can make me understand?

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik siaane kete tujh bin kavan kahaae ||
verses.translation: There are millions of Siddhas and enlightened seekers, but without You, who can call himself one?

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਭਏ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaal bikaal bhe dhevaane man raakhiaa gur Thaae ||
verses.translation: Death and rebirth drive the mind insane; only the Guru can hold it in its place.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak avagan sabadh jalaae gun sa(n)gam prabh paae ||4||1||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who burns away his demerits and faults with the Shabad, accumulates virtue, and finds God. ||4||1||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, First Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sajanaa hau dhekhaa dharasan teraa raam ||
verses.translation: Come, my friend, so that I may behold the blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਆਪਨੜੈ ਖੜੀ ਤਕਾ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ghar aapanaRai khaRee takaa mai man chaau ghaneraa raam ||
verses.translation: I stand in my doorway, watching for You; my mind is filled with such a great yearning.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: man chaau ghaneraa sun prabh meraa mai teraa bharavaasaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with such a great yearning; hear me, O God - I place my faith in You.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekh bhiee nihakeval janam maran dhukh naasaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have become free of desire; the pains of birth and death are taken away.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਤੂ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sagalee jot jaataa too soiee miliaa bhai subhaae ||
verses.translation: Your Light is in everyone; through it, You are known. Through love, You are easily met.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saajan kau bal jaieeaai saach mile ghar aae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Friend; He has come home to meet with those who are true. ||1||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਤਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ghar aaiaRe saajanaa taa dhan kharee sarasee raam ||
verses.translation: When her Friend comes to her home, the bride is very pleased.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੰਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har mohiaRee saach sabadh Thaakur dhekh raha(n)see raam ||
verses.translation: She is fascinated with the True Word of the Lord's Shabad; gazing upon her Lord and Master, she is filled with joy.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੰਸੀ ਖਰੀ ਸਰਸੀ ਜਾ ਰਾਵੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: gun sa(n)g raha(n)see kharee sarasee jaa raavee ra(n)g raatai ||
verses.translation: She is filled with virtuous joy, and is totally pleased, when she is ravished and enjoyed by her Lord, and imbued with His Love.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: avagan maar gunee ghar chhaiaa poorai purakh bidhaatai ||
verses.translation: Her faults and demerits are eradicated, and she roofs her home with virtue, through the Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਸੀ ਪੰਚਾਇਣਿ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tasakar maar vasee pa(n)chain adhal kare veechaare ||
verses.translation: Conquering the thieves, she dwells as the mistress of her home, and administers justice wisely.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak raam naam nisataaraa gurmat mileh piaare ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, she is emancipated; through the Guru's Teachings, she meets her Beloved. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: var paiaRaa baalaRe'e aasaa manasaa pooree raam ||
verses.translation: The young bride has found her Husband Lord; her hopes and desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵਿਅੜੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਲੀ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਹ ਦੂਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pir raaviaRee sabadh ralee rav rahiaa neh dhooree raam ||
verses.translation: She enjoys and ravishes her Husband Lord, and blends into the Word of the Shabad, pervading and permeating everywhere; the Lord is not far away.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhoor na hoiee ghaT ghaT soiee tis kee naar sabaiee ||
verses.translation: God is not far away; He is in each and every heart. All are His brides.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape raseeaa aape raave jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Enjoyer, He Himself ravishes and enjoys; this is His glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: amar addol amol apaaraa gur poorai sach paieeaai ||
verses.translation: He is imperishable, immovable, invaluable and infinite. The True Lord is obtained through the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਜੋਗ ਸਜੋਗੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak aape jog sajogee nadhar kare liv laieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself unites in Union; by His Glance of Grace, He lovingly attunes them to Himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਉਚੜੀਐ ਮਾੜੜੀਐ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਆ ਸਿਰਤਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pir uchaReeaai maaRaReeaai tih loaa sirataajaa raam ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord dwells in the loftiest balcony; He is the Supreme Lord of the three worlds.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਦੇਖਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: hau bisam bhiee dhekh gunaa anahadh sabadh agaajaa raam ||
verses.translation: I am amazed, gazing upon His glorious excellence; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resonates.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh veechaaree karanee saaree raam naam neesaano ||
verses.translation: I contemplate the Shabad, and perform sublime deeds; I am blessed with the insignia, the banner of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਖੋਟੇ ਨਹੀ ਠਾਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa khoTe nahee Thaahar naam ratan paravaano ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the false find no place of rest; only the jewel of the Naam brings acceptance and renown.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: pat mat pooree pooraa paravaanaa naa aavai naa jaasee ||
verses.translation: Perfect is my honor, perfect is my intellect and password. I shall not have to come or go.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh aap pachhaanai prabh jaise avinaasee ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands her own self; she becomes like her Imperishable Lord God. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ghar chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Chhant, First Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa jag dha(n)dhaRai laiaa ||
verses.translation: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks.

verses.original: ਦਾਨਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਤਨਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaan terai ghaT chaananaa tan cha(n)dh dheepaiaa ||
verses.translation: Your gifts, O Lord, illuminate the heart, and the moon casts its light on the body.

verses.original: ਚੰਦੋ ਦੀਪਾਇਆ ਦਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dho dheepaiaa dhaan har kai dhukh a(n)dheraa uTh giaa ||
verses.translation: The moon glows, by the Lord's gift, and the darkness of suffering is taken away.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਜੰਞ ਲਾੜੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਪਰਖਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਐ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun ja(n)n(j) laaRe naal sohai parakh mohaneeaai liaa ||
verses.translation: The marriage party of virtue looks beautiful with the Groom; He chooses His enticing bride with care.

verses.original: ਵੀਵਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੋਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: veevaahu hoaa sobh setee pa(n)ch sabadhee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The wedding is performed with glorious splendor; He has arrived, accompanied by the vibrations of the Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧੜੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tin dhekhiaa jag dha(n)dhaRai laiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The One who created the world, watches over it; He enjoins the people of the world to their tasks. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮੀਤਾ ਅਵਰੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਡਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan jin siau gaaddiaa man leeaRaa dheetaa ||
verses.translation: This body is attached to them, and we have shared our minds.

verses.original: ਲੀਆ ਤ ਦੀਆ ਮਾਨੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਸੇ ਸਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: leeaa ta dheeaa maan jin(h) siau se sajan kiau veesareh ||
verses.translation: We have shared our minds - how could I forget those friends?

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਹੋਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਅ ਸੇਤੀ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) dhis aaiaa hoh raleeaa jeea setee geh raheh ||
verses.translation: Seeing them brings joy to my heart; I keep them clasped to my soul.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਹਿ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal gun avagan na koiee hoh neetaa neetaa ||
verses.translation: They have all virtues and merits, forever and ever; they have no demerits or faults at all.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮੀਤਾ ਅਵਰੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree saajanaa meetaa avareetaa ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my pure friends, the immaculate Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadd vaas lieejai ||
verses.translation: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਨਿੑ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: je gun hovani(h) saajanaa mil saajh kareejai ||
verses.translation: If my friends have virtues, I will share in them.

verses.original: ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਗੁਣਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: saajh kareejai guneh keree chhodd avagan chaleeaai ||
verses.translation: Let us form a partnership, and share our virtues; let us abandon our faults, and walk on the Path.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਰੇ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: pahire paTa(n)bar kar adda(n)bar aapanaa piR maleeaai ||
verses.translation: Let us wear our virtues like silk clothes; let us decorate ourselves, and enter the arena.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਝੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jithai jai baheeaai bhalaa kaheeaai jhol a(n)mrit peejai ||
verses.translation: Let us speak of goodness, wherever we go and sit; let us skim off the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadd vaas lieejai ||3||
verses.translation: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap kare kis aakheeaai hor kare na koiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything.

verses.original: ਆਖਣ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲੜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aakhan taa kau jaieeaai je bhoolaRaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: Go ahead and complain to Him, if He makes a mistake.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: je hoi bhoolaa jai kaheeaai aap karataa kiau bhulai ||
verses.translation: If He makes a mistake, go ahead and complain to Him; but how can the Creator Himself make a mistake?

verses.original: ਸੁਣੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਕਹਿਐ ਦਾਨੁ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਿਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sune dhekhe baajh kahiaai dhaan anama(n)giaa dhivai ||
verses.translation: He sees, He hears, and without our asking, without our begging, He gives His gifts.

verses.original: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhaan dhei dhaataa jag bidhaataa naanakaa sach soiee ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver, the Architect of the Universe, gives His gifts. O Nanak, He is the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: aap kare kis aakheeaai hor kare na koiee ||4||1||4||
verses.translation: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything. ||4||1||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soiee ||
