verses.translation: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee pauRee saach kee saachaa sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Truth is the ladder to the Guru; climbing up to the True Lord, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਟਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sahaj aavai saach bhaavai saach kee mat kiau Talai ||
verses.translation: Celestial peace comes; the Truth pleases me. How could these True Teachings ever be erased?

verses.original: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਛਲਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: eisanaan dhaan sugiaan majan aap achhalio kiau chhalai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is Undeceivable; how could He ever be deceived by cleansing baths, charity, spiritual wisdom or ritual bathings?

verses.original: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਦੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: parapa(n)ch moh bikaar thaake kooR kapaT na dhoiee ||
verses.translation: Fraud, attachment and corruption are taken away, as are falsehood, hypocrisy and duality.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soiee ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: saahib so saalaaheeaai jin kaaran keeaa ||
verses.translation: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation.

verses.original: ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲਿਐ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: mail laagee man mailiaai kinai a(n)mrit peeaa ||
verses.translation: Filth sticks to the polluted mind; how rare are those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: math a(n)mrit peeaa ih man dheeaa gur peh mol karaiaa ||
verses.translation: Churn this Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in; dedicate this mind to the Guru, and He will value it highly.

verses.original: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaRaa prabh sahaj pachhaataa jaa man saachai laiaa ||
verses.translation: I intuitively realized my God, when I linked my mind to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis naal gun gaavaa je tis bhaavaa kiau milai hoi paraiaa ||
verses.translation: I will sing the Lord's Glorious Praises with Him, if it pleases Him; how could I meet Him by being a stranger to Him?

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saahib so saalaaheeaai jin jagat upaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਕੀ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਕਿਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: aai giaa kee na aaio kiau aavai jaataa ||
verses.translation: When He comes, what else remains behind? How can there be any coming or going then?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: preetam siau man maaniaa har setee raataa ||
verses.translation: When the mind is reconciled with its Beloved Lord, it is blended with Him.

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saahib ra(n)g raataa sach kee baataa jin bi(n)b kaa koT usaariaa ||
verses.translation: True is the speech of one who is imbued with the Love of his Lord and Master, who fashioned the body fortress from a mere bubble.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bhoo naiko aap sira(n)dhaa jin sach kaa pi(n)dd savaariaa ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the five elements; He Himself is the Creator Lord. He embellished the body with Truth.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham avaganiaare too sun piaare tudh bhaavai sach soiee ||
verses.translation: I am worthless; please hear me, O my Beloved! Whatever pleases You is True.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa naa theeaai saachee mat hoiee ||3||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with true understanding, does not come and go. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅੰਜੀਐ ਜੈਸਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan taisaa a(n)jeeaai jaisaa pir bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Apply such an ointment to your eyes, which is pleasing to your Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: samajhai soojhai jaaneeaai je aap jaanaavai ||
verses.translation: I realize, understand and know Him, only if He Himself causes me to know Him.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਲੇਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap jaanaavai maarag paavai aape manooaa leve ||
verses.translation: He Himself shows me the Way, and He Himself leads me to it, attracting my mind.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਅਭੇਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: karam sukaram karaae aape keemat kaun abheve ||
verses.translation: He Himself causes us to do good and bad deeds; who can know the value of the Mysterious Lord?

verses.original: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)dd na jaanaa raam ridhai man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: I know nothing of Tantric spells, magical mantras and hypocritical rituals; enshrining the Lord within my heart, my mind is satisfied.

verses.original: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: a(n)jan naam tisai te soojhai gur sabadhee sach jaaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: The ointment of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is only understood by one who realizes the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਿਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saajan hovan aapane kiau par ghar jaahee ||
verses.translation: I have my own friends; why should I go to the home of a stranger?

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saajan raate sach ke sa(n)ge man maahee ||
verses.translation: My friends are imbued with the True Lord; He is with them, in their minds.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁੰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man maeh saajan kareh raleeaa karam dharam sabaiaa || aThasaTh teerath pu(n)n poojaa naam saachaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: In their minds, these friends celebrate in happiness; all good karma, righteousness and Dharma, the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, charity and worship, are found in the love of the True Name.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਾਜੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap saaje thaap vekhai tisai bhaanaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates, establishes and beholds all, by the Pleasure of His Will.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਂਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਲੜੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saajan raa(n)g ra(n)geelaRe ra(n)g laal banaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: My friends are happy in the Love of the Lord; they nurture love for their Beloved. ||5||

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਆਗੂ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa aagoo je theeaai kiau paadhar jaanai ||
verses.translation: If a blind man is made the leader, how will he know the way?

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਮੁਸੈ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਛੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap musai mat hochheeaai kiau raahu pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: He is impaired, and his understanding is inadequate; how will he know the way?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਰਾਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਧ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiau raeh jaavai mahal paavai a(n)dh kee mat a(n)dhalee ||
verses.translation: How can he follow the path and reach the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? Blind is the understanding of the blind.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੂਡੌ ਧੰਧਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: vin naam har ke kachh na soojhai a(n)dh booddau dha(n)dhalee ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, they cannot see anything; the blind are drowned in worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਚਾਉ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhin raat chaanan chaau upajai sabadh gur kaa man vasai ||
verses.translation: Day and night, the Divine Light shines forth and joy wells up, when the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides in the mind.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਸੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kar joR gur peh kar bina(n)tee raahu paadhar gur dhasai ||6||
verses.translation: With your palms pressed together, pray to the Guru to show you the way. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man paradhesee je theeaai sabh dhes paraiaa ||
verses.translation: If the man becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him.

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਖੋਲੑਉ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kis peh khol(h)au ga(n)ThaRee dhookhee bhar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Unto whom should I tie up and give the bundle of my pains?

verses.original: ਦੂਖੀ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhookhee bhar aaiaa jagat sabaiaa kaun jaanai bidh mereeaa ||
verses.translation: The whole world is overflowing with pain and suffering; who can know the state of my inner self?

verses.original: ਆਵਣੇ ਜਾਵਣੇ ਖਰੇ ਡਰਾਵਣੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫੇਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavane jaavane khare ddaraavane toT na aavai fereeaa ||
verses.translation: Comings and goings are terrible and dreadful; there is no end to the rounds of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਊਣੇ ਝੂਣੇ ਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naam vihoone uoone jhoone naa gur sabadh sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, he is vacant and sad; he does not listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਪਰਦੇਸੀ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: man paradhesee je theeaai sabh dhes paraiaa ||7||
verses.translation: If the mind becomes a stranger to God, then all the world becomes a stranger to him. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharapur leenaa ||
verses.translation: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevak sevaa taa(n) kare sach sabadh pateenaa ||
verses.translation: The sevadar performs selfless service when he is pleased, and confirmed in the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਅੰਕੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਅੰਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe pateejai a(n)k bheejai su mahal mahalaa a(n)tare ||
verses.translation: Confirmed in the Shabad, with her being softened by devotion, the bride dwells in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, deep within her being.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aap karataa kare soiee prabh aap a(n)t nira(n)tare ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself creates; God Himself, in the end, is endless.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਬਾਜੰਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh melaa taa(n) suhelaa baaja(n)t anahadh beenaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mortal is united, and then embellished; the unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੋ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur mahalee ghar aapanai so bharipur leenaa ||8||
verses.translation: One who finds the Guru's Mansion within the home of his own being, merges in the All-pervading Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeaai kar vekhai soiee ||
verses.translation: Why praise that which is created? Praise instead the One who created it and watches over it.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat na pavai je lochai koiee ||
verses.translation: His value cannot be estimated, no matter how much one may wish.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਏ ॥
verses.translit: keemat so paavai aap jaanaavai aap abhul na bhule ||
verses.translation: He alone can estimate the Lord's value, whom the Lord Himself causes to know. He is not mistaken; He does not make mistakes.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਮੁਲਏ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar kareh tudh bhaaveh gur kai sabadh amule ||
verses.translation: He alone celebrates victory, who is pleasing to You, through the Invaluable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹੀਣਉ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: heenau neech karau bena(n)tee saach na chhoddau bhaiee ||
verses.translation: I am lowly and abject - I offer my prayer; may I never forsake the True Name, O Sibling of Destiny.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੯॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak jin kar dhekhiaa dhevai mat saiee ||9||2||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the One who created the creation, watches over it; He alone bestows understanding. ||9||2||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Third Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sohilaRaa har dhiaavahu ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har fal paavahu ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, obtain the Lord's fruitful rewards.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh fal paavahu har naam dhiaavahu janam janam ke dhookh nivaare ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, obtain the fruit of the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name; the pains of countless lifetimes shall be erased.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur apane viTahu jin kaaraj sabh savaare ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has arranged and resolved all my affairs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh kirapaa kare har jaapahu sukh fal har jan paavahu ||
verses.translation: The Lord God will bestow His Grace, if you meditate on the Lord; O humble servant of the Lord, you shall obtain the fruit of peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kahai sunahu jan bhaiee sukh sohilaRaa har dhiaavahu ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen O humble Sibling of Destiny: meditate on the Lord, and find peace and pleasure. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sun har gun bheene sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat sahaje naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, I meditate intuitively on the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau dhur likhiaa tin gur miliaa tin janam maran bhau bhaagaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meet the Guru, and their fears of birth and death leave them.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਖੋਈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu dhuramat dhoojee khoiee so jan har liv laagaa ||
verses.translation: One who eliminates evil-mindedness and duality from within himself, that humble being lovingly focuses his mind on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau kirapaa keenee merai suaamee tin anadhin har gun gaae ||
verses.translation: Those, upon whom my Lord and Master bestows His Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sun man bheene sahaj subhaae ||2||
verses.translation: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jug meh raam naam nisataaraa ||
verses.translation: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur te upajai sabadh veechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad emanates from the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh veechaaraa raam naam piaaraa jis kirapaa kare su paae ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, one comes to love the Lord's Name; he alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje gun gaavai dhin raatee kilavikh sabh gavaae ||
verses.translation: In peace and poise, he sings the Lord's Praises day and night, and all sins are eradicated.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko teraa too sabhanaa kaa hau teraa too hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: All are Yours, and You belong to all. I am Yours, and You are mine.

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jug meh raam naam nisataaraa ||3||
verses.translation: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: saajan aai vuThe ghar maahee ||
verses.translation: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart;

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaaveh tirapat aghaahee ||
verses.translation: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gai sadhaa tirapataasee fir bhookh na laagai aae ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied forever, never to feel hunger again.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis pooj hovai har jan kee jo har har naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: That humble servant of the Lord, who meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is worshipped in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak har aape joR vichhoRe har bin ko dhoojaa naahee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself joins and separates; there is no other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: saajan aai vuThe ghar maahee ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart. ||4||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa teejaa ghar teejaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Third Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kee har jeeau raakhai jug jug rakhadhaa aaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord protects His humble devotees; throughout the ages, He has protected them.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: so bhagat jo gurmukh hovai haumai sabadh jalaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Those devotees who become Gurmukh burn away their ego, through the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: haumai sabadh jalaiaa mere har bhaiaa jis dhee saachee baanee ||
verses.translation: Those who burn away their ego through the Shabad, become pleasing to my Lord; their speech becomes True.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachee bhagat kareh dhin raatee gurmukh aakh vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: They perform the Lord's true devotional service, day and night, as the Guru has instructed them.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਸਚੀ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kee chaal sachee at niramal naam sachaa man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The devotees' lifestyle is true, and absolutely pure; the True Name is pleasing to their minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagat soheh dhar saachai jinee sacho sach kamaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the those devotees, who practice Truth, and only Truth, look beauteous in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa kee jaat pat hai bhagat har kai naam samaane raam ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the social class and honor of His devotees; the Lord's devotees merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagat kareh vichahu aap gavaaveh jin gun avagan pachhaane raam ||
verses.translation: They worship the Lord in devotion, and eradicate self-conceit from within themselves; they understand merits and demerits.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: gun aaugan pachhaanai har naam vakhaanai bhai bhagat meeThee laagee ||
verses.translation: They understand merits and demerits, and chant the Lord's Name; devotional worship is sweet to them.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee ghar hee meh bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night, and in the home of the self, they remain detached.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagatee raate sadhaa man niramal har jeeau vekheh sadhaa naale ||
verses.translation: Imbued with devotion, their minds remain forever immaculate and pure; they see their Dear Lord always with them.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak se bhagat har kai dhar saache anadhin naam sam(h)aale ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those devotees are True in the Court of the Lord; night and day, they dwell upon the Naam. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhagat kareh bin satigur vin satigur bhagat na hoiee raam ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs practice devotional rituals without the True Guru, but without the True Guru, there is no devotion.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maiaa rog viaape mar janameh dhukh hoiee raam ||
verses.translation: They are afflicted with the diseases of egotism and Maya, and they suffer the pains of death and rebirth.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mar janameh dhukh hoiee dhoojai bhai paraj vigoiee vin gur tat na jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The world suffers the pains of death and rebirth, and through the love of duality, it is ruined; without the Guru, the essence of reality is not known.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vihoonaa sabh jag bharamiaa a(n)t giaa pachhutaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship, everyone in the world is deluded and confused, and in the end, they depart with regrets.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: koT madhe kinai pachhaaniaa har naamaa sach soiee ||
verses.translation: Among millions, there is scarcely one who realizes the Name of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; in the love of duality, all honor is lost. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kai ghar kaaraj saachaa har gun sadhaa vakhaane raam ||
verses.translation: In the home of the devotees, is the joy of true marriage; they chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੀਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat khajaanaa aape dheeaa kaal ka(n)Tak maar samaane raam ||
verses.translation: He Himself blesses them with the treasure of devotion; conquering the thorny pain of death, they merge in the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaal ka(n)Tak maar samaane har man bhaane naam nidhaan sach paiaa ||
verses.translation: Conquering the thorny pain of death, they merge in the Lord; they are pleasing to the Lord's Mind, and they obtain the true treasure of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa akhuT kadhe na nikhuTai har dheeaa sahaj subhaiaa ||
verses.translation: This treasure is inexhaustible; it will never be exhausted. The Lord automatically blesses them with it.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਊਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jan uooche sadh hee uooche gur kai sabadh suhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are exalted and elevated, forever on high; they are adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak aape bakhas milaae jug jug sobhaa paiaa ||4||1||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself forgives them, and merges them with Himself; throughout the ages, they are glorified. ||4||1||2||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਜਿਥੈ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh sachai sach sohilaa jithai sache kaa hoi veechaaro raam ||
verses.translation: Through the True Word of the Shabad, true happiness prevails, there where the True Lord is contemplated.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: haumai sabh kilavikh kaaTe saach rakhiaa ur dhaare raam ||
verses.translation: Egotism and all sins are eradicated, when one keeps the True Lord enshrined in the heart.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach rakhiaa ur dhaare dhutar taare fir bhavajal taran na hoiee ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the True Lord enshrined in the heart, crosses over the terrible and dreadful world-ocean; he shall not have to cross over it again.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa satigur sachee baanee jin sach vikhaaliaa soiee ||
verses.translation: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; through it, the True Lord is seen.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saache gun gaavai sach samaavai sach vekhai sabh soiee ||
verses.translation: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord merges in Truth; he beholds the True Lord everywhere.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saachaa saahib saachee naiee sach nisataaraa hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; through Truth, comes emancipation. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saachai satigur saach bujhaiaa pat raakhai sach soiee raam ||
verses.translation: The True Guru reveals the True Lord; the True Lord preserves our honor.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa bhojan bhaau sachaa hai sachai naam sukh hoiee raam ||
verses.translation: The true food is love for the True Lord; through the True Name, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: saachai naam sukh hoiee marai na koiee garabh na joonee vaasaa ||
verses.translation: Through the True Name, the mortal finds peace; he shall never die, and never again enter the womb of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milaiee sach samaiee sach nai paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: His light blends with the Light, and he merges into the True Lord; he is illuminated and enlightened with the True Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਹੋਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee sach jaataa se sache hoe anadhin sach dhiaain ||
verses.translation: Those who know the Truth are True; night and day, they meditate on Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sach naam jin hiradhai vasiaa naa veechhuR dhukh pain ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those whose hearts are filled with the True Name, never suffer the pains of separation. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee sache gun gaaveh tit ghar sohilaa hoiee raam ||
verses.translation: In that home, and in that heart, where the True Bani of the Lord's True Praises are sung, the songs of joy resound.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: niramal gun saache tan man saachaa vich saachaa purakh prabh soiee raam ||
verses.translation: Through the immaculate virtues of the True Lord, the body and mind are rendered True, and God, the True Primal Being, dwells within.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sach varatai sacho bolai jo sach karai su hoiee ||
verses.translation: Such a person practices only Truth, and speaks only Truth; whatever the True Lord does, that alone comes to pass.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸਚੁ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh sach pasariaa avar na dhoojaa koiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see the True Lord pervading; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sache upajai sach samaavai mar janamai dhoojaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: From the True Lord, we emanate, and into the True Lord, we shall merge; death and birth come from duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh kichh aape karataa aap karaavai soiee ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself does everything; He Himself is the Cause. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sache bhagat soheh dharavaare sacho sach vakhaane raam ||
verses.translation: The true devotees look beautiful in the Darbaar of the Lord's Court. They speak Truth, and only Truth.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੋ ਆਪਿ ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT a(n)tare saachee baanee saacho aap pachhaane raam ||
verses.translation: Deep within the nucleus of their heart, is the True Word of the Lord's Bani. Through the Truth, they understand themselves.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap pachhaaneh taa sach jaaneh saache sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: They understand themselves, and so know the True Lord, through their true intuition.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੀ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh sachee hai sobhaa saache hee sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: True is the Shabad, and True is its Glory; peace comes only from Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਗਤ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saach rate bhagat ik ra(n)gee dhoojaa ra(n)g na koiee ||
verses.translation: Imbued with Truth, the devotees love the One Lord; they do not love any other.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak jis kau masatak likhiaa tis sach paraapat hoiee ||4||2||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone obtains the True Lord, who has such pre-ordained destiny written upon his forehead. ||4||2||3||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਧਨ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jug chaare dhan je bhavai bin satigur sohaag na hoiee raam ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride may wander throughout the four ages, but still, without the True Guru, she will not find her True Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: nihachal raaj sadhaa har keraa tis bin avar na koiee raam ||
verses.translation: The Kingdom of the Lord is permanent, and forever unchanging; there is no other than Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin avar na koiee sadhaa sach soiee gurmukh eko jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: There is no other than Him - He is True forever; the Gurmukh knows the One Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhan pir melaavaa hoaa gurmatee man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: That soul-bride, whose mind accepts the Guru's Teachings, meets her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaa taa har paiaa bin har naavai mukat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, she finds the Lord; without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੈ ਰਾਵੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman ka(n)tai raave man maaniaai sukh hoiee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride ravishes and enjoys her Husband Lord; her mind accepts Him, and she finds peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev dhan baalaRe'e har var paaveh soiee raam ||
verses.translation: Serve the True Guru, O young and innocent bride; thus you shall obtain the Lord as your Husband.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa hoveh sohaaganee fir mailaa ves na hoiee raam ||
verses.translation: You shall be the virtuous and happy bride of the True Lord forever; and you shall never again wear soiled clothes.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: fir mailaa ves na hoiee gurmukh boojhai koiee haumai maar pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Your clothes shall never again be soiled; how rare are those few, who, as Gurmukh, recognize this, and conquer their ego.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: karanee kaar kamaavai sabadh samaavai a(n)tar eko jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: So make your practice the practice of good deeds; merge into the Word of the Shabad, and deep within, come to know the One Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh prabh raave dhin raatee aapanaa saachee sobhaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh enjoys God, day and night, and so obtains true glory.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kaaman pir raave aapanaa rav rahiaa prabh soiee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the soul-bride enjoys and ravishes her Beloved; God is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee kaar kare dhan baalaRe'e har var dhei milaae raam ||
verses.translation: Serve the Guru, O young and innocent soul-bride, and he will lead to you meet your Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har kai ra(n)g ratee hai kaaman mil preetam sukh paae raam ||
verses.translation: The bride is imbued with the Love of her Lord; meeting with her Beloved, she finds peace.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mil preetam sukh paae sach samaae sach varatai sabh thaiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting her Beloved, she finds peace, and merges in the True Lord; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa seegaar kare dhin raatee kaaman sach samaiee ||
verses.translation: The bride makes Truth her decorations, day and night, and remains absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਲਇਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har sukhadhaataa sabadh pachhaataa kaaman liaa ka(n)Th laae ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, is realized through His Shabad; He hugs His bride close in His embrace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak mahalee mahal pachhaanai gurmatee har paae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the bride obtains the Mansion of His Presence; through the Guru's Teachings, she finds her Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saa dhan baalee dhur melee merai prabh aap milaiee raam ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord, my God, has united His young and innocent bride with Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee ghaT chaanan hoaa prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaiee raam ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, her heart is illumined and enlightened; God is permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh rav rahiaa sabh thaiee ma(n)n vasaiee poorab likhiaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: God is permeating and pervading everywhere; He dwells in her mind, and she realizes her pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sej sukhaalee mere prabh bhaanee sach seegaar banaiaa ||
verses.translation: On his cozy bed, she is pleasing to my God; she fashions her decorations of Truth.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman niramal haumai mal khoiee gurmat sach samaiee ||
verses.translation: The bride is immaculate and pure; she washes away the filth of egotism, and through the Guru's Teachings, she merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਕਰਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aap milaiee karatai naam navai nidh paiee ||4||3||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Creator Lord blends her into Himself, and she obtains the nine treasure of the Naam. ||4||3||4||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har hare har gun gaavahu har gurmukhe paae raam ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; the Gurmukh obtains the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵਹੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: anadhino sabadh ravahu anahadh sabadh vajaae raam ||
verses.translation: Night and day, chant the Word of the Shabad; night and day, the Shabad shall vibrate and resound.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh vajaae har jeeau ghar aae har gun gaavahu naaree ||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody of the Shabad vibrates, and the Dear Lord comes into the home of my heart; O ladies, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhagat kareh gur aagai saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
verses.translation: That soul-bride, who performs devotional worship service to the Guru night and day, becomes the Beloved bride of her Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar se jan sabadh suhaae ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, whose hearts are filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, are adorned with the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin ghar sadh hee sohilaa har kar kirapaa ghar aae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, their hearts are forever filled with happiness; the Lord, in His Mercy, enters into their hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa man aana(n)dh bhiaa har naam rahe liv laae raam ||
verses.translation: The minds of the devotees are filled with bliss; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhe man niramal hoaa niramal har gun gaae raam ||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh is immaculate and pure; she sings the Immaculate Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: niramal gun gaae naam ma(n)n vasaae har kee a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: Singing His Immaculate Praises, she enshrines in her mind the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Ambrosial Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) man vasiaa seiee jan nisatare ghaT ghaT sabadh samaanee ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings, within whose minds it abides, are emancipated; the Shabad permeates each and every heart.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tere gun gaaveh sahaj samaaveh sabadhe mel milaae ||
verses.translation: Singing Your Glorious Praises, they merge naturally into You, O Lord; through the Shabad, they are united in Union with You.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak safal janam tin keraa j satigur har maarag paae ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, their lives are fruitful; the True Guru places them on the Lord's Path. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)gat siau mel bhiaa har har naam samaae raam ||
verses.translation: Those who join the Society of the Saints are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sadh jeevan mukat bhe har kai naam liv laae raam ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are forever 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive; they are lovingly absorbed in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam chit laae gur mel milaae manooaa rataa har naale ||
verses.translation: They center their consciousness on the Lord's Name; through the Guru, they are united in His Union. Their minds are imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa paiaa moh chukaiaa anadhin naam sam(h)aale ||
verses.translation: They find the Lord, the Giver of peace, and they eradicate attachments; night and day, they contemplate the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhe raataa sahaje maataa naam man vasaae ||
verses.translation: They are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and intoxicated with celestial peace; the Naam abides in their minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak tin ghar sadh hee sohilaa j satigur sev samaae ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the homes of their hearts are filled with happiness, forever and always; they are absorbed in serving the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur jag bharam bhulaiaa har kaa mahal na paiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the world is deluded by doubt; it does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukhe ik mel milaiaa tin ke dhookh gavaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, some are united in the Lord's Union, and their pains are dispelled.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tin ke dhookh gavaiaa jaa har man bhaiaa sadhaa gaaveh ra(n)g raate ||
verses.translation: Their pains are dispelled, when it is pleasing to the Lord's Mind; imbued with His Love, they sing His Praises forever.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke bhagat sadhaa jan niramal jug jug sadh hee jaate ||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees are pure and humble forever; throughout the ages, they are forever respected.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਪਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: saachee bhagat kareh dhar jaapeh ghar dhar sachaa soiee ||
verses.translation: They perform true devotional worship service, and are honored in the Lord's Court; the True Lord is their hearth and home.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa sohilaa sachee sach baanee sabadhe hee sukh hoiee ||4||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, true are their songs of joy, and true is their word; through the Word of the Shabad, they find peace. ||4||4||5||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: je loReh var baalaRe'e taa gur charanee chit laae raam ||
verses.translation: If you long for your Husband Lord, O young and innocent bride, then focus your consciousness on the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa hoveh sohaaganee har jeeau marai na jaae raam ||
verses.translation: You shall be a happy soul bride of your Dear Lord forever; He does not die or leave.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau marai na jaae gur kai sahaj subhaae saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord does not die, and He does not leave; through the peaceful poise of the Guru, the soul bride becomes the lover of her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam sadhaa hai niramal gur kai sabadh seegaaree ||
verses.translation: Through truth and self-control, she is forever immaculate and pure; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: meraa prabh saachaa sadh hee saachaa jin aape aap upaiaa ||
verses.translation: My God is True, forever and ever; He Himself created Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sadhaa pir raave aapanaa jin gur charanee chit laiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she who focuses her consciousness on the Guru's feet, enjoys her Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pir paiaRaa baalaRe'e anadhin sahaje maatee raam ||
verses.translation: When the young, innocent bride finds her Husband Lord, she is automatically intoxicated with Him, night and day.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee man anadh bhiaa tit tan mail na raatee raam ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes blissful, and her body is not tinged with filth at all.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tit tan mail na raatee har prabh raatee meraa prabh mel milaae ||
verses.translation: Her body is not tinged with filth at all, and she is imbued with her Lord God; my God unites her in Union.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin raave har prabh apanaa vichahu aap gavaae ||
verses.translation: Night and day, she enjoys her Lord God; her egotism is banished from within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat paiaa sahaj milaiaa apane preetam raatee ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, she easily finds and meets Him. She is imbued with her Beloved.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee prabh raave ra(n)g raatee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, she obtains glorious greatness. She ravishes and enjoys her God; she is imbued with His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: pir raave ra(n)g raataRe'e pir kaa mahal tin paiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Ravishing her Husband Lord, she is imbued with His Love; she obtains the Mansion of His Presence.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਹੋ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: so saho at niramal dhaataa jin vichahu aap gavaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: She is utterly immaculate and pure; the Great Giver banishes self-conceit from within her.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: vichahu moh chukaiaa jaa har bhaiaa har kaaman man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord drives out attachment from within her, when it pleases Him. The soul bride becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaavai nit saache kathe akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: Night and day, she continually sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; she speaks the Unspoken Speech.

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jug chaare saachaa eko varatai bin gur kinai na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Throughout the four ages, the One True Lord is permeating and pervading; without the Guru, no one finds Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak ra(n)g ravai ra(n)g raatee jin har setee chit laiaa ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she revels in joy, imbued with His Love; she focuses her consciousness on the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kaaman man sohilaRaa saajan mile piaare raam ||
verses.translation: The mind of the soul bride is very happy, when she meets her Friend, her Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee man niramal hoaa har raakhiaa ur dhaare raam ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, her mind becomes immaculate; she enshrines the Lord within her heart.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har raakhiaa ur dhaare apanaa kaaraj savaare gurmatee har jaataa ||
verses.translation: Keeping the Lord enshrined within her heart, her affairs are arranged and resolved; through the Guru's Teachings, she knows her Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: preetam moh liaa man meraa paiaa karam bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: My Beloved has enticed my mind; I have obtained the Lord, the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa har vasiaa ma(n)n muraare ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, she finds lasting peace; the Lord, the Destroyer of pride, dwells in her mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak mel liee gur apunai gur kai sabadh savaare ||4||5||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she merges with her Guru, embellished and adorned with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||5||6||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sohilaRaa har raam naam gur sabadhee veechaare raam ||
verses.translation: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; contemplate it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har man tano gurmukh bheejai raam naam piaare raam ||
verses.translation: The mind and body of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord, the Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam piaare sabh kul udhaare raam naam mukh baanee ||
verses.translation: Through the Name of the Beloved Lord, all one's ancestors and generations are redeemed; chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan rahe sukh paiaa ghar anahadh surat samaanee ||
verses.translation: Comings and goings cease, peace is obtained, and in the home of the heart, one's awareness is absorbed in the unstruck melody of the sound current.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har eko paiaa har prabh naanak kirapaa dhaare ||
verses.translation: I have found the One and only Lord, Har, Har. The Lord God has showered His Mercy upon Nanak.

verses.original: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sohilaRaa har raam naam gur sabadhee veechaare ||1||
verses.translation: The song of joy is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, contemplate it. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ham neevee prabh at uoochaa kiau kar miliaa jaae raam ||
verses.translation: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur melee bahu kirapaa dhaaree har kai sabadh subhaae raam ||
verses.translation: The Guru has very mercifully blessed me and united me with the Lord; through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord, I am lovingly embellished.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: mil sabadh subhaae aap gavaae ra(n)g siau raleeaa maane ||
verses.translation: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly embellished; my ego is eradicated, and I revel in joyous love.

verses.original: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: sej sukhaalee jaa prabh bhaiaa har har naam samaane ||
verses.translation: My bed is so comfortable, since I became pleasing to God; I am absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sohaagan saa vaddabhaagee je chalai satigur bhaae ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul bride is so very blessed, who walks in harmony with the True Guru's Will.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨੀਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham neevee prabh at uoochaa kiau kar miliaa jaae raam ||2||
verses.translation: I am lowly, and God is lofty and exalted. How will I ever meet Him? ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaTe sabhanaa vich eko eko raam bhataaro raam ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa prabh dhoor vasai ikanaa man aadhaaro raam ||
verses.translation: God dwells far away from some, while for others, He is the Support of the mind.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨ ਆਧਾਰੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa man aadhaaro sirajanahaaro vaddabhaagee gur paiaa ||
verses.translation: For some, the Creator Lord is the Support of the mind; He is obtained by great good fortune, through the Guru.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT har prabh eko suaamee gurmukh alakh lakhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord God, the Master, is in each and every heart; the Gurmukh sees the unseen.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje anadh hoaa man maaniaa naanak braham beechaaro ||
verses.translation: The mind is satisfied, in natural ecstasy, O Nanak, contemplating God.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਮ ਭਤਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaTe sabhanaa vich eko eko raam bhataaro raam ||3||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, and deep within all, is the One Lord, the Husband Lord of all. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevan satigur dhaataa har har naam samaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧੂੜਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਮੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har dhooR dhevahu mai poore gur kee ham paapee mukat karaiaa raam ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please bless me with the dust of the feet of the Perfect Guru, so that I, a sinner, may be liberated.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: paapee mukat karaae aap gavaae nij ghar paiaa vaasaa ||
verses.translation: Even sinners are liberated, by eradicating their egotism; they obtain a home within their own heart.

verses.original: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: bibek budhee sukh rain vihaanee gurmat naam pragaasaa ||
verses.translation: With clear unerstanding, the night of their lives passes peacefully; through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is revealed to them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har har anadh bhiaa dhin raatee naanak har meeTh lagaae ||
verses.translation: Through the Lord, Har, Har, I am in ecstasy, day and night. O Nanak, the Lord seems sweet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥੭॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: gur sevan satigur dhaataa har har naam samaae ||4||6||7||5||7||12||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Guru, the True Guru, the Giver, merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||6||7||5||7||12||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag soohee mahalaa chauthhaa chha(n)t ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Fourth Mehla, Chhant, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਅਵਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh milai avagan vikanaa gun ravaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: If only I could meet the True Guru, the Primal Being. Discarding my faults and sins, I would chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaai gurbaanee nit nit chavaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Continuously, continually, I chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee sadh meeThee laagee paap vikaar gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Gurbani always seems so sweet; I have eradicated the sins from within.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rog giaa bhau bhaagaa sahaje sahaj milaiaa ||
verses.translation: The disease of egotism is gone, fear has left, and I am absorbed in celestial peace.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa sej gur sabadh sukhaalee giaan tat kar bhogo ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the bed of my body has become cozy and beautiful, and I enjoy the essence of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin sukh maane nit raleeaa naanak dhur sa(n)jogo ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, I continually enjoy peace and pleasure. O Nanak, this is my pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਕੁੜਮੁ ਕੁੜਮਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh kar bhaau kuRam kuRamaiee aaiaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is lovingly embellished with truth and contentment; her Father, the Guru, has come to engage her in marriage to her Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kar mel gurbaanee gaavaieeaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: Joining with the humble Saints, I sing Gurbani.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baanee gur gaiee param gat paiee pa(n)ch mile sohaiaa ||
verses.translation: Singing the Guru's Bani, I have obtained the supreme status; meeting with the Saints, the self-elect, I am blessed and adorned.

verses.original: ਗਇਆ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: giaa karodh mamataa tan naaThee paakha(n)dd bharam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Anger and attachment have left my body and run away; I have eradicated hypocrisy and doubt.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਰੋਗਤ ਭਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: haumai peer giee sukh paiaa aarogat bhe sareeraa ||
verses.translation: The pain of egotism is gone, and I have found peace; my body has become healthy and free of disease.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee braham pachhaataa naanak gunee gaheeraa ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, I have realized God, the ocean of virtue. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh vichhuRee dhoor mahal na paae bal giee bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is separated, far away from God; she does not obtain the Mansion of His Presence, and she burns.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੂਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਈ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mamataa koor kooR vihaajhe kooR liee bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: Egotism and falsehood are deep within her; deluded by falsehood, she deals only in falsehood.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kapaT kamaavai mahaa dhukh paavai vin satigur mag na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Practicing fraud and falsehood, she suffers terrible pain; without the True Guru, she does not find the way.

verses.original: ਉਝੜ ਪੰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਧਕੇ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aujhaR pa(n)th bhramai gaavaaree khin khin dhake khaiaa ||
verses.translation: The foolish soul-bride wanders along dismal pathways; each and every moment, she is bumped and pushed.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aape dhiaa kare prabh dhaataa satigur purakh milaae ||
verses.translation: God, the Great Giver, shows His Mercy, and leads her to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke vichhuRe jan mele naanak sahaj subhaae ||3||
verses.translation: Those beings who have been separated for countless incarnations, O Nanak, are reunited with the Lord, with intuitive ease. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਲਗਨੁ ਗਣਾਇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਨ ਓਮਾਹੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa lagan ganai hiradhai dhan omaaheeaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: Calculating the most auspicious moment, the Lord comes into the bride's home; her heart is filled with ecstasy.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪਾਧੇ ਆਣਿ ਪਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਵਾਚਾਈਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paadhe aan patee beh vaachaieeaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Pandits and astrologers have come, to sit and consult the almanacs.

verses.original: ਪਤੀ ਵਾਚਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਜਬ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: patee vaachaiee man vajee vadhaiee jab saajan sune ghar aae ||
verses.translation: They have consulted the almanacs, and the bride's mind vibrates with bliss, when she hears that her Friend is coming into the home of her heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਹਿ ਮਤਾ ਪਕਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਤੁ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gunee giaanee beh mataa pakaiaa fere tat dhivaae ||
verses.translation: The virtuous and wise men sat down and decided to perform the marriage immediately.

verses.original: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: var paiaa purakh aga(n)m agochar sadh navatan baal sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: She has found her Husband, the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Primal Lord, who is forever young; He is her Best Friend from her earliest childhood.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kirapaa kar kai mele vichhuR kadhe na jaiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he has mercifully united the bride with Himself. She shall never be separated again. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: soohee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿਲੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਪਰਵਿਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har pahilaRee laav paraviratee karam dhiraRaiaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the first round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord sets out His Instructions for performing the daily duties of married life.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਤਜਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: baanee brahamaa vedh dharam dhiraRahu paap tajaiaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: Instead of the hymns of the Vedas to Brahma, embrace the righteous conduct of Dharma, and renounce sinful actions.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dharam dhiraRahu har naam dhiaavahu simirat naam dhiraRaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name; embrace and enshrine the contemplative remembrance of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur gur pooraa aaraadhahu sabh kilavikh paap gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, and all your sins shall be dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj ana(n)dh hoaa vaddabhaagee man har har meeThaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, celestial bliss is attained, and the Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the mind.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਾਵ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਆਰੰਭੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan kahai naanak laav pahilee aara(n)bh kaaj rachaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the first round of the marriage ceremony, the marriage ceremony has begun. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੂਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har dhoojaRee laav satigur purakh milaiaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the second round of the marriage ceremony, the Lord leads you to meet the True Guru, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭੈ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau bhai man hoi haumai mail gavaiaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: With the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord in the mind, the filth of egotism is eradicated.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਭਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: niramal bhau paiaa har gun gaiaa har vekhai raam hadhoore ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the Immaculate Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and behold the Lord's Presence before you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har aatam raam pasaariaa suaamee sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is the Lord and Master of the Universe; He is pervading and permeating everywhere, fully filling all spaces.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar har prabh eko mil har jan ma(n)gal gaae ||
verses.translation: Deep within, and outside as well, there is only the One Lord God. Meeting together, the humble servants of the Lord sing the songs of joy.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੀ ਲਾਵ ਚਲਾਈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhoojee laav chalaiee anahadh sabadh vajaae ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the second round of the marriage ceremony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੀਜੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har teejaRee laav man chaau bhiaa bairaageeaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa har mel har paiaa vaddabhaageeaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble Saints of the Lord, I have found the Lord, by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: niramal har paiaa har gun gaiaa mukh bolee har baanee ||
verses.translation: I have found the Immaculate Lord, and I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. I speak the Word of the Lord's Bani.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਥੀਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa vaddabhaagee paiaa har katheeaai akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the humble Saints, and I speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai har har har dhun upajee har japeeaai masatak bhaag jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, vibrates and resounds within my heart; meditating on the Lord, I have realized the destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਤੀਜੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bole teejee laavai har upajai man bairaag jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the third round of the marriage ceremony, the mind is filled with Divine Love for the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਉਥੜੀ ਲਾਵ ਮਨਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har chauthaRee laav man sahaj bhiaa har paiaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, my mind has become peaceful; I have found the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਬਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh miliaa subhai har man tan meeThaa laiaa bal raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have met Him, with intuitive ease; the Lord seems so sweet to my mind and body.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har meeThaa laiaa mere prabh bhaiaa anadhin har liv laiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord seems so sweet; I am pleasing to my God. Night and day, I lovingly focus my consciousness on the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man chi(n)dhiaa fal paiaa suaamee har naam vajee vaadhaiee ||
verses.translation: I have obtained my Lord and Master, the fruit of my mind's desires. The Lord's Name resounds and resonates.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਧਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh Thaakur kaaj rachaiaa dhan hiradhai naam vigaasee ||
verses.translation: The Lord God, my Lord and Master, blends with His bride, and her heart blossoms forth in the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਚਉਥੀ ਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak bole chauthee laavai har paiaa prabh avinaasee ||4||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak proclaims that, in this, the fourth round of the marriage ceremony, we have found the Eternal Lord God. ||4||2||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har gun gaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord;

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai rasan rasaae ||
verses.translation: in their hearts, and on their tongues, they enjoy and savor His taste.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har rasan rasaae mere prabh bhaae miliaa sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: They enjoy and savor His taste, and are pleasing to my God, who meets them with natural ease.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin bhog bhoge sukh sovai sabadh rahai liv laae ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they enjoy enjoyments, and they sleep in peace; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag gur pooraa paieeaai anadhin naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, one obtains the Perfect Guru; night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sahaje sahaj miliaa jagajeevan naanak su(n)n samaae ||1||
verses.translation: In absolute ease and poise, one meets the Life of the World. O Nanak, one is absorbed in the state of absolute absorption. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat sa(n)t milaae || har sar niramal naae ||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I bathe in the Immaculate Pool of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਏ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: niramal jal naae mail gavaae bhe pavit sareeraa ||
verses.translation: Bathing in these Immaculate Waters, my filth is removed, and my body is purified and sanctified.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat mail giee bhram bhaagaa haumai binaThee peeraa ||
verses.translation: The filth of intellectual evil-mindedness is removed, doubt is gone, and the pain of egotism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar prabhoo satasa(n)gat paiee nij ghar hoaa vaasaa ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. I dwell in the home of my own inner being.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)gal ras rasan rasaae naanak naam pragaasaa ||2||
verses.translation: My tongue tastes the taste of the Lord's joyous song; O Nanak, the Naam shines forth brightly. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ratan beechaare || gurmukh naam piaare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh loves the Name of the Lord; deep within, she contemplates the jewel of the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har naam piaare sabadh nisataare agiaan adher gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who love the Lord's Name are emancipated through the Word of the Shabad. The darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੋਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: giaan pracha(n)dd baliaa ghaT chaanan ghar ma(n)dhar sohaiaa ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom burns brilliantly, illuminating the heart; their homes and temples are embellished and blessed.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan man arap seegaar banaae har prabh saache bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have made my body and mind into adornments, and dedicated them to the True Lord God, pleasing Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo prabh kahai soiee par keejai naanak a(n)k samaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever God says, I gladly do. O Nanak, I have merged into the fiber of His Being. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh kaaj rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord God has arranged the marriage ceremony;

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਆਹਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh veeaahan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: He has come to marry the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਵੀਆਹਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: veeaahan aaiaa gurmukh har paiaa saa dhan ka(n)t piaaree ||
verses.translation: He has come to marry the Gurmukh, who has found the Lord. That bride is very dear to her Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa mil ma(n)gal gaae har jeeau aap savaaree ||
verses.translation: The humble Saints join together and sing the songs of joy; the Dear Lord Himself has adorned the soul-bride.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਏ ਅਪੂਰਬ ਜੰਞ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar gan ga(n)dharab mil aae apoorab ja(n)n(j) banaiee ||
verses.translation: The angels and mortal beings, the heavenly heralds and celestial singers, have come together and formed a wondrous wedding party.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh paiaa mai saachaa naa kadhe marai na jaiee ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have found my True Lord God, who never dies, and is not born. ||4||1||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: raag soohee chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Soohee, Chhant, Fourth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਵਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aavaho sa(n)t janahu gun gaaveh govi(n)dh kere raam ||
verses.translation: Come, humble Saints, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mil raheeaai ghar vaajeh sabadh ghanere raam ||
verses.translation: Let us gather together as Gurmukh; within the home of our own heart, the Shabad vibrates and resonates.

verses.original: ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ghanere har prabh tere too karataa sabh thaiee ||
verses.translation: The many melodies of the Shabad are Yours, O Lord God; O Creator Lord, You are everywhere.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis japee sadhaa saalaahee saach sabadh liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Day and night, I chant His Praises forever, lovingly focusing on the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin sahaj rahai ra(n)g raataa raam naam ridh poojaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I remain intuitively attuned to the Lord's Love; in my heart, I worship the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh ek pachhaanai avar na jaanai dhoojaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I have realized the One Lord; I do not know any other. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh rav rahiaa so prabh a(n)tarajaamee raam ||
verses.translation: He is contained amongst all; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh ravai rav rahiaa so prabh meraa suaamee raam ||
verses.translation: One who meditates and dwells upon God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, knows that God, my Lord and Master, is pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh meraa suaamee a(n)tarajaamee ghaT ghaT raviaa soiee ||
