verses.translit: gur satigur kahiaa jee saachaa agam beechaaro ||
verses.translation: The Guru, the True Guru, has instructed me in the contemplation of the True, Inaccessible Lord.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦੀਨਾ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo dheenaa taa naam leenaa janam maran dhukh naaThe ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble, Holy Saint, I obtained the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the pains of birth and death left me.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਨਠੀ ਗਾਠੇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sookh aana(n)dh ghanere haumai binaThee gaaThe ||
verses.translation: I have been blessed with peace, poise and abundant bliss, and the knot of egotism has been untied.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kai madh sabh hoo te baahar raag dhokh te niaaro ||
verses.translation: He is inside all, and outside of all; He is untouched by love or hate.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas gobi(n)dh saranaiee har preetam maneh sadhaaro ||3||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe; the Beloved Lord is the Support of the mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai khojat khojat jee har nihachalu su ghar paiaa ||
verses.translation: I searched and searched, and found the immovable, unchanging home of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਅਧ੍ਰੁਵ ਡਿਠੇ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh adhruv ddiThe jeeau taa charan kamal chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: I have seen that everything is transitory and perishable, and so I have linked my consciousness to the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: prabh abinaasee hau tis kee dhaasee marai na aavai jaae ||
verses.translation: God is eternal and unchanging, and I am just His hand-maiden; He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਕਾਮ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dharam arath kaam sabh pooran man chi(n)dhee ichh pujaae ||
verses.translation: He is overflowing with Dharmic faith, wealth and success; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: srut simirat gun gaaveh karate sidh saadhik mun jan dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Vedas and the Simritees sing the Praises of the Creator, while the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saran kirapaa nidh suaamee vaddabhaagee har har gaiaa ||4||1||11||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, the treasure of mercy; by great good fortune, he sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||11||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਵਾਰ ਸੂਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: vaar soohee kee salokaa naal mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Vaar Of Soohee, With Shaloks Of The Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਰ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: soohai ves dhohaaganee par pir raavan jai ||
verses.translation: In her red robes, the discarded bride goes out, seeking enjoyment with another's husband.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pir chhoddiaa ghar aapanai mohee dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: She leaves the husband of her own home, enticed by her love of duality.

verses.original: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਵਧਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: miThaa kar kai khaiaa bahu saadhahu vadhiaa rog ||
verses.translation: She finds it sweet, and eats it up; her excessive sensuality only makes her disease worse.

verses.original: ਸੁਧੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sudh bhataar har chhoddiaa fir lagaa jai vijog ||
verses.translation: She forsakes the Lord, her sublime Husband, and then later, she suffers the pain of separation from Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su palaTiaa har raatee saaj seegaar ||
verses.translation: But she who becomes Gurmukh, turns away from corruption and adorns herself, attuned to the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sach pir raaviaa har naamaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: She enjoys her celestial Husband Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within her heart.

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aagiaakaaree sadhaa suohaagan aap melee karataar ||
verses.translation: She is humble and obedient; she is His virtuous bride forever; the Creator unites her with Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pir paiaa har saachaa sadhaa suohaagan naar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she who has obtained the True Lord as her husband, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਏ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: soohave'ee nimaane'ee so sahu sadhaa sam(h)aal ||
verses.translation: O meek, red-robed bride, keep your Husband Lord always in your thoughts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak janam savaareh aapanaa kul bhee chhuTee naal ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, your life shall be embellished, and your generations shall be saved along with you. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape takhat rachaion aakaas pataalaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself established His throne, in the Akaashic ethers and the nether worlds.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: hukame dharatee saajeean sachee dharam saalaa ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the earth, the true home of Dharma.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap upai khapaidhaa sache dheen dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created and destroys; He is the True Lord, merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa rijak sa(n)baahidhaa teraa hukam niraalaa ||
verses.translation: You give sustenance to all; how wonderful and unique is the Hukam of Your Command!

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape aap varatadhaa aape pratipaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: You Yourself are permeating and pervading; You Yourself are the Cherisher. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹਬ ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soohab taa sohaaganee jaa ma(n)n laih sach naau ||
verses.translation: The red-robed woman becomes a happy soul-bride, only when she accepts the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਚੜੀ ਤਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur apanaa manai lai roop chaRee taa agalaa dhoojaa naahee thaau ||
verses.translation: Become pleasing to your True Guru, and you shall be totally beautified; otherwise, there is no place of rest.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਤੂ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa seegaar banai too mailaa kadhe na hoviee ahinis laagai bhaau ||
verses.translation: So decorate yourself with the decorations that will never stain, and love the Lord day and night.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sohaagan kaa kiaa chihan hai a(n)dhar sach mukh ujalaa khasamai maeh samai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, what is the character of the happy soul-bride? Within her, is Truth; her face is bright and radiant, and she is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਲੋਕਾ ਵੇ ਹਉ ਸੂਹਵੀ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: lokaa ve hau soohavee soohaa ves karee ||
verses.translation: O people: I am in red, dressed in a red robe.

verses.original: ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਰਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: vesee sahu na paieeaai kar kar ves rahee ||
verses.translation: But my Husband Lord is not obtained by any robes; I have tried and tried, and given up wearing robes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak tinee sahu paiaa jinee gur kee sikh sunee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone obtain their Husband Lord, who listen to the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai in bidh ka(n)t milee ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, happens. In this way, the Husband Lord is met. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਿਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee sirasaT saajeean bahu bhit sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: By His Command, He created the creation, the world with its many species of beings.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਸਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa hukam na jaapee ketaRaa sache alakh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: I do not know how great Your Command is, O Unseen and Infinite True Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa no too mel laih gur sabadh beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: You join some with Yourself; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach rate se niramale haumai taj vikaaraa ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are immaculate and pure; they conquer egotism and corruption.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis too meleh so tudh milai soiee sachiaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: He alone is united with You, whom You unite with Yourself; he alone is true. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soohave'ee soohaa sabh sa(n)saar hai jin dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: O red-robed woman, the whole world is red, engrossed in evil-mindedness and the love of duality.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਠੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਿਉ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਕੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh jhooTh sabh binas jai jiau Tikai na birakh kee chhaau ||
verses.translation: In an instant, this falsehood totally vanishes; like the shade of a tree, it is gone.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਜੀਠ ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh laalo laal hai jiau ra(n)g majeeTh sachaRaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is the deepest crimson of crimson, dyed in the permanent color of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਉਲਟੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aulaTee sakat sivai ghar aaiee man vasiaa har a(n)mirat naau ||
verses.translation: She turns away from Maya, and enters the celestial home of the Lord; the Ambrosial Name of the Lord dwells within her mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak balihaaree gur aapane jit miliaai har gun gaau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to my Guru; meeting Him, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: soohaa ra(n)g vikaar hai ka(n)t na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The red color is vain and useless; it cannot help you obtain your Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਲਹਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis lahadhe bilam na hoviee ra(n)dd baiThee dhoojai bhai ||
verses.translation: This color does not take long to fade; she who loves duality, ends up a widow.

verses.original: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਦੁੰਮਣੀ ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dh iaanee dhu(n)manee soohai ves luobhai ||
verses.translation: She who loves to wear her red dress is foolish and double-minded.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh sachai ra(n)g laal kar bhai bhai seegaar banai ||
verses.translation: So make the True Word of the Shabad your red dress, and let the Fear of God, and the Love of God, be your ornaments and decorations.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sadhaa sohaaganee j chalan satigur bhai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever, who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap upaian aap keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself created Himself, and He Himself evaluates Himself.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhaa a(n)t na jaapiee gur sabadh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: His limits cannot be known; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh gubaar hai dhoojai bharamaiee ||
verses.translation: In the darkness of attachment to Maya, the world wanders in duality.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh Thaur na pain(h)ee fir aavai jaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest; they continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai sabh chalai rajaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him, that alone happens. All walk according to His Will. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: soohai ves kaaman kulakhanee jo prabh chhodd par purakh dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: The red-robed bride is vicious; she forsakes God, and cultivates love for another man.

verses.original: ਓਸੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: os seel na sa(n)jam sadhaa jhooTh bolai manmukh karam khuaar ||
verses.translation: She has neither modesty or self-discipline; the self-willed manmukh constantly tells lies, and is ruined by the bad karma of evil deeds.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai bhataar ||
verses.translation: She who has such pre-ordained destiny, obtains the True Guru has her Husband.

verses.original: ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਧਰੇ ਗਲਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: soohaa ves sabh utaar dhare gal pahirai khimaa seegaar ||
verses.translation: She discards all her red dresses, and wears the ornaments of mercy and forgiveness around her neck.

verses.original: ਪੇਈਐ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: peieeaai saahurai bahu sobhaa paae tis pooj kare sabh saisaar ||
verses.translation: In this world and the next, she receives great honor, and the whole world worships her.

verses.original: ਓਹ ਰਲਾਈ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: oh ralaiee kisai dhee naa ralai jis raave sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: She who is enjoyed by her Creator Lord stands out, and does not blend in with the crowd.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sadhaa suhaaganee jis avinaasee purakh bharataar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is the happy soul-bride forever; she has the Imperishable Lord God as her Husband. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਗੇ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: soohaa ra(n)g supanai nisee bin taage gal haar ||
verses.translation: The red color is like a dream in the night; it is like a necklace without a string.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa ra(n)g majeeTh kaa gurmukh braham beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs take on the permanent color, contemplating the Lord God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੀ ਸਭਿ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak prem mahaa rasee sabh buriaaieeaa chhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, with the supreme sublime essence of the Lord's Love, all sins and evil deeds are turned to ashes. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag aap upaion kar choj viddaan ||
verses.translation: He Himself created this world, and staged this wondrous play.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhaat vich paieean moh jhooTh gumaan ||
verses.translation: Into the body of the five elements, He infused attachment, falsehood and self-conceit.

verses.original: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavai jai bhavaieeaai manmukh agiaan ||
verses.translation: The ignorant, self-willed manmukh comes and goes, wandering in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa aap bujhaion gurmukh har giaan ||
verses.translation: He Himself teaches some to become Gurmukh, through the spiritual wisdom of the Lord.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhagat khajaanaa bakhasion har naam nidhaan ||4||
verses.translation: He blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, and the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਲਗੀ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: soohave'ee soohaa ves chhadd too taa pir lagee piaar ||
verses.translation: O red-robed woman, discard your red dress, and then, you shall come to love your Husband Lord.
